Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.

</details>


### [163] [Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20625)
*Tisha Chawla,Susheem Koul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Chronicle 在非确定性边界处记录 LLM agent 运行并支持 cut-point replay，将录制的事故转化为可离线、位稳定的 CI 回归测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 的失败难以复现：推理非位可复现、工具读取变化状态、多步轨迹难以重复。现有 agent 工具只记录用于追踪或评分的运行，无法针对代码变更进行测试。

Method: 将运行在非确定性边界记录为不可变信封并可重放；核心操作 cut-point replay 从记录中服务选定边界子集，其余边界用新代码实时执行，从而把录制的事故变为 CI 回归测试。基于 6 个模拟模型边界的失败 benchmark 进行评测。

Result: 记录每次穿越增加 23 μs（约为假设 300 ms 模型调用的 0.008%）；完整重放零模型调用，20 次重复位稳定；cut-point 测试在有缺陷代码上失败，在有保护和良性变更上通过，6 个事故全部符合；在受保护工具变异研究中，cut-point 测试捕获所有允许不安全动作通过的变异体，而桩化所有边界的基线用相同断言捕获零个。

Conclusion: Chronicle 以低开销记录与位稳定重放实现 agent 失败的确定性回归测试，cut-point replay 可有效检测回归并优于全桩基线；Chronicle 与 benchmark 已公开。

Abstract: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 μs per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.

</details>


### [164] [UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20630)
*Kun Yao,Yuhang Zhou,Yichi Zhang,Zeliang Tong,Shengri Xue,Haitao Wang,Siyu Lu,Qianlong Xie,Xingxing Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UniPolicy是一个面向搜索广告的目标感知多策略对齐框架，通过分层参数解耦与多阶段偏好构造，实现相关性、点击倾向与商业价值的联合优化，离线与在线实验均取得多指标均衡提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索广告需同时兼顾相关性、点击倾向与商业价值等异构目标，以平衡用户体验与商业收益；现有系统多将预训练生成模型对齐到单一业务奖励（如eCPM），或采用朴素奖励融合，易因梯度竞争导致全局次优。

Method: 提出UniPolicy框架：采用目标专属前缀token、稀疏MoE-LoRA路由与目标专属残差FFN，在共享主干内分层解耦参数，为不同业务目标提供差异化的参数与策略表达空间；基于多阶段行为反馈构造成对偏好，补充曝光未点击样本的相对偏好信息并强化点击候选项在生成分布中的相对优势；推理阶段支持并行的、业务可定制的多策略beam search，在固定召回预算下灵活分配各目标候选配额。

Result: 大规模离线实验显示，UniPolicy在保持召回质量的同时实现多指标均衡提升，优于单目标强化学习与朴素奖励融合基线；在真实搜索广告系统的7天在线A/B测试中，CTR提升0.71%，RPS提升1.58%，广告收入提升1.32%，且服务延迟保持稳定。

Conclusion: UniPolicy通过目标感知的多策略参数解耦与偏好对齐，有效缓解多目标梯度竞争，在固定检索预算下实现用户体验与商业价值的协同优化，具备实际线上部署的可行性。

Abstract: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.

</details>


### [165] [HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20684)
*Hassan Saeed Hassan Albattra,Mazen Mohammed Bahgat,Rahatara Ferdousi,Hana Essam Sayed Ahmed Amrya,Mariam Mousa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出HerHealthEval框架，用于受控评估大语言模型在多语言女性健康沟通中的理解能力。通过英、法、现代标准阿拉伯语三种语言及六种沟通形式（规范、临床、通俗、间接/模糊、情绪化、刻意信息不足）对模型进行测试，发现聚合准确率与一致性可能掩盖安全隐患：在多语言适配下法语和阿拉伯语的分诊不足率达0.994，改用源生语言不变风险标签重新适配后分别降至0.572和0.558。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗沟通中的应用日益增多，但现有评估多聚焦回答质量，并默认模型已正确理解用户诉求，忽视了语言多样性、语域差异和不确定性表达的潜在风险。因此需要一个受控框架来检验多语言女性健康沟通中的深层理解与安全问题。

Method: 构建HerHealthEval受控评估框架：针对每个临床案例，提供英语、法语和现代标准阿拉伯语的匹配版本，覆盖六种沟通形式（规范、临床、通俗、间接/模糊、情绪化、刻意信息不足）。前五种保留相同临床信息，信息不足形式刻意省略细节以测试模型是否主动寻求澄清。评估多语言指令模型及QLoRA适配变体，指标体系包括诉求分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性和跨形式一致性。

Result: 聚合准确率和一致性会掩盖与安全相关的失败。多语言适配模型在语言非对称风险监督下，法语和阿拉伯语的分诊不足率高达0.994；采用源生、语言不变风险标签进行受控再适配后，分诊不足率分别降至0.572和0.558。

Conclusion: 稳健的多语言医疗评估必须显式测试语域变化、不确定性处理，以及适配标签的来源与不变性；仅依赖聚合指标可能漏检安全隐患。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

</details>


### [166] [Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20712)
*Levent Bulut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出并操作化"摘要化偏差"这一构念，指LLM倾向于将叙事意义表征为抽象摘要标签，而非生成该意义的可重构推理性结构；并将其分为生成性与评价性两种机制，后者因LLM充当评判者而更具影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益担任评判者与奖励模型，若其对叙事存在方向性偏差，将形成选择压力，使文风退化为平直陈述。因此需要明确界定并检验此类偏差。

Method: 在Bulut Doctrine的"讲述—展示"轴框架下定义摘要化偏差，将其与LLM-as-judge既有偏差对照，重新解读一项已完成的独立信度研究作为方向性证据，并预注册一项双机制检验及可放弃该构念的判定规则。

Result: 本文未宣称该偏差已获验证；仅将其定位为构念，提供与之一致的方向性证据，并给出预注册的检验方案。

Conclusion: 摘要化偏差是待检验的构念而非已确立结论；评价性机制最具后果，需通过预注册的双机制实验加以验证或放弃。

Abstract: This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure.
  The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration.
  This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

</details>


### [167] [On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20734)
*Haibo Feng,Ruiqi Liang,Hanyang Peng,Shiqi Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 On-Demand Attention（ODA），一种局部优先的解码方法：基于预训练模型解码状态中已蕴含的“全局读取收益”预测信号，用轻量 recall head 按需触发全局注意力，仅训练 recall head 并保留完整历史 KV cache；在 vLLM 中实现 GPU 端条件执行，将减少的全局读取转化为长上下文下的实际解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理与智能体负载日益需要高效的长上下文推理，但全注意力解码在每一步都会读取不断增长的历史，而这一读取对下一步预测的收益并不确定，造成大量无效计算。核心动机是：能否在全局读取发生之前，就预判该读取的收益，从而有选择地执行全局注意力。

Method: 1）发现预训练模型的解码状态在全局读取前已包含可预测该收益的信息；2）提出 ODA：局部优先解码，用轻量 recall head 在生成过程中根据预测收益的变化选择性调用全局注意力；3）仅训练 recall head，冻结预训练权重，并保留完整历史 KV cache 以供后续召回；4）在 vLLM 中实现 GPU 端条件执行，把减少的全局读取转化为实际解码加速。

Result: 在 Qwen 与 Gemma 系列模型（含混合注意力骨干）上的实验表明，选择性召回能够恢复局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时显著减少全局读取次数。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种新的长上下文推理范式：预训练模型可自主引导其对所保留信息的访问，从而在保持性能的同时降低全局读取开销，实现高效长上下文解码。

Abstract: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

</details>


### [168] [dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20751)
*Anton Xue,Litu Rout,Aditya Akella,Adam Klivans,Sujay Sanghavi,Sanjay Shakkottai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究将混合架构（注意力与RNN交错）的自回归模型适配为扩散语言模型，提出dQwen3.5系列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型多从全注意力Transformer适配而来，但自回归建模已转向注意力与RNN交错的混合架构；RNN结构上是因果的，难以双向化，这构成了适配障碍。作者欲探究此类骨干能否成为有效扩散语言模型。

Method: 在0.8B、2B、4B、9B四个规模上对Qwen3.5进行适配，构建dQwen3.5系列，并与全注意力对照模型比较。

Result: 相较于全注意力对照，混合骨干达到相同训练损失所需token数约为其一半；跨规模上，dQwen3.5在任意顺序解码行为上与全注意力扩散语言模型相似，并在并行解码下表现强劲。

Conclusion: 混合骨干可作为扩散语言模型适配的高效起点，尽管其RNN部分的因果性与双向化需求存在结构性不匹配。

Abstract: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.

</details>


### [169] [Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20779)
*Sarah Wyer,Sue Black,Noura Al Moubayed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"伤害洗白"（harm laundering）概念，指出大语言模型的安全性评估方法存在系统性缺陷：模型代际演进中显性歧视内容并非被消除，而是被转化为隐蔽形式。通过分析15个模型、45万条性别定向生成文本，作者发现毒性分数下降的同时表征性伤害反而上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型的安全评估依赖表层形式分类器，这些分类器报告模型代际间伤害分数持续下降。作者质疑这一方法论的完备性，认为其掩盖了伤害的真实持续存在，因此需要揭示显性歧视内容被"转化而非移除"的机制。

Method: 分析450,000条性别定向补全文本，覆盖15个模型（GPT-2至GPT-5，OpenAI GPT谱系，三种人口统计条件）。使用主题聚类、情感分析、主题多样性度量，并结合三个独立分类器（包括REGARD与Detoxify）进行表征性伤害评估，最终形式化"伤害洗白"的三标准检验及三阶段检测协议。

Result: GPT-2女性定向输出中普遍存在的性暴力聚类到GPT-4时消失，而男性定向补全获得正向表征领域（照护、情感表达、盟友身份），女性定向则未获得。GPT-5中Topic 5（1,997份文档）将乳腺癌框定为人权议题，女性定向输出中无等价聚类，但三个独立分类器均判其为非毒性。情感分数在GPT-4处反转：早期模型贬低女性，后期模型过度矫正。女性定向补全的主题多样性较男性下降36%（W/M=0.58，GPT-2时为0.91）。REGARD表征伤害差距与发布时间相关（ρ=+0.55，p=.034），Detoxify则不然（ρ=-0.23，p=.42）。

Conclusion: 毒性分数的降低并非伤害减少的充分代理指标。在OpenAI GPT谱系内，安全性评估的表面分类器方法存在系统性盲区，伤害以转化形式持续存在。作者提出可应用于任意生成模型的伤害洗白三标准检验与三阶段检测协议。

Abstract: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

</details>


### [170] [RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20784)
*Yan Yu,Zhengxi Lu,Yizhou Liu,Yichen Pan,Aozhe Wang,Qipeng Chen,Hua Yang,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Qianglong Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RetireOPD，一种自适应退出的在线策略蒸馏方法，解决多轮智能体RL训练中特权教师不可靠与监督收益阶段依赖的问题。先优化技能条件教师，再联合RL与OPD训练无技能学生，待差异不再缩小且达目标成功率后自行退出教师。在Qwen2.5 1.5B–7B上显著超越RL基线并超过教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体用RL训练时每条轨迹仅得单一标量奖励，稀疏监督不足；self on-policy distillation（OPD）试图用具备特权任务技能的自教师提供token级稠密监督，让无技能学生内化技能。但该方案在智能体任务中存在两个问题：仅凭特权信息不一定使教师可靠；教师监督的收益依赖训练阶段。因此需要重新设计教师优化与蒸馏调度方式。

Method: RetireOPD（Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation）：1）先用环境奖励优化一个解耦的技能条件教师（skill-conditioned teacher）；2）再以RL与OPD联合训练无技能学生（skill-free student）；3）不采用预设蒸馏计划，而用Adaptive Retirement自适应退出：当学生与教师的差异不再缩小、且学生达到教师成功率的某一目标比例时，学生自行放弃教师，之后仅用RL继续训练。

Result: 在Qwen2.5（1.5B至7B）系列模型上，RetireOPD相对RL基线在ALFWorld成功率上提升14.1%–18.8%，在WebShop准确率上提升11.8%–19.0%，并且在所有设置下均超过其自身的技能条件教师。

Conclusion: 将教师优化与蒸馏调度解耦、并以学生自身进步信号触发教师退出，可有效利用OPD的稠密监督而不受不可靠教师与阶段依赖收益的拖累，最终学生性能超越特权教师，验证了自适应退出策略在智能体多轮RL训练中的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

</details>


### [171] [JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20800)
*Taoyong Cui,Zhongyao Wang,Xinyue Xu,Weiyang Liu,Zhaochen Yu,Yuying Zhang,Qiang Gao,Mengyue Yang,Wanli Ouyang,Pheng Ann Heng,Yingcheng Wu,Zhenfei Yin,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出域无关的世界建模框架 JEPA-Anything，基于正交预测因子分解（OPF），在7个异构领域、多种预测与干预任务上普遍优于匹配的 JEPA 基线，并获实验与物理规律验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界建模让智能体能够预判后果、指导干预并从交互中学习，但现有预测模型多为领域专用，缺乏可跨异构系统通用的学习原则。作者试图探究是否存在一种共同的学习原理来支撑跨领域的世界建模。

Method: 在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）基础上提出正交预测因子分解（OPF）：将隐空间预测目标分解为互补因子，通过专用通路分别学习，再在共享预测设计中重组，从而构建域无关框架 JEPA-Anything。评估覆盖视觉、生物学、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场和天气七个领域，任务涵盖表征学习、干预预测、分布外泛化和长时程动力学。

Result: 在10个匹配的动力学任务上报告指标全部提升；在 Interventional Pong 上将单次干预预测误差降低34.8%；在四个分子系统的单步与100步 rollout 误差均为对比方法中最低；完成超1000个临床事件预测。因子提名得到的生物学干预在细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤片段和小鼠中获得实验支持；潜在轨道模态恢复开普勒标度指数，拟合斜率为-1.4991。

Conclusion: 结果表明存在一种可跨异构世界通用的因子化预测原理，将世界建模与干预决策及具备实验支撑的科学发现联系起来。代码已开源（Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything）。

Abstract: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

</details>


### [172] [Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20808)
*Patrick Gerard,Julia Mendelsohn,Kristina Lerman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究以2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X上的286万条帖子为数据，在同一实证框架下对六种群体间敌意理论机制进行建模，揭示其结构组织与时间排序规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 敌意言论会正常化排斥、正当化不当对待，并加剧极化与政治暴力。现有调节网络敌意言论的努力依赖社会心理学、道德心理学与政治学的基础理论，但这些理论多各自平行发展，对敌意如何形成提出不同甚至冲突的解释，且极少在真实话语中相互检验，导致对敌意修辞机制的理解碎片化，缺乏其在真实话语中如何呈现与相互关联的整体认识。

Method: 研究采集2024年美国总统选举期间TikTok、Truth Social与Twitter/X上的286万条帖子，在统一的实证框架内对六种群体间敌意基础理论的机制——边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊化、负面评价、去人性化与行动导向——进行建模，以还原群体间敌意修辞的整体组织方式。

Result: 结构上，边界建构与威胁建构是整个体系的锚点；时间上，各机制呈现规律性排序：边界建构、贬损与行动导向倾向较早出现，去人性化与威胁建构较晚，替罪羊化最晚出现。

Conclusion: 将各理论框架在真实话语中的实际呈现方式加以映射，弥合了社会科学传统之间的长期分歧，并为计算社会科学在超越单标签检测的基础上建模群体间敌意修辞提供了更清晰的实证基础。

Abstract: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

</details>


### [173] [Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20821)
*Juri Opitz,Andrianos Michail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文考察词/句子嵌入空间是否能反映质量、距离、时间、体积等物理量的客观测量关系，发现嵌入仅弱建模物理测量，且表现出异常模式，主要受表面字符串相似性影响，重新校准相似度也无法显著改善对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入空间定义了语义相似性与距离的概念，而物理测量具有唯一、客观的语义等价与距离定义，因此是检验嵌入是否真正捕捉语义的理想基准。作者希望验证嵌入表示能否忠实反映这些客观测量关系。

Method: 以质量、距离、时间、体积四类物理测量为对象，比较嵌入空间中的相似性与距离与客观测量值之间的一致性；进一步分析嵌入表示是否受表层字符串相似性（如单位名称的字面形式）影响，并尝试对相似度进行重新校准以改善对齐。

Result: 物理测量在嵌入空间中仅被弱建模，且可观察到相当特殊的测量模式；嵌入表示明显受表面字符串相似性主导；重新校准相似度后，对齐效果并未得到实质性提升。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间未能可靠地编码物理测量的客观语义结构，其相似性判断更多依赖表层字面特征而非深层测量语义；单纯的相似度校准不足以弥补这一缺陷。

Abstract: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [174] [Generative Query Suggestion via Intent Coverage and Query-Level Credit Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19209)
*Xinpeng Liu,Lu Ma,Jiayi Qiao,Mengyu Zhou,Linglong Li,Xiaofeng Bian,Haonan Chen,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出意图驱动的生成式查询建议框架，通过双阶段优化（意图感知多样性建模与查询级信用分配）提升点击率、查询质量与意图覆盖度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式查询建议的核心挑战在于兼顾单个查询的实用性与整组建议（slate）对多意图的覆盖，即同时优化质量与多样性。

Method: 双阶段优化框架：第一阶段进行意图感知多样性建模，构建与意图对齐的监督微调（SFT）数据，并采用意图感知多样性奖励（Intent-Aware Diversity Reward）优化意图覆盖；第二阶段进行查询级信用分配，将个体质量信号路由到对应查询的token，同时将组级多样性信号在整组内共享。

Result: 在大规模生产数据集上的实验（含在线A/B测试与离线评估）显示，点击率、查询质量和意图覆盖度均有提升。

Conclusion: 意图驱动的双阶段优化能有效提升生成式查询建议的综合表现，兼顾查询质量与意图多样性，并在真实生产环境中验证了效果。

Abstract: Generative query suggestion aims to enhance user engagement by anticipating user intents and recommending relevant follow-up queries. A central challenge is to generate slates whose individual queries are useful while the slate covers distinct intents. We propose an Intent-Driven Query Suggestion Framework with dual-stage optimization. First, intent-aware diversity modeling constructs intent-aligned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data and uses an Intent-Aware Diversity Reward to optimize intent coverage. Second, query-level credit assignment routes individual quality signals to the corresponding query tokens while sharing a slate-level diversity signal across the slate. Experiments on a large-scale production dataset, including online A/B testing and offline evaluation, show improvements in click-through rate, query quality, and intent coverage.

</details>


### [175] [Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19213)
*Donggeon Lee,Dooyeon Na,Seungmin Oh,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向LLM压缩的逐层课程学习框架，将模型切分为多个层段以实现高效知识迁移，并配合特征缓存与多线程策略，在BERT/GPT-2/LLaMA/Qwen上以更少显存与训练时间达到SOTA压缩性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM压缩中的知识蒸馏通常需要全模型级别的知识迁移，计算成本高、显存占用大、收敛慢。作者希望将课程学习（先易后难）与逐层分段机制结合，在降低计算开销的同时提升收敛速度与知识迁移稳定性。

Method: 1) 逐层课程学习：将整个模型划分为由若干层组成的多个段，按由易到难的顺序进行分段知识迁移，实现更高效的知识蒸馏。2) 对累积误差现象进行理论分析，论证逐层课程学习可加速收敛并稳定知识迁移过程。3) 特征缓存方法结合多线程策略，解决跨层特征错位问题，最大化GPU利用率。

Result: 在BERT与GPT-2上，所提方法在达到SOTA压缩性能的同时，将GPU显存占用和训练时长降低50%以上；在相同训练时长下，于LLaMA系列与Qwen模型上优于其他剪枝方法，且显存占用更低。

Conclusion: 逐层课程学习为LLM压缩提供了一种兼顾性能与效率的方案：通过分段课程式知识迁移并结合特征缓存与多线程优化，在多种模型与数据集上实现了领先的压缩效果、最小化显存占用与更短训练时间。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. Consequently, our method exhibits advanced model compression performance, as well as high computational efficiency in terms of minimized memory usage and short training hours. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing GPU memory usage and training hours by more than 50\% on BERT and GPT-2. Moreover, it outperforms the other pruning methods on LLaMA-family and Qwen models under the same training hours, with a lower GPU memory footprint.

</details>


### [176] [Intact-to-Amputee Transfer in Surface-EMG Gesture Decoding: Training Source and Calibration Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20297)
*Jethro Odeyemi,W. J. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 肌电识别器难以跨人迁移，肌电界面缺乏无校准的零样本迁移能力；本文在11名经桡截肢者上验证一个跨用户编码器，发现零样本跨群体迁移完全失败，需少量标注数据后性能大幅超过个体化分类器，并揭示了预测假设成立的边界条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表面肌电（EMG）识别器通常仅针对单一个体训练，跨用户迁移性差，临床实用性能往往依赖终端用户重新进行一轮带标签校准。既有证据在截肢人群上尤为薄弱：对1077项研究的系统综述显示截肢者仅出现在约六分之一的研究中。因此，需要系统检验跨用户编码器在截肢人群中的迁移能力及其边界条件。

Method: 将一个与安装位置（montage）无关的跨用户编码器迁移至11名经桡（transradial）截肢者，并采用与其健全肢体训练数据相匹配的实验协议。对比条件包括：（1）零样本跨群体迁移；（2）在目标用户上拟合的个体化分类器；（3）对源池进行不同配置——40名健全受试者 vs. 10名其他截肢者，以及二者组合。评价指标为macro F1，并考察不同标注重复次数（repetition）预算下的表现。

Result: 零样本跨群体迁移完全失败：编码器在获得新用户的带标签数据前无法开始解码。在提供3次标注重复后，编码器较临床可拟合的个体化分类器高出0.190 macro F1，且该优势在队列中每一名受试者上均成立；3次标注重复下编码器达到0.779 macro-F1，而个体化流程为0.589。用40名健全受试者训练所得的迁移效果优于用10名其他截肢者训练；二者组合的效果优于单独任一来源。研究预注册的预测（在编码器"基线强度"解释上增加"截肢者EMG可分性更低"这一前提）仅在具备若干次重复、且源池中补充了额外截肢者后才成立；在单次重复下、以及在与健全肢体对照相匹配的任何数据预算下，该预测均不成立。

Conclusion: 该研究定位了所提解释框架的适用边界：零样本跨群体肌电解码在截肢人群中不可行，少量标注校准是必要的；跨用户编码器在获得少量标注数据后可显著超越个体化分类器，且混合健全与截肢源数据可获得最佳迁移。预注册假设并非普遍成立，其有效性依赖于标注重复次数与源池构成。

Abstract: A recogniser trained on one person rarely transfers to the next, and useful performance usually demands a fresh round of labelled calibration from the end user. A systematic review of 1077 studies quantifies where the evidence is thin: amputees appear in about one in six. Here a montage-agnostic cross-user encoder is carried to eleven transradial amputees on a protocol matched to its intact-limb training data. Zero-shot cross-population transfer fails outright: the encoder requires labeled data from the new user before it begins decoding, and it then exceeds the per-user classifier a clinic would fit by 0.190 macro F1 at three repetitions and for every subject in the cohort. Given three labelled repetitions it reaches 0.779 macro-F1 against 0.589 for the per-user pipeline. Training on forty intact subjects produces better transfers to a new amputee than training on ten other amputees, and combining the two produces better transfers than either individually. The prediction pre-registered for this study, which extends the encoder's baseline-strength account with the premise that amputee EMG is less separable, holds true only after a few repetitions become available and after enriching the source pool with additional amputees. At a single repetition, and at every budget under a source matched to the intact-limb comparison, it fails. Thus, it locates the boundary of the proposed account.

</details>


### [177] [Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) Improves Classification Accuracy of Bacterial Raman Spectral Data Enabling Portable Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19453)
*Kaitlin Zareno,Jarett Dewbury,Siamak K. Sorooshyari,Hossein Mobahi,Loza F. Tadesse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对拉曼光谱病原体耐药性检测中深度学习模型泛化性差、依赖复杂预处理的问题，引入锐度感知最小化（SAM）优化器以提升跨患者群体的小样本分类泛化能力，在临床细菌分离株分类任务上相比Adam最高提升10.5%准确率，平均提升2.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抗菌素耐药性预计到2050年每年导致1000万人死亡，资源受限地区受影响最严重。拉曼光谱作为一种新型病原体诊断手段，有望在数小时内实现快速、便携的耐药性检测（金标准方法则需数天）。但现有拉曼光谱分析算法存在两大局限：1）在有限数据集上难以跨多样化患者群体泛化；2）为缓解拉曼光谱数据低质量问题，必须采用特征提取等非平凡的预处理步骤，导致模型复杂度上升。

Method: 作者采用锐度感知最小化（Sharpness-Aware Minimization, SAM）优化器，以增强模型在临床细菌分离株分类任务中跨多种超参数设置的泛化能力；将其与传统的Adam优化器进行对照，评估在光谱分类任务中的性能。

Result: 在单一数据划分上，SAM相比Adam最多提升10.5%的准确率；在所有数据划分上，平均准确率提升2.7%。

Conclusion: 结果表明SAM能够推动AI驱动的拉曼光谱工具在临床中的应用，缓解其在有限数据集和多样化患者群体下的泛化瓶颈。

Abstract: Antimicrobial resistance is expected to claim 10 million lives per year by 2050, and resource-limited regions are most affected. Raman spectroscopy is a novel pathogen diagnostic approach promising rapid and portable antibiotic resistance testing within a few hours, compared to days when using gold standard methods. However, current algorithms for Raman spectra analysis 1) are unable to generalize well on limited datasets across diverse patient populations and 2) require increased complexity due to the necessity of non-trivial pre-processing steps, such as feature extraction, which are essential to mitigate the low-quality nature of Raman spectral data. In this work, we address these limitations using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to enhance model generalization across a diverse array of hyperparameters in clinical bacterial isolate classification tasks. We demonstrate that SAM achieves accuracy improvements of up to 10.5% on a single split, and an increase in average accuracy of 2.7% across all splits in spectral classification tasks over the traditional optimizer, Adam. These results display the capability of SAM to advance the clinical application of AI-powered Raman spectroscopy tools.

</details>


### [178] [Block Parallelism For Efficient Distributed Long-Context Diffusion Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19242)
*Tarun Suresh,Pranshu Chaturvedi,Hangoo Kang,Parth Shroff,Ishan S. Khare,Hermann Kumbong,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出块并行（BP）及上下文分片块并行（CSBP），一种针对块扩散语言模型（BDLM）的新型分布式并行维度，通过将每个损坏块计算分配到单个 rank 并分片共享干净序列，消除干净 K/V 复制、保持损坏 K/V 与梯度本地化，从而在长上下文训练中实现显著加速并降低显存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BDLM 结合了块间自回归依赖与块内并行去噪，但长上下文训练受限于分布式注意力通信开销与激活内存。传统上下文并行（CP）按位置切分"干净+损坏"合并序列，需同时通信共享的干净 K/V 以及块特定的损坏 K/V 及其梯度，通信与内存代价高昂。

Method: 作者观察到 BDLM 目标函数在目标块之间可分解。据此提出块并行（BP）：将每个损坏块的计算分配给一个 rank。为扩展到长上下文，进一步提出上下文分片块并行（CSBP），在保持 BP 的同时将共享干净序列也跨这些 rank 分片。CSBP 使损坏 K/V 与梯度保持本地，避免复制干净前缀，并严格保持 BDLM 训练语义。

Result: 在 16 张 H200、256K 上下文下，CSBP 相比最佳基线在监督微调上吞吐提升 1.18-1.45 倍，在自回归模型转换为 BDLM 上提升 1.27-1.33 倍，同时峰值 HBM 持平或降低；512K 时全模型加速达 1.61 倍。在 8 张 H100 上，CSBP 使 DFlash2 投机解码器训练在 512K 加速 2.48 倍、1M 加速 7.59 倍。在 12 小时匹配的 DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT 实验中，CSBP 在每个训练检查点的 SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench Lite 通过率均更高。

Conclusion: CSBP 通过将 BDLM 目标分解性转化为新的并行维度，有效缓解长上下文训练的通信与内存瓶颈，在吞吐、显存与下游任务质量上全面优于传统 CP 基线，为大模型长上下文扩散训练提供了可扩展的分布式并行方案。

Abstract: Block diffusion language models (BDLMs) combine autoregressive dependencies across blocks with parallel denoising within blocks, but long-context training is constrained by distributed attention communication and activation memory. Conventional context parallelism (CP) shards the combined clean-plus-corrupted sequence by position, communicating shared clean K/V together with block-specific corrupted K/V and their gradients. We observe that the BDLM objective separates over target blocks. We introduce block parallelism (BP), a new distributed parallelism dimension that assigns each corrupted-block computation to one rank. To scale BP to long contexts, we introduce context-sharded block parallelism (CSBP), which also shards the shared clean sequence across those ranks. CSBP keeps corrupted K/V and gradients local, avoids replicated clean prefixes, and preserves BDLM training semantics. On 16 H200 GPUs at 256K context, CSBP improves throughput over the best baseline by 1.18-1.45x for supervised fine-tuning and 1.27-1.33x for conversion of autoregressive models to BDLMs, while matching or reducing peak HBM. Full-model speedup reaches 1.61x at 512K. On eight H100 GPUs, CSBP accelerates DFlash2 speculative-decoder training by 2.48x at 512K and 7.59x at 1M. In matched 12-hour DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT runs, CSBP achieves higher pass rates at every trained checkpoint on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench Lite. Code: https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM

</details>


### [179] [Dynamic Generalized Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20008)
*Junda Ying,Zhiwei Zeng,Peijie Zhou,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TP-DATE 提出一种无模拟的动态 Gromov-Wasserstein 最优传输框架（基于 Quadratic-form OT 的路径作用量表述），并用 travelling-pair flow matching 将交互条件路径边缘化为单一向量场，实现空间转录组数据的连续三维动力学重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典最优传输只匹配分布，Gromov-Wasserstein OT 通过结构感知代价在传输中保留几何/组织结构，这对空间转录组学的动力学重建尤为关键（既需匹配表达模式，也需保持组织空间结构）。但现有工作多局限于静态形式，缺乏可在连续时间上重建轨迹的通用动态表述。

Method: 1) 通过 path action（路径作用量）刻画一大类静态与动态 Quadratic-form OT（QOT），并证明静态-动态等价性；2) 提出 travelling-pair flow matching，允许条件路径之间相互交互，并将这些成对交互边缘化（marginalize）为单一向量场；3) 以 simulation-free（无需求解 ODE/SDE 模拟）方式训练与推断，构建 TP-DATE 理论-计算框架。

Result: 在合成数据与真实空间转录组数据上，TP-DATE 相比基线更好地保持空间结构，并提升连续三维动力学重建质量。

Conclusion: 该工作将 GW-OT 从静态推广到通用的动态形式，给出静态-动态等价的 QOT 理论刻画与可行的无模拟算法，为结构感知的连续轨迹重建（尤其空间转录组学）提供了新范式。

Abstract: Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport (GW-OT) extends classical optimal transport by introducing structure-aware transport cost. This is particularly relevant for spatial transcriptomics, where dynamical reconstruction should preserve tissue structure in addition to matching expression patterns. While static formulations have been widely used for such structure-aware alignment, a general dynamic formulation for reconstructing continuous trajectories is still missing. We introduce Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE), a theoretical and computational framework to generalize GW-OT dynamically in a simulation-free manner. We formulate a broad class of static and dynamic Quadratic-form OT (QOT) through path actions and prove the static dynamic equivalence. We further develop travelling-pair flow matching, which allows interacting conditional paths and marginalizes their interactions into a single vector field. On synthetic and real spatial transcriptomics data, TP-DATE better preserves spatial structure and improves continuous 3D dynamics reconstruction.

</details>


### [180] [Randomized SVD Approximations for Spectral Co-Clustering of Word-Document Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19243)
*Fateme Mazdarani,Carlos Toxtli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种针对二部文本数据归一化谱共聚类的随机近似方法：基于随机投影的随机SVD（RP）与结合部分SVD与逐元素随机采样的方法。实验表明两者均比全SVD基线更快，但效果依赖矩阵稀疏性：RP更稳健，采样法仅适用于较稠密矩阵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱共聚类是挖掘词-文档矩阵潜在结构的有效工具，但其依赖奇异值分解（SVD），在高维数据上标准公式计算代价高昂。因此需要高效的随机近似方案，尤其当文档簇与词簇数量可能不同（非对称二部划分）时。

Method: 提出两种归一化谱共聚类的随机近似：（1）通过随机投影实现随机SVD；（2）将部分SVD与逐元素随机采样相结合。在真实与合成数据集上与全SVD基线进行对比评测，并考察矩阵稀疏性对方法行为的影响。

Result: 两种方法相较全SVD基线均降低运行时间，但表现受矩阵稀疏性影响。随机投影方法在所测设置中更为可靠的近似；基于采样的方法在较稠密矩阵上最有用，在本身已稀疏的文本数据上收益有限。

Conclusion: 谱共聚类的随机近似方法应根据数据的底层结构来选择：追求稳健性优先随机投影法，而在较稠密矩阵上可考虑采样法。

Abstract: Spectral co-clustering is a useful tool for discovering latent structure in word-document matrices, but its reliance on singular value decomposition (SVD) can make standard formulations expensive on high-dimensional data. This paper presents two randomized approximations for normalized spectral co-clustering of bipartite text data when the numbers of document and word clusters may differ. The first method uses randomized SVD through random projection, while the second combines partial SVD with element-wise random sampling. Across real-world and synthetic datasets, both methods reduce runtime relative to the full-SVD baseline, but their behavior depends on matrix sparsity. The random projection method is the more reliable approximation across the tested settings, whereas the sampling-based method is most useful on denser matrices and provides limited benefit on already sparse text data. These results show that randomized approximations for spectral co-clustering should be selected according to the underlying structure of the data.

</details>


### [181] [Radio-Frequency Convolutional Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19279)
*Zhihui Gao,Shi-Yuan Ma,Yiran Chen,Dirk Englund,Tingjun Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出射频卷积神经网络（RF-CNN），利用无线射频中已有的频率混频器在频域原生执行卷积，将多通道卷积映射到频点由无源混频器单次完成，实现高达2640万参数、9层深CNN的推理，能效低至0.72 fJ/MAC，比附加数字处理器低两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在智能手机、可穿戴设备、无人机等边缘设备上直接运行AI模型具有低延迟、可扩展与数据隐私优势，但这类设备算力难以满足现代神经网络需求。已有的边缘加速器需额外增加计算硬件，而设备在尺寸、重量、功耗与成本（SWaP-C）上已高度受限，因此需要一种不增加硬件的替代方案。

Method: 利用无线射频收发机中普遍存在的频率混频器——其在时域对信号做乘法，等效于在频域执行卷积——将其复用为CNN推理单元。将多通道卷积映射到不同频点（frequency tones），由无源混频器以单次（single pass）方式完成计算；权重通过空中（over the air）传输获得，模拟硬件与通信功能共享，边缘设备仅需承担数据准备与读出开销。

Result: 实验表明RF-CNN可运行含多达2640万参数、9层的深度CNN，任务涵盖无线信号分类、图像分类乃至可控图像生成，性能接近全精度水平。能效低至每次乘累加0.72飞焦（fJ/MAC），比在额外数字处理器上执行低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 该工作表明可复用已部署的无线基础设施，为其已连接的数十亿设备带来高效、先进水平的AI推理能力，为边缘AI提供了一条不增加SWaP-C负担的软硬件协同路径。

Abstract: Running artificial intelligence (AI) models directly on edge devices such as smartphones, wearables, and drones offers low latency, pervasive scalability, and data privacy, but these devices rarely carry the computing capability that modern neural networks demand. Edge accelerators have been developed in response, yet each adds computing hardware to devices already constrained in size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP-C). An alternative lies in what these devices already carry: the frequency mixer in every wireless radio multiplies signals in time, natively performing convolution in the frequency domain. Here we introduce radio-frequency convolutional neural networks (RF-CNNs), which repurpose existing communication hardware for CNN inference. Multi-channel convolutions are mapped onto frequency tones for a passive mixer to execute in a single pass. We experimentally demonstrate that RF-CNN runs deep CNNs up to 26.4 million parameters and nine layers from classification of wireless signals and images to controllable image generation, close to full-precision performance. Because the weights arrive over the air and the analog hardware is shared with communication, the edge device spends energy only on data preparation and readout-down to 0.72 femtojoules per multiply-accumulate, two orders of magnitude less than it would cost on an added digital processor. These results suggest that deployed wireless infrastructure can bring efficient, state-of-the-art AI inference to the billions of devices it already connects.

</details>


### [182] [Learning-Induced Dynamical Transition in Recurrent Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19288)
*Varun Vaidya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT),描述循环神经网络在学习过程中由混沌动力学向稳定任务行为的转变,并预测了依赖于学习率的临界时间与临界反馈强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环神经网络的学习会从根本上重塑其底层动力学,使初始混沌活动转变为稳定的任务相关行为,但缺乏对该转变过程的理论刻画。

Method: 构建非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT),引入缓慢反馈驱动的学习过程产生的演化有效反馈强度,通过推导整个学习过程的两时间关联函数来分析动力学转变。

Result: 发现DMFT解的分岔定义了由混沌到稳定动力学的转变,识别出临界反馈强度及依赖于学习率的临界时间;转变源于有效动力学景观被逐渐生长的学习反馈结构所形变;理论预测的输出时间演化与数值模拟定量一致。

Conclusion: 该理论从理论上刻画了学习驱动的混沌-稳定动力学转变机制,并定量预测了训练过程中的网络输出演化。

Abstract: Learning in recurrent neural networks can fundamentally reshape their underlying dynamics, transforming initially chaotic activity into stable task-dependent behavior. We develop a non-equilibrium dynamical mean-field theory(DMFT) to describe this transition during learning. We show that a slow feedback-driven learning process generates an evolving effective feedback strength that drives the network through a transition from chaotic to stable dynamics defined by a bifurcation of the DMFT solution. By deriving the two-time correlation function throughout learning, we identify a critical feedback strength and a corresponding learning rate dependent critical time separating these regimes. The transition arises from the progressive deformation of an effective dynamical landscape by the growing learned feedback structure. Starting from the untrained state, the theory predicts the time evolution of the network output during training and shows quantitative agreement with numerical simulations.

</details>


### [183] [Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Privacy-Preserving Modeling of Heterogeneous Distributed Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19337)
*Xianjian Xie,Hao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出个性化联邦分层高斯过程（pFedHGP），用于数据分散在异构客户端时的概率回归与分类，在保持数据本地化的同时实现不确定性感知预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据分布在异构客户端上时，需要在保护隐私（不集中原始数据）的前提下进行概率建模，并同时兼顾客户端间的共享知识与个性化差异。

Method: 将每个客户端的隐函数分解为三部分：共享全局分量、共享全局核结构的客户端特定偏差、以及灵活局部残差；采用稀疏诱导变量近似与联邦变分推断，仅同步共享分量的低维统计量，原始数据保留在本地；由全预测分布支持不确定性决策。并给出瞬时线性混合模型视角，将该层次结构与多输出高斯过程联系起来。

Result: 在压力机吨位监测中仅用13.77%的标注循环即实现完美的故障分类；在联邦空气质量建模中无需集中站点级时间序列即可恢复地理分区。

Conclusion: pFedHGP 是一种有效的个性化联邦概率建模框架，兼顾共享与个性化、隐私保护与不确定性量化，并可通过瞬时线性混合模型视角与多输出高斯过程建立联系。

Abstract: We present Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes (pFedHGP) for probabilistic regression and classification when data are distributed across heterogeneous clients. Each client's latent function decomposes into (i) a shared global component, (ii) a client-specific deviation that shares the global kernel structure, and (iii) a flexible local residual. Sparse inducing-variable approximations and federated variational inference keep raw data local while the server synchronizes only low-dimensional statistics for the shared component. Full predictive distributions support uncertainty-aware decisions. In application studies, pFedHGP attains perfect fault classification in press tonnage monitoring using 13.77% of labeled cycles and recovers geographic zones in federated air-quality modeling without centralizing station-level time series. An Instantaneous Linear Mixing Model viewpoint links the hierarchy to multi-output Gaussian processes for correlated sensors.

</details>


### [184] [How to Guide Your Language Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19356)
*Rohit Dilip,Tianrong Chen,Yuyang Wang,David Van Valen,Joshua Susskind,Miguel Angel Bautista*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"探针引导"（probe guidance），利用扩散模型冻结的内部状态构建引导信号，无需额外前向传播即可引导流匹配模型，在连续扩散语言模型上刷新无条件生成性能，并揭示了自引导机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自引导（autoguidance）虽有效但需在推理时增加一次额外前向传播，且其内部机制尚不清晰。作者希望在保持引导效果的同时降低推理开销，并厘清自引导的工作机理。

Method: 探针引导使用现有扩散模型的冻结内部状态构造引导信号，原理与自引导类似，但省去推理时的额外前向传播，并能可靠保证弱模型与强模型具有相似的动力学。方法在连续扩散语言模型上应用与评测，并借助探针研究传统的自引导设置（弱模型为弱检查点）。

Result: 在无条件生成任务上取得新的最优性能；应用于1.7B扩散语言模型时，在多项选择题问答基准上获得一致提升；通过探针分析发现，自引导中弱模型必须来自训练的低熵区域。

Conclusion: 探针引导为改进扩散语言模型提供了实用途径，同时揭示了目前理解不足的自引导背后的实际机制，即弱模型需源自低熵训练区域。

Abstract: We introduce a new method to guide flow matching models. Our approach, which we call probe guidance, uses the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct a guidance signal. This works using a similar principle as autoguidance, but eliminates the need for an additional forward pass at inference time and provides a reliable path to ensure that the weak and strong model share similar dynamics. We apply and benchmark this method on continuous diffusion language models, where probe guidance sets a new state-of-the-art performance on unconditional generation. When applied to a 1.7B diffusion language model, probe guidance consistently improves on multiple choice question answering benchmarks. Using our probes, we study the traditional autoguidance setting where the strong model is a weak checkpoint, and find that the weak model must come from a low-entropy region of training. These findings both provide a practical way to improve diffusion language models and shed light on the actual mechanism behind autoguidance, which is currently poorly understood.

</details>


### [185] [Smart Insole Human Activity Recognition for Continuous Monitoring in Elderly Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19359)
*Edwin Rios,Antony Garcia,Fengpei Yuan,Xinming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无线智能鞋垫平台与机器学习流程，从足底压力与IMU信号识别坐、站、走及不稳定行走；在参与者独立验证下，HGB达到macro-F1 0.954/0.959（左/右脚）与0.980（双侧），为老年跌倒预防提供基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 老年人跌倒通常先伴随移动能力、平衡与体位转换的变化，因此需要一种低负担、可穿戴的连续活动状态监测手段。现有研究常缺少参与者独立的严格验证，且鞋垫式压力与惯性融合方案在模型选择与评估协议上的规范性不足，难以确认其对未见用户的泛化能力。

Method: 硬件上每只鞋垫集成16个有源压力传感点与六维IMU（三轴加速度+三轴角速度）。采集15名健康成人数据，采样率80 Hz，切分为重叠窗口。先用分层10折交叉验证筛选窗口长度与候选模型族，再以参与者独立的5折分层分组交叉验证（同一参与者所有窗口留在同一折）作为主要性能估计。对比Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting与紧凑1D-CNN。

Result: 在参与者独立协议下，HGB的macro-F1为左足0.954、右足0.959，双侧融合提升至0.980。相同折划分下，紧凑1D-CNN未显著优于HGB（p=0.0625）。

Conclusion: 低外形鞋垫式传感可基于压力与IMU测量推断活动状态，且对训练中未见的参与者仍有效，为老年照护中的活动监测与跌倒预防奠定基础。

Abstract: Falls in older adults are often preceded by changes in mobility, balance, and postural transitions. This paper presents a wireless smart insole platform and machine-learning workflow for recognizing sitting, standing, walking, and unstable walking from plantar-pressure and inertial signals. Each insole integrates 16 active pressure-sensing locations and a six-dimensional IMU stream consisting of tri-axial acceleration and angular velocity. Data were collected from 15 healthy adults at 80~Hz and segmented into overlapping windows. Window length and candidate model families were first screened with stratified 10-fold cross-validation; the primary performance estimate was then obtained with participant-independent 5-fold Stratified Group cross-validation, ensuring that all windows from a participant remained in a single fold. Under this protocol, Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting (HGB) achieved macro-F1 scores of 0.954 and 0.959 for the left and right feet, respectively, and 0.980 with bilateral sensing. A compact 1D-CNN evaluated with the same participant-independent folds did not significantly outperform HGB ($p=0.0625$). The results show that low-profile footwear sensing can infer activity state from pressure and IMU measurements for participants unseen during training, establishing a basis for activity monitoring and fall prevention in elderly care.

</details>


### [186] [Stiefel Attention: When the Geometry of Transformer Projection Matrices Dominates Optimizer Choice---and When It Does Not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19363)
*Rubén Darío Guerrero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将注意力机制中的WQ、WK投影约束在Stiefel流形上，并用带信赖域与极分解回缩的Riemannian Adam优化，从理论与实验两方面论证其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注意力中的查询与键投影WQ、WK几乎总是用欧氏优化器训练，且对其几何结构无任何约束。作者希望通过将权重约束在Stiefel流形上并采用黎曼优化来改进训练。

Method: 把WQ、WK约束到Stiefel流形St(d,r)上，使用Riemannian Adam优化：每帧携带一个标量二阶矩，通过信赖域限制步长，并用极分解进行回缩。作者给出五个命题：前四个证明该更新是嵌入度量下的最速下降、与梯度尺度无关、良态、且精确满足O(d)-等变性（并用float64数值验证）；第五个揭示机制——权重衰减在St(d,r)上的黎曼梯度恒为零（因W=WIr位于法空间），故学到的注意力几何能在衰减引发的坍缩循环中存活。

Result: 在模运算grokking任务上，单次运行在第20000轮达到97.0%验证准确率，基线为61.1%（作者将其视为机制证据而非效应量）。在CIFAR-10 patches上，同一规则相对12个配对起始点提升+8.98 pp（t=60.6，12/12），且差距随数据增加而扩大。固定步长黎曼更新对梯度是一阶的，每步移动量仅为同形AdamW矩阵的24–40倍之一，其框架几乎不离开初始化，直接冻结仅损失0.28 pp。消融表明全部增益来自步长尺度自由，投影器与等变性无可测贡献。另有一个负面结果：规范移除无法作为方法动机，因为损失不变方向根本不含梯度。

Conclusion: 将注意力投影约束在Stiefel流形并用Riemannian Adam优化可带来稳定且随数据扩展的增益，机制在于权重衰减的黎曼梯度恒为零使注意力几何得以保留；增益主要来自使步长尺度自由，而非投影器或等变性，规范移除也不能为方法提供动机。

Abstract: The query and key projections $\WQ,\WK$ in attention are almost always trained by Euclidean optimizers with no constraint on their geometry. We constrain them to the Stiefel manifold and optimize them there with a Riemannian Adam that carries one scalar second moment per frame, caps its step by a trust region, and retracts polarly. Four propositions prove this update is steepest descent in the embedded metric, independent of gradient scale, well conditioned, and exactly $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariant, each certified numerically in \texttt{float64}. A fifth supplies the mechanism: weight decay has \emph{identically zero} Riemannian gradient on $\St(d,r)$, since $W = W I_r$ lies in the normal space, so the learned attention geometry survives the collapse cycles that decay drives through the rest of the model. On modular arithmetic grokking, a single run holds $97.0\%$ validation accuracy at epoch 20\,000 against the baseline's $61.1\%$---an unstable endpoint we report as evidence for the mechanism rather than as an effect size. On CIFAR-10 patches the same rule gains $\mathbf{+8.98}$\,pp over 12 paired starts ($t{=}60.6$, $12/12$), and the gap widens with data rather than eroding. The step rule earns this: a fixed-step Riemannian update is degree one in the gradient, so it moves $24$--$40\times$ less per step than an identically shaped AdamW matrix---its frames barely leave their initialization, and freezing them outright costs only $0.28$\,pp. An ablation credits the whole gain to making the step scale free, and nothing measurable to the projector or to equivariance. A negative result sharpens the account: gauge removal cannot motivate the method, because a direction along which the loss is invariant carries no gradient at all.

</details>


### [187] [RISC-V and machine learning: a survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20677)
*Shriman Keshri,Apparna Singh,Chinmaya Kumar Palo,Shreya Adya,Subhankar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该综述分析了RISC-V ISA在机器学习中的应用现状，涵盖学术与商业实现、软件框架及实际部署，提出了统一的分类法、性能与设计权衡的对比、工具链成熟度评估及新兴趋势识别，并提出四个未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源处理器架构与机器学习的交汇推动了对可定制、高效且易获取硬件的需求，因此有必要系统梳理RISC-V在机器学习领域的能力、挑战与未来方向。

Method: 基于近期研究进行综述分析，覆盖指令集扩展、核心实现、编译器优化与部署策略，对学术与商业实现、软件框架及实际应用进行考察，并构建统一分类法与对比分析。

Result: 在能效、专用指令开发和框架集成方面取得进展，同时存在标准化、验证复杂性和生态碎片化等挑战。

Conclusion: 提出四个研究方向：专用神经处理扩展、自适应与模块化处理器架构、安全框架以及高能效多域架构，为RISC-V成为下一代机器学习系统的基础平台提供路线图。

Abstract: The intersection of open-source processor architectures and machine learning is driving the demand for customizable, efficient, and accessible hardware. This survey examines the state of the RISC-V ISA in machine learning applications, analyzing current capabilities, challenges, and future directions based on recent research. The analysis covers academic and commercial implementations, software frameworks, and real-world applications. The RISC-V machine learning ecosystem is evaluated, from instruction set extensions and core implementations to compiler optimizations and deployment strategies. Key contributions include a unified taxonomy of RISC-V ML implementations, a comparative analysis of performance and design trade-offs, an evaluation of software toolchain maturity, and the identification of emerging trends in instruction set extensions and specialized accelerators. Findings reveal progress in energy efficiency, specialized instruction development, and framework integration, while highlighting challenges in standardization, verification complexity, and ecosystem fragmentation. The analysis proposes four research directions to address current limitations: specialized neural processing extensions, adaptive and modular processor architectures, security frameworks, and energy-efficient multi-domain architectures. These directions provide a roadmap for advancing RISC-V as a foundational platform for next-generation machine learning systems.

</details>


### [188] [Machine-Learning Assessment of the Predictive Value of Inflammatory Biomarkers for Cognitive Impairment in an Older Hispanic Adult Cohort](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19374)
*Antony Garcia,Gabrielle Britton,Alcibiades Villarreal,Diana Oviedo,Giselle Rangel,Xinming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在PARI-HD队列(n=165)中，采用泄漏安全的阈值似然伯努利/类别朴素贝叶斯分类器，发现I-309(CCL1)是可解释的认知障碍表格预测候选特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型临床表格数据集需要可解释的机器学习方法：深度学习通常不实用，集成模型难以检视，且统计显著性未必意味着预测效用，因此需要一个可解释且严格防泄漏的分类框架。

Method: 基于PARI-HD队列(n=165)构建阈值似然伯努利/类别朴素贝叶斯(BNB/CNB)分类器。在每个训练折内，将连续预测变量通过监督式卡方派生状态离散化，收入以类别似然形式进入模型。所有依赖数据的步骤均在重复分层10折交叉验证(30次重复)内完成；采用配对DeLong检验评估增量预测价值，并在200个随机划分上评估稳健性，对18个候选标志物进行Benjamini-Hochberg多重检验校正。

Result: 人口学基线ROC-AUC为0.630±0.017。I-309(CCL1)是最主要的增量特征，使AUC提高0.110，配对DeLong检验在100%的重复中p<0.05。预设定主分析中I-309的固定划分DeLong p=0.0018，200次随机划分的中位p值为0.0011。在18个候选标志物中，I-309在冻结划分上BH校正后q=0.032，并在85%的随机划分中满足q<0.05，其余标志物均未显示可靠的增量预测价值。

Conclusion: 拟合模型是可检视的阈值与类条件概率表，结果将I-309/CCL1确定为认知障碍表格预测的可解释候选特征，但仍需外部验证。

Abstract: Small clinical tabular datasets require interpretable machine learning because deep learning is often impractical and ensemble models can be difficult to inspect. A key pitfall is that statistical significance does not necessarily imply predictive utility. Using data from the Panama Aging Research Initiative--Health Disparities (PARI-HD) cohort (n=165), we implemented a leakage-safe threshold-likelihood Bernoulli/Categorical Naive Bayes (BNB/CNB) classifier. Within every training fold, each continuous predictor was reduced to a supervised chi-square-derived state, while income entered the model through a categorical likelihood. All data-dependent steps were performed within repeated stratified 10-fold cross-validation with 30 repeats. The demographic baseline achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.630 +/- 0.017. I-309 (CCL1) was the dominant incremental feature, increasing AUC by 0.110, with paired DeLong tests yielding p<0.05 in 100% of repeats. In the pre-specified primary analysis, I-309 produced a fixed-partition DeLong p=0.0018, with robustness assessed across 200 random partitions, where the median p-value was 0.0011. Within the exploratory family of 18 candidate markers, I-309 achieved a Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted q=0.032 on the frozen partition and satisfied q<0.05 in 85% of random partitions, whereas no other marker demonstrated reliable incremental predictive value. Because the fitted model is an inspectable table of thresholds and class-conditional probabilities, these results identify I-309/CCL1 as an interpretable candidate feature for tabular prediction of cognitive impairment, pending external validation.

</details>


### [189] [Sample Count Is Not Enough: Candidate-Generation Strategy Shapes the Energy and Performance of LLM Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19499)
*Mobina Kashaniyan,Ali Jannesari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出，测试时扩展中“候选数N”不足以描述系统成本：在固定N=8时，批次调度（1x8 vs 8x1）会显著影响能耗与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样式测试时扩展方法常以生成候选数N衡量推理预算与效率，但N只表示生成多少候选，不表示候选如何执行；相同的N可一次批量生成或拆分为多次小批量串行生成，其系统成本（延迟、能耗等）可能完全不同。作者希望揭示准确率指标之外的系统开销问题。

Method: 在Phi-3-mini与Qwen2.5-1.5B上对500条GSM8K提示测试N从1到8的准确率变化；随后固定N=8，比较四种生成调度：1x8、2x4、4x2、8x1（axb表示a次调用、每次b个候选），并在A100上测量延迟、吞吐、GPU-hours与GPU设备总能耗；同时用三台独立调度的A100节点及短输出SciQ/V100实验做验证。

Result: N从1增至8时，Phi-3-mini准确率提升8.4个百分点，Qwen2.5-1.5B提升18.4个百分点；固定N=8时，在A100上八次串行调用（8x1）的GPU设备总能耗是单次批量8候选（1x8）的4.64–4.86倍，P95延迟是5.77–6.12倍。该模式在三台独立A100节点及SciQ/V100实验中一致出现。

Conclusion: 候选数本身不足以刻画多候选测试时扩展的系统成本；当候选相互独立且显存允许时，更少调用、更大批量更高效。评估应同时报告候选数、准确率、生成调度以及GPU级系统指标（如延迟、吞吐、能耗）。

Abstract: Test-time scaling can improve large language model reasoning by generating and combining multiple candidate responses. In sampling-based methods, the inference budget is often described by the number of generated candidates, N. However, N tells us how many candidates are generated, not how they are executed. The same candidate budget can be produced in one batched generation call or split across several sequential calls with smaller batch sizes. We first study the effect of increasing N on reasoning accuracy using Phi-3-mini and Qwen2.5-1.5B on 500 GSM8K prompts. As expected, increasing N from 1 to 8 improves accuracy by 8.4 percentage points for Phi-3-mini and 18.4 points for Qwen2.5-1.5B. However, accuracy alone does not show the systems cost of using a larger candidate budget. We therefore fix N = 8 and compare four generation schedules: 1x8, 2x4, 4x2, and 8x1, where axb denotes a generation calls with b candidates per call. We measure latency, throughput, GPU-hours, and gross GPU-device energy while keeping the total candidate count fixed. On A100 GPUs, eight serial calls use 4.64-4.86x as much gross GPU-device energy and have 5.77-6.12x the P95 latency of one batched call with eight candidates. The same pattern appears across three independently scheduled A100 nodes per model and in short-output SciQ/V100 experiments. These results show that candidate count alone is not enough to describe the systems cost of multi-candidate test-time scaling. When candidates are independent and memory allows it, fewer generation calls with larger batch sizes are more efficient. Evaluations should therefore report not only candidate count and accuracy, but also generation schedule and GPU-level systems metrics.

</details>


### [190] [FCx: An algorithm for finding Feasible Counterfactual Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19383)
*Kleopatra Markou,Vana Kalogeraki,Dimitrios Gunopulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可行反事实解释（FCx），首次高效生成兼顾真实性、低代价与可行性的反事实解释，支持领域知识硬约束与因果推断软约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法虽能生成真实且低代价的样本，但往往不保证可行性：给出的修改不可构造，或与未来变化不相容（如改变种族以获得工作）。因此需要显式约束反事实解释的可行性。

Method: FCx基于改进的变分自编码器（VAE），采用多因素损失函数优化。损失中同时考虑硬可行约束（由领域知识用户指定）与软可行约束（通过数据集因果推断自动获取）；代价以数值绝对变化（proximity）与改动特征数量（sparsity）衡量，真实性以LOF密度估计衡量，确保反事实位于高密度区域。

Result: 在四个公开数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在多项指标上达到当前最优水平，同时保证可行性。

Conclusion: FCx首次实现了高效生成真实、低代价且可行的反事实解释，在保持SOTA性能的同时显式满足可行性约束。

Abstract: Counterfactual (CF) explanations identify changes that alter an input's classification. While existing methods produce realistic and low-cost CFs, they often fail to ensure feasibility, by suggesting non-constructive modifications or incompatible with future changes (e.g., changing an individual's race to secure a job offer). We introduce a refinement of CF explanations that explicitly enforces feasibility. Our approach is the first to efficiently generate CFs that are realistic, low-cost and feasible. We accommodate both hard feasible constraints, specified by domain knowledge users, and soft feasible constraints, inferred automatically via causal inference from the dataset. Our method, Feasible Counterfactual Explanations (FCx), is based on a modified Variational Autoencoder (VAE) optimized with a multi-factor loss function. We measure the cost of a change based on the absolute change in values (proximity) as well as the number of features changed (sparsity) while realism is measured based on the LOF for density estimation, guaranteeing that CFs reside in densely populated regions. Extensive experiments on four public datasets show that our approach matches state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics while guaranteeing feasibility.

</details>


### [191] [Improving Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning via Selective Reward Stimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19414)
*Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RSIQL，一种在离线目标条件强化学习中通过中间状态奖励刺激缓解奖励传播问题的非分层方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习面临稀疏奖励和长时序依赖的挑战：目标完成信号与早期决策在时间上相距甚远，同时离线价值估计会引入额外误差，导致目标导向的价值区分度相对于局部估计误差过小。

Method: 从奖励传播视角进行理论分析，在延迟目标设定下刻画价值区分度与估计误差的关系；提出RSIQL，利用辅助的目标条件价值函数识别离线轨迹中估计有进展的中间状态，并在这些状态施加奖励刺激，从而提供延迟更小的训练监督，且不学习单独的高层子目标策略。

Result: 在D4RL目标到达基准和OGBench上，RSIQL平均优于目标条件IQL，并与分层离线目标条件方法性能相当，同时保持简单的扁平策略结构。

Conclusion: 通过缓解奖励传播延迟，可在不引入分层结构的前提下有效提升离线目标条件强化学习性能。

Abstract: Goal-conditioned reinforcement learning aims to learn policies that reach specified goals, but remains challenging in offline settings with sparse rewards and long-horizon dependencies. In such settings, goal-completion information can be temporally distant from the early decisions that enable success, while offline value estimation introduces additional error. We study this issue from a reward-propagation perspective and show, in a stylized delayed-goal setting, how goal-directed value separation can become small relative to local estimation error. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Reward Stimulation Implicit Q-Learning (RSIQL), a simple non-hierarchical method that introduces additional reward signals at progress-making intermediate states in offline trajectories. RSIQL uses an auxiliary goal-conditioned value function to identify intermediate states estimated to make progress toward the goal and applies reward stimulation to provide less-delayed training supervision. Unlike hierarchical methods, RSIQL does not learn a separate high-level subgoal policy. Experiments on D4RL goal-reaching benchmarks and OGBench show that RSIQL improves over goal-conditioned IQL on average and achieves performance competitive with hierarchical offline goal-conditioned methods, while retaining a simple flat policy structure.

</details>


### [192] [Bayesian Optimization with Rich Auxiliary Information via LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19437)
*Tejus Gupta,Efe Mert Karagözlü,Rohit Sonker,Barnabás Póczos,Jeff Schnieder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）将丰富辅助信息（如训练曲线、专家注释、先验知识）融入贝叶斯优化（BO），提出三种方法，在超参数优化及核聚变优化任务中优于标准BO与现有LLM优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实优化问题常包含比单纯函数评估更丰富的信息，而传统贝叶斯优化仅利用函数评估，未能充分利用这些辅助信息。作者希望借助LLM的能力挖掘并整合这些信息以提升优化效果。

Method: 首先展示LLM能有效利用丰富辅助信息指导优化；据此提出三种将辅助信息通过LLM融入贝叶斯优化的方法。

Result: 在超参数优化基准与真实核聚变优化任务上，所提方法一致优于标准贝叶斯优化及现有基于LLM的优化方法。

Conclusion: 结果表明LLM能有效利用丰富辅助信息辅助贝叶斯优化，验证了该方向的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely used for optimizing expensive black-box functions, yet many real-world optimization problems contain substantially richer information than function evaluations alone. Examples include training curves in hyperparameter optimization, expert notes and images in scientific experimentation, and prior knowledge about where optima may lie. We show that large language models (LLMs) can effectively leverage such rich auxiliary information to guide optimization. Motivated by these findings, we develop three methods for incorporating auxiliary information into BO using LLMs. Across hyperparameter optimization benchmarks and a real-world nuclear fusion optimization task, our methods consistently outperform both standard BO and existing LLM-based optimization approaches. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of LLMs for leveraging rich auxiliary information in BO.

</details>


### [193] [Enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network by Domain Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19466)
*Ci Lin,Futong Li,Rose Chong-Wu,Tet Yeap,Iluju Kiringa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KAINN（知识增强农业信息神经网络），在AINN基础上引入肥料扩散、土壤呼吸和充水孔隙度等领域知识，构建神经-机理混合框架；在CNN、LSTM、Transformer上验证，其RMSE和MAE更低、R²更高，参数轨迹更平滑且物理一致、不确定性更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业N2O排放受土壤性质、气候、生化过程和管理措施复杂交互影响，高质量观测数据有限，预测困难。深度学习虽能捕捉非线性关系，但缺乏物理可解释性，且跨环境条件泛化能力差。因此需要兼顾预测精度、可解释性与泛化性的方法。

Method: 提出KAINN混合神经-机理框架，扩展农业信息神经网络（AINN），融入肥料扩散、土壤呼吸和充水孔隙度三方面领域知识；在多个生长季和多种输入特征配置下，以CNN、LSTM和Transformer三种架构进行评价，并与纯数据驱动模型及原始AINN对比，同时分析学习到的界面（parameter trajectories）。

Result: KAINN的均方根误差（RMSE）和平均绝对误差（MAE）总体低于纯数据驱动模型和原始AINN，R²更高；学习界面的参数轨迹更平滑、更具物理一致性，且不确定性降低。

Conclusion: 将环境知识融入神经网络可提升农业N2O排放预测的可靠性、可解释性和泛化能力，为可持续农业评估与环境影响评价提供支持。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions from agriculture is important for assessing environmental impacts and supporting sustainable farming. However, prediction remains difficult because N2O emissions result from complex interactions among soil properties, climate, biochemical processes, and management practices, while high-quality observations are limited. Deep learning models can capture nonlinear relationships but often lack physical interpretability and may generalize poorly across environmental conditions. We propose the Knowledge-enhanced Agriculture-informed Neural Network (KAINN), a hybrid neural-mechanistic framework that extends the Agriculture-informed Neural Network by incorporating domain knowledge about fertilizer diffusion, soil respiration, and water-filled porosity. We evaluate KAINN using CNN, LSTM, and Transformer architectures across multiple growing seasons and input-feature configurations. The results show that KAINN generally provides lower root mean square error and mean absolute error and higher R-squared values than purely data-driven models and the original AINN. Analysis of the learned interfaces also shows smoother and more physically consistent parameter trajectories with reduced uncertainty. These findings demonstrate that incorporating environmental knowledge into neural networks can improve the reliability, interpretability, and generalization of agricultural N2O-emission predictions.

</details>


### [194] [Search at the Cost of Sampling: Nearly-Instant Latent Space Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19476)
*Donney Fan,Colin Doumont,Aleksandra Kalisz,Paul Duckworth,Jacob R. Gardner,Henry Moss,Geoff Pleiss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用球面域上的线性模型与球对称性，得到代理建模和采集函数的近闭式解，使贝叶斯优化在生成模型的新分子/图像发现流程中提速至少100倍且性能不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型在de novo发现流程中按规模生成设计，再经虚拟筛选挑出候选进行实验验证。贝叶斯优化虽能利用历史评估指导后续提议，但序列决策的计算开销在虚拟筛选成本较低时成为瓶颈，导致BO在该场景下难以实用。

Method: 利用高维隐变量集中分布在球面域这一特性，在受球面约束的线性模型上开展工作：基于近期关于线性代理模型合理性的证据，针对代理建模与采集函数问题推导出利用球对称性的近闭式解。

Result: 相较当前最优基线实现至少100倍加速，并在分子生成与图像生成基准上取得相当或更优的性能。

Conclusion: 该方法使贝叶斯优化成为de novo生成流程中可直接替换的实用组件，适用于此前因过慢而不予考虑的场景。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly central to many de novo discovery pipelines, in which designs are generated at scale and filtered through virtual screens to determine a set of candidates to experimentally validate. While Bayesian optimization (BO) is a natural fit for this setting, as it uses past evaluations to guide future proposals, the computational overhead required for its sequential decision-making becomes a bottleneck when virtual screens are relatively cheap. We make BO practical in this regime by exploiting the unique combination of a linear model constrained to a spherical domain where high-dimensional latents concentrate. We build off recent work justifying the use of linear surrogates, while deriving nearly closed-form solutions to the surrogate modelling and acquisition problems that exploit spherical symmetry. The result is at least a 100x speedup over state-of-the art baselines, with matching or improved performance across molecular and image generation benchmarks. Altogether, our method makes BO a practical drop-in for de novo pipelines where it was previously too slow to consider.

</details>


### [195] [Multi-center Medical Data Mining with FL-Net - A One-stop Shop for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20650)
*Simon Süwer,Julian Klemm,Elisa Acitelli,Mathieu Almeida,Lucia Altucci,Zsolt Bagyura,Michelangela Barbieri,Zsolt-Zoltán Bedő,Rosaria Benedetti,Béla Bihari,Csongor Csalóka,Lucia Dicunta,Stanislav Ehrlich,Bjoern M. Eskofier,Sándor-József Fejér,Georg Fröwis,Walter Hötzendorfer,Alexandra Kautzky-Willer,Jens Johann Georg Lohmann,Marianna Maranghi,Lorenzo Marconi,Rudolf Mayer,Wouter Leonard Megchelenbrink,Monika Moga,Adham Mottalib,Sanjeev Mehta,Madeleine Müller,Thomas Nyström,Balázs-Attila Orbán,Paul O'Toole,Giuseppe Paolisso,Paolo Parini,Matteo Pedrelli,Enrico Petrillo,Philipp Poindl,Niklas Probul,Anastasia Pustozerova,Tanja Šarčević,Lukas Weilguny,Jan Baumbach,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出联邦学习多数研究仅停留在仿真阶段，现有14个框架均无法完全满足文献提出的五项需求，故提出FL-Net框架以全面满足这些需求，并通过端到端评估验证其可行性与可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可实现无需共享患者级数据的协作训练，但多数研究仍是仿真，缺乏实际可部署、可复现、隐私保护且支持多中心临床研究的完整框架。基于文献提炼的五项需求，作者分析14个现有联邦学习框架，发现无一完全满足，因此需要构建一个满足全部需求的临床研究框架。

Method: 提出FL-Net框架，整合模块化数据协调、数据发现、信息披露控制、安全构建的带版本FL-Net-Tools，以及容器化联邦工作流执行，形成持久网络；支持跨研究复用协调后的数据与工作流；通过数据协调、跨MIMIC与US-130的跨研究患者发现，以及支持多达50个并发客户端的可复现、可审计联邦工作流进行端到端评估。

Result: FL-Net的端到端能力得到验证，包括数据协调、跨MIMIC与US-130的跨研究患者发现，以及支持最多50个并发客户端的可复现、可审计联邦工作流。该框架正在dAIbetes和Microb-AI-ome两个欧盟项目中开发，将覆盖9个国家10家医院、超过80万名患者，涵盖纵向与单时点数据。

Conclusion: FL-Net为可互操作、可复现且隐私保护的多中心临床研究提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative training without sharing patient-level data, but most studies remain simulations. Based on five requirements derived from the literature, we analyzed 14 FL frameworks and found that none fully satisfied these requirements. We present FL-Net, a novel federated clinical research framework to fulfill all requirements. It integrates modular data harmonization, data discovery, disclosure control, securely built versioned FL-Net-Tools and containerized federated workflow execution into a persistent network. It enables the re-use of harmonized data and workflows across studies. FL-Net's end-to-end capabilities were evaluated through harmonization, cross-study patient discovery across MIMIC and US-130, and reproducible, audited federated workflows with up to 50 concurrent clients. FL-Net is being developed within the dAIbetes and Microb-AI-ome EU projects and will cover over 800,000 patients across 10 hospitals in 9 countries covering longitudinal and single point in time data, FL-Net provides a practical foundation for interoperable, reproducible, and privacy-preserving multicenter clinical research.

</details>


### [196] [LSTM-UT and Recurrent-Depth Transformers on Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19521)
*Aras Kavuncu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较三种循环深度Transformer（BUT、CoTFormer、LSTM-UT）在跨步骤信息保持上的差异，发现LSTM-UT的有界门控记忆在深度外推与延迟回忆任务上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环深度Transformer反复应用共享计算，但不同模型在跨步骤保留信息的方式上存在差异，需要明确这种信息保持机制（仅当前隐状态、扩展注意力缓存、有界门控记忆）对性能的影响。

Method: 对比Block Universal Transformer（BUT，仅携带当前隐状态）、CoTFormer（保留扩展注意力缓存）与新型LSTM Universal Transformer（LSTM-UT，有界门控记忆）；在Rule 30元胞自动机和延迟回忆任务上进行评估，并通过状态与缓存干预实验分析CoTFormer的失败机制。

Result: 在Rule 30上，BUT对未见循环深度的外推比CoTFormer更可靠（虽最终精度下降）；干预显示CoTFormer的失败依赖状态与缓存的交互——修正当前状态可暂时恢复精度，而保留的历史会削弱该修正。在延迟回忆任务中，BUT亦优于CoTFormer，后者无法可靠选取所请求的缓存表示。LSTM-UT在深度外推与延迟回忆两方面均超过这些基线。

Conclusion: 有界门控记忆是重复计算及后续检索任务中的有效归纳偏置。

Abstract: Recurrent-depth Transformers apply shared computation repeatedly, but differ in how they retain information across steps. We compare a Block Universal Transformer (BUT), which carries only its current hidden state; CoTFormer, which also retains an expanding attention cache; and a new LSTM Universal Transformer (LSTM-UT) with bounded gated memory. On Rule 30 cellular automata, BUT extrapolates to unseen recurrent depths more reliably than CoTFormer, although its accuracy eventually degrades. State and cache interventions show that CoTFormer's failure depends on their interaction: correcting the current state can temporarily restore accuracy, while retained history can undermine that correction. In a delayed-recall task, BUT also outperforms CoTFormer despite lacking direct access to past states; CoTFormer does not reliably select the requested cached representation. LSTM-UT improves both depth extrapolation and delayed recall over these baselines. The results support bounded gated memory as an effective inductive bias for repeated computation and later retrieval in these tasks.

</details>


### [197] [Compressed Active Subspaces for Scalable Bayesian Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19539)
*Thomas Flynn,Sanket Jantre,Byung-Jun Yoon,Kibaek Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出压缩活跃子空间（CAS）方法，通过等距嵌入先将参数映射到压缩空间再构建活跃子空间，显著降低内存开销，实现大模型的可扩展贝叶斯推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活跃子空间方法虽然能为高维模型量化预测不确定性，但其构建过程需存储大量全维度模型梯度，随模型规模增大内存开销变得不可承受，限制了其在大模型上的应用。

Method: CAS首先利用结构化等距嵌入（structured isometric embedding）将模型参数映射到压缩空间，然后在该降维参数化内构建活跃子空间，从而在压缩空间中进行推理。

Result: 实验在不同规模递增的神经网络上验证了CAS的可扩展性，同时保持了预测性能与稳健的不确定性估计。

Conclusion: CAS大幅降低了活跃子空间构建所需内存，使标准活跃子空间方法难以处理的大模型贝叶斯推断成为可能，为高维模型的不确定性量化提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Active subspace methods provide a framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty in high-dimensional models by identifying and performing inference along parameter directions that have the greatest influence on the model output. However, the construction of active subspaces requires storing many full-dimensional model gradients, which becomes prohibitive as model size increases. We address this limitation by proposing Compressed Active Subspaces (CAS), a scalable approach that first maps the model parameters to a compressed space using a structured isometric embedding and then constructs the active subspace within this reduced parameterization. Our approach substantially reduces the memory required for active subspace construction and enables Bayesian inference for large models where standard active subspace methods become impractical. We demonstrate the scalability of CAS on neural networks of increasing size while maintaining predictive performance and robust uncertainty estimates.

</details>


### [198] [FedFIbOS: Fisher Importance based Optimal Submodelling for Heterogeneous Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19559)
*Yasmeen Afzal,Jeremiah D. Deng,Haibo Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedFIbOS，用Fisher信息量作为异质联邦学习中子模型参数选择准则，在CIFAR-10/100、AGNews上比SOTA高约10%准确率，异质性越强提升越明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质联邦学习需为不同算力的客户端训练容量受限的子模型，现有方法多基于启发式重要性（如参数幅值）选参，缺乏收敛性理论支撑；且部分客户端参与会给Fisher分数带来额外估计误差。论文指出参数选择准则与收敛框架之间存在理论空白。

Method: 将子模型选择形式化为Fisher加权的二次掩码代理问题，从最小化子模型掩码误差推导准则；提出FedFIbOS，在Fisher主导排序条件下，原始Fisher top-k规则可求解该代理问题，并保留掩码联邦优化的收敛结构；用平方梯度估计经验对角Fisher信息，实现稳定、自适应的参数选择且无额外优化开销。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和AGNews上，于病态（pathological）与Dirichlet非IID设置下，FedFIbOS比当前最优方法准确率高约10%，且异质性越强提升越显著。

Conclusion: Fisher信息为异质子模型选择提供了有理论依据的准则，弥补了幅值等启发式方法的理论缺失，并保持原掩码联邦优化的收敛结构，实验上在强异质场景下取得显著精度提升。

Abstract: Heterogeneous federated learning requires clients with diverse computational capacities to collaboratively train a global model, where each client trains a capacity-constrained submodel. Existing methods select submodel parameters using heuristic importance measures---most prominently parameter magnitude---without theoretical justification for why these measures support convergence. We identify a fundamental gap: existing parameter selection criteria lack theoretical grounding in the convergence framework, partial client participation introduces additional estimation effects in the Fisher scores. We propose \textbf{FedFIbOS}: Fisher Importance-based Optimal Submodelling for heterogeneous federated learning, using Fisher Information in a principled criterion derived from minimizing submodel masking error. %We formally establish when magnitude selection is equivalent to Fisher selection fail under non-IID heterogeneous federated learning. We theoretically formulate submodel selection through a Fisher-weighted quadratic masking surrogate and show that the raw Fisher top-$k$ rule implemented by FedFIbOS solves this surrogate under a Fisher-dominant ranking condition.
