Conclusion: 通过将全局模糊集构造为局部模糊集可容许混合之并，该工作统一处理了跨客户端混合不确定性与客户端内分布模糊性，实现客户端可分离优化，兼顾理论保证与算法收敛，并经仿真验证有效。

Abstract: Federated learning trains a shared model from private client data. In practice, data-generating distributions may differ, and the true mixture across clients is often unknown, making the underlying group distribution difficult to specify. Existing approaches address cross-client mixture uncertainty by optimizing against the worst-case mixture, yet assume accurate client-wise distribution estimates. However, these estimates can be unreliable when based on finite samples. To handle both cross-client mixture uncertainty and within-client distributional ambiguity, we construct a global ambiguity set as the union of admissible mixtures of local ambiguity sets. The construction allows client-specific ambiguity radii and admits a client-wise separable reformulation. Leveraging this structure, we establish a high-probability out-of-sample performance guarantee. We further develop a federated algorithm for a penalty-based reformulation and prove its convergence under milder regularity conditions. Simulations validate the algorithm's effectiveness.

</details>


### [268] [Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20715)
*Juzheng Zhang,Disha Makhija,Manoj Ghuhan Arivazhagan,Vinayshekhar Bannihatti Kumar,Rashmi Gangadharaiah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ActObs，在SFT阶段除了监督agent的动作token外，还监督轨迹中已有的观测token，从而让策略建模动作后果。该方法不增加数据、参数、序列长度或前向计算，并在后续GRPO强化学习中显著优于仅监督动作的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SFT只对agent生成的动作token计算损失，将环境观测作为上下文而非预测目标。作者质疑这一惯例是否为后续强化学习提供了最优初始化，希望探索是否可以通过监督观测token来改善策略的后果建模能力。

Method: 提出ActObs，在SFT时对每条轨迹中已存在的观测token也进行监督，即联合监督动作与观测。尽管部署时agent从不生成观测，但预测观测能促使策略建模动作后果。该方法不增加数据、参数、序列token或前向传播次数，随后使用GRPO进行强化学习。

Result: SFT后两者表现相近，但GRPO后出现分化。在Qwen3-4B上，ActObs的GRPO在Terminal-Bench 2.0各采样预算下pass@k均更高；在Qwen3-8B上，以部分pass@1可靠性换取更高pass@k（pass@16提升3.4个百分点）并解决更多不同任务。跨域代码编辑aider-polyglot上4B模型pass@1提升4.2个百分点（任务在SFT和RL中均未见过）。ActObs在RL中保留更高熵且策略移动更少，最终策略更接近SFT初始化。

Conclusion: 分析表明差异源于SFT：动作与观测梯度迅速变得正交，仅动作训练会留下较大的观测残差梯度并使环境预测能力低于基座模型。联合监督避免了这种单侧特化，保留了后果预测能力，为下游探索做好准备。

Abstract: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.

</details>


### [269] [Radio Frequency Detection and Classification of Microplastics in Water](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20507)
*Jaden Tolbert,Md Saiful Islam,Pingshan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种机器学习辅助的射频介电光谱流式细胞术（ML-assisted RF DiSC）平台，实现水环境中微/纳米塑料颗粒的无标记快速检测与分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微/纳米塑料（MPs/NPs）作为普遍存在的环境污染物，其丰度上升及潜在健康影响亟需快速、无标记的检测方法；而粒径降至低微米级时，传统光学与光谱技术受限于通量不足或样品前处理复杂。

Method: 构建ML辅助RF介电光谱流式细胞术平台，对悬浮于去离子水中的8类标称直径10 μm的MP颗粒，在0.2–9 GHz范围内选取4个频率进行表征；以载体介质为参考，测量RF散射参数（S参数）的变化，并用于训练有监督ML模型进行材料分类，同时测试混合样品与盐水环境下的识别能力。

Result: 对去离子水中8类MP，宏平均F1-score、精确率与召回率均超过0.71；在含3.3%与6.6%海盐的盐水载体介质中，PET的分类性能基本保持。

Conclusion: 结果验证了ML辅助RF DiSC用于水环境中快速单颗粒MP分类的可行性；未来将通过改进RF校准、扩展光谱覆盖、扩大训练数据集，以及采用环境老化与生物污染的微塑料进行验证来提升分类性能。

Abstract: Micro- and nano-plastic particles (MPs/NPs) are ubiquitous environmental contaminants whose increasing abundance and potential health impacts have created an urgent need for rapid, label-free detection methods. As particle size decreases to the low-micrometer range, conventional optical and spectroscopic techniques become increasingly challenging because of limited throughput and/or complex sample preparation. In this work, we present a machine learning (ML)-assisted radio-frequency (RF) dielectric spectroscopic cytometry (DiSC) platform for the label-free detection and classification of MPs. Eight types of $ 10 $ μm nominal-diameter MP particles suspended in deionized (DI) water were characterized at four frequencies spanning $ 0.2\text{-}9\text{ GHz} $. The measured alterations in RF scattering parameters (S-parameters), referenced to the carrier medium, were used to train supervised ML models for material classification, including the identification of MPs in mixed samples and saline-water environments. For eight MP classes suspended in DI water, the proposed method achieved macro-average F1-score, precision, and recall values exceeding $ 0.71 $. Furthermore, PET classification performance was largely maintained in saline carrier media containing $3.3\% $ and $ 6.6\% $ sea salt. These results demonstrate the feasibility of ML-assisted RF DiSC for rapid, single-particle MP classification in aqueous environments. Future work will focus on improving classification performance through enhanced RF calibration, increased spectral coverage, larger training datasets, and validation using environmentally aged and biologically contaminated microplastics.

</details>


### [270] [When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20511)
*Yuxiao Yang,Tianrun Yu,Shangzhe Li,Kaixiang Zhao,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Huaxiu Yao,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究on-policy distillation (OPD)中的长度膨胀现象，识别出基础学生模型与后训练教师模型之间的“终止token不匹配”是重要成因，并提出将功能等价的EOS token视为共享语义终止动作的修正方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在on-policy蒸馏中，学生模型的回复会变得过长，甚至耗尽生成预算（length inflation）。作者希望找出这一长度膨胀行为的来源，并探究训练过程中终止行为如何演变。

Method: 作者在Qwen3、Llama、Gemma三个模型家族上分析基础学生模型与后训练教师模型之间的termination-token mismatch，即两者可能将停止概率放在不同的EOS token上，即使声明的停止集合相同。方法包括：仅对齐解码停止集合；将功能等价的EOS token视为共享语义终止动作；并跨不同K2-Horizon训练阶段开展stage-wise分析以观察终止偏好随训练的演变。

Result: 仅对齐解码停止集合不足以解决问题；将功能等价的EOS token视为共享语义终止动作，能在三个模型家族上显著缓解由不匹配引起的长度膨胀。stage-wise分析显示终止偏好在训练过程中会大幅变化，同时在OPD训练后期还出现一种独立于终止对齐之外、持续存在的长度膨胀。

Conclusion: 终止不匹配是OPD长度动态的重要来源，但并非唯一来源；训练后期的长度膨胀需其他机制解释。作者发布了包含所提终止处理修正的实现。

Abstract: We study length inflation in on-policy distillation (OPD), where student responses can become excessively long and even exhaust the generation budget. We identify \emph{termination-token mismatch} between base students and post-trained teachers as an important source of this behavior. Across Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma, the two models can place their stopping probability on different EOS tokens, even when their declared stopping sets are identical. This mismatch can suppress the student's preferred termination action without reliably transferring the teacher-preferred alternative. We show that aligning the decoding stopping set alone is insufficient, while treating functionally equivalent EOS tokens as a shared semantic stopping action substantially mitigates mismatch-induced length inflation across all three model families. To further understand how termination behavior evolves over training, we study OPD across different K2-Horizon training stages. This stage-wise analysis shows that termination preferences can shift substantially during training, while also revealing a distinct length inflation late in the OPD run that persists beyond termination alignment. Together, these results identify termination mismatch as an important, but not exhaustive, source of OPD length dynamics. We release an implementation incorporating the proposed termination-handling corrections.

</details>


### [271] [Parallelism, critical windows, and separations among diffusion language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20539)
*Sitan Chen,Liye Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对掩码、均匀、高斯三类扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的并行采样能力进行细粒度理论比较，证明均匀与高斯扩散的采样前向次数可随分布的对偶总相关性缩放，并在随机经验测度上证明了均匀/高斯扩散与掩码扩散之间可证明的并行性分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型的核心卖点是相比自回归模型更高效的并行生成，但不同扩散范式（掩码、均匀、高斯）在并行性上的优劣缺乏原理性理解，此前仅知掩码扩散可借助内在复杂度实现高效并行采样。

Method: 通过理论分析，将均匀与高斯扩散的采样前向次数与底层分布的对偶总相关性（度量内在复杂度）建立联系；并针对一类随机经验测度，分析均匀/高斯扩散所需前向次数的下界与上界，同时构造近似 score oracle 以刻画掩码扩散所需前向次数。

Result: 证明均匀与高斯扩散的采样前向次数可随对偶总相关性缩放（该量可远小于上下文长度），此前仅掩码扩散具备此性质；对特定随机经验测度，均匀/高斯扩散需 \(\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{d})\) 次前向，而掩码扩散在存在近似 score oracle 时需 \(\widetildeΩ(d)\) 次前向，首次给出三种 dLLM 范式在并行性上的可证明分离。

Conclusion: 该分离并非源于"掩码扩散需提交 token 值"这一流行直觉，而是由于掩码扩散采样中的关键窗口渐近地比均匀与高斯扩散采样更窄，从而揭示了三种 dLLM 并行性差异的机制。

Abstract: A popular selling point of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is their capacity for parallelism: the ability to generate sequences of text far more efficiently than autoregressive models, which require one forward pass per token. Yet among the many competing paradigms for dLLMs, from masked to uniform to Gaussian diffusion, principled understanding of how these different proposals compare in parallelism remains limited. In this work, we initiate a fine-grained comparison of the capacity for parallelism among these three leading approaches and prove the following:
  - Uniform and Gaussian diffusion can sample in a number of forward passes which scales with the dual total correlation of the underlying distribution, a measure of intrinsic complexity which can be much smaller than the context length. Previously, it was only known how to achieve this using masked diffusion.
  - For a certain family of random empirical measures, we show that $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{d})$ forward passes are necessary and sufficient to sample using uniform or Gaussian diffusion, yet there exist approximate score oracles for which $\widetildeΩ(d)$ forward passes are needed for masked diffusion. This establishes the first provable separation in parallelism between the three prevailing dLLM paradigms.
  Contrary to popular intuition that masked diffusions are harder to parallelize because they must commit to token values, the latter separation instead comes from the fact that the critical windows in masked diffusion sampling are asymptotically narrower than those in uniform and Gaussian diffusion sampling.

</details>


### [272] [Mitigating Retaliatory Algorithmic Collusion in Repeated Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20548)
*Karthik Sivachandran,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示Q学习智能体在重复博弈中形成隐性合谋的机制，并提出CURB奖励塑形框架加以抑制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Q学习智能体在重复博弈中最大化自身收益时会自发收敛到类似显性合谋的超竞争结果，而现有缓解方法多局限于特定经济场景（如双边平台、拍卖），缺乏适用于一般重复博弈的干预设计。

Method: 作者将先前关于Q学习合谋的经验观察与经典简单惩罚码（SPC）理论建立形式化联系，证明任何非平凡SPC都会在智能体策略中诱导可量化的条件依赖，可通过合作与背叛历史下动作分布的总变差距离（TV）检测。据此提出CURB框架，在Q学习中对该TV距离信号施加惩罚，从而将SPC不动点转化为平凡不动点。

Result: 在Bertrand和Cournot重复竞争博弈中，CURB显著降低了Q学习智能体的合谋程度；在Bertrand竞争中进一步验证该机制可推广至深度Q网络（DQN）智能体。

Conclusion: CURB通过惩罚策略条件依赖来阻断惩罚威胁维持的合谋均衡，为一般重复博弈中的算法合谋治理提供了有理论保证的通用方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents trained to maximize their own reward in repeated interactions can converge to supra-competitive outcomes resembling explicit collusion, without communication or shared design. Existing mitigation approaches are largely tied to specific economic settings, like two-sided platforms and auctions, leaving open how to design interventions for general repeated games. We address this gap by formalizing the connection between empirical observations from prior work on Q-learning collusion and classical theory of Simple Penal Codes (SPCs). We show any non-trivial SPC induces a quantifiable conditional dependence in agents' policies, detectable via the total variation distance between an agent's action distributions across cooperation and defection histories. Building on this connection, we propose CURB (Collusion Unwinding via Reward shaping and Belief injection), a reward-shaping framework that penalizes this Total Variation (TV) distance signal during Q-learning and is guaranteed to convert any SPC fixed point of the dynamics into a trivial one, thus precluding collusive equilibria sustained by punishment threats. Empirically, CURB substantially reduces collusion by Q-learning agents in both Bertrand and Cournot Competition Repeated Games. We further demonstrate that CURB extends to deep Q-network agents in Bertrand competition, suggesting the mechanism generalizes beyond tabular Q-learning.

</details>


### [273] [CrystalMO-TuRBO: Multi-Objective Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for High-precision Joint Crystal Structure Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20592)
*Joseph Agada,Yishu Wang,Arpan Biswas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CrystalMO-TuRBO，一种用于X射线与中子衍射联合晶体结构精修的多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化架构，通过分阶段优化提升收敛性、鲁棒性与参数精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最小二乘与似然优化依赖局部搜索，难以应对非凸、含噪且参数高度相关的复杂景观；X射线与中子衍射联合精修因两者灵敏度互补又竞争，通常通过标量化目标合并，需要人工赋权，易导致次优解。

Method: 将X射线与中子偏差建模为两个独立目标，转化为归一化最大化问题；采用两阶段策略：阶段1用并行信赖域贝叶斯优化在多种标量化下进行全局探索，锁定有潜力的参数区域；阶段2在收缩区域内进行局部精修，实现高精度求解，从而将全局搜索与细粒度优化显式分离。

Result: 在单晶Ho2Ti2O7的实验X射线与中子衍射数据上评估，相较于经典精修方法与贝叶斯优化基线，所提方法在收敛性、鲁棒性和参数精度上均有提升。

Conclusion: CrystalMO-TuRBO通过多目标分解与两阶段信赖域贝叶斯优化，有效缓解联合精修中的标量化赋权难题，为多模态衍射数据的高精度晶体结构精修提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Crystal structure refinement is a fundamental inverse problem in materials characterization, where structural parameters are optimized to reproduce experimental diffraction data. Conventional approaches, such as least-squares and likelihood-based optimization, rely on local search and often struggle with non-convex, noisy, and highly correlated parameter landscapes, particularly when integrating multiple diffraction modalities. Joint refinement of X-ray and neutron data is especially challenging due to their complementary but competing sensitivities, which are typically combined through scalarized objectives requiring manual weighting and leading to suboptimal solutions. We propose CrystalMO-TuRBO, a multi-objective trust region Bayesian optimization architecture for joint crystal structure refinement. The method models X-ray and neutron discrepancies as separate objectives and transforms the problem into a normalized maximization setting. A two-phase optimization strategy is introduced: Phase 1 performs global exploration using parallel trust-region Bayesian optimization across multiple scalarizations to identify promising regions of the parameter space, while Phase 2 conducts localized refinement within a shrinking region to achieve high-precision solutions. This design explicitly separates global search from fine-grained optimization, addressing the unique accuracy requirements of refinement tasks. We evaluate the proposed method on experimentally collected X-ray and neutron diffraction data from single-crystal Ho2Ti2O7. Results demonstrate improved convergence, robustness, and parameter precision compared to classical refinement methods and Bayesian optimization baselines on refinement of a single-crystal pyrochlore material system.

</details>


### [274] [Recursive Quantum Long Short-Term Memory for Stable Short-Horizon Temperature Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20594)
*Mu-En Lee,Yen-Ku Liu,Samuel Yen-Chi Chen,Yun-Cheng Tsai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较递归QLSTM与标准QLSTM在日最低/最高气温一步预测任务中的表现，结果显示递归模型收敛更快、误差更低、泛化间隙更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QLSTM虽将变分量子电路引入循环序列学习，但其优化行为对随机初始化和时序上下文敏感，稳定性与泛化能力有待改进。

Method: 以Toronto日气象观测数据为输入，在相同训练设置下，对递归QLSTM与标准QLSTM进行对比；采用8、16、32天输入窗口，跨20个随机种子评估收敛速度、预测精度与泛化性能。

Result: 递归模型一致更早达到接近最优的测试损失，降低了MAE和RMSE，并表现出更小的泛化间隙。

Conclusion: 递归量子特征变换可提升紧凑型混合量子-经典时序模型的稳定性与样本外性能。

Abstract: Quantum long short-term memory (QLSTM) models extend recurrent sequence learning with variational quantum circuits, but their optimization behavior can vary substantially across random initializations and temporal contexts. This paper evaluates a recursive QLSTM architecture against a standard QLSTM for one-step-ahead prediction of daily minimum and maximum temperature. Using daily weather observations from Toronto and identical training settings, we compare convergence, predictive accuracy, and generalization across input windows of 8, 16, and 32 days over 20 random seeds. The recursive model consistently reaches a near-optimal test loss earlier, reduces mean absolute error and root mean squared error, and exhibits a smaller generalization gap. These results indicate that recursive quantum feature transformations can improve stability and out-of-sample performance for compact hybrid quantum--classical temporal models.

</details>


### [275] [COIN-GP: Cooperative Online Learning in Networked Distributed Systems with Partial Measurements via Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20598)
*Zewen Yang,Xiaobing Dai,Zhenxiao Yin,Hang Zhao,Zhijun Li,C. C. Chan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究分布式传感器网络中系统状态与部分未知动态的联合估计问题，提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，融合在线分布式高斯过程回归，并给出数据采集策略、误差上界与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式传感器网络中，仅有部分状态观测可用，同时系统的部分动态未知，导致状态估计与模型估计相互耦合、难度较大；现有分布式GP方法难以在测量不完整且GP模型存在缺陷时保持精度。

Method: 提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，结合在线分布式高斯过程（GP）回归，实现状态估计与未知动态估计的联合求解；并设计新的数据采集策略，给出保证数据获取可行的理论条件。

Result: 推导了同时涵盖状态估计与模型估计的误差上界，该上界利用了GP的确定性误差界；仿真实验表明该方法相较现有基于分布式GP的方法具有优势。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够在部分状态观测与GP模型不完善条件下实现状态与未知动态的联合估计，并通过理论误差界与仿真结果验证了其有效性和优越性。

Abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of jointly estimating the system states and partially unknown dynamics within distributed sensor-equipped networks, particularly in scenarios where only partial state observations are available. To address this issue, we propose an observer-based dynamic cooperative learning framework incorporating online distributed Gaussian Process (GP) regression, which enables accurate estimation despite incomplete in measurements and deficient GP models. In addition, a novel data collection strategy is introduced, with theoretical conditions ensuring feasible data acquisition. Moreover, we also derive an error upper bound encompassing state estimation and model estimation, leveraging the deterministic error bounds of GPs. Empirical simulations demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to existing distributed GP-based methods.

</details>


### [276] [Epidemiological Causal Graph Identification: Challenges, Identifiability and Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20676)
*Sambit Mishra,Yingying Wang,Christine K. Johnson,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合数据类型（有序变量与指数族变量）的DAG因果发现问题，证明有序节点与指数族节点之间的边方向在分布上可识别，并提出基于评分的穷举搜索与DAGMA掩码连续优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果可识别性研究主要针对加性噪声模型下的连续变量，忽视了包含有序尺度（ordinal）、计数（counts）和连续测量值的混合数据集，导致此类场景下的因果方向判定缺乏理论支撑。

Method: 针对节点服从有序分布（有序logit模型）或单参数指数族分布的DAG，理论证明有序节点与指数族节点之间的边方向对一般参数值具有分布可识别性；计算上提出基于评分的穷举搜索，并针对较大图引入基于DAGMA的掩码连续优化框架。

Result: 理论结果将已有的Ordinal-Poisson可识别性结论推广至更广泛的指数族；数值实验验证了理论，在马尔可夫等价类内恢复了经典结构方程模型下不可识别的边方向。

Conclusion: 该工作为混合类型数据的因果发现提供了可识别性理论保证与可扩展的计算方法，突破了传统结构方程模型在边方向识别上的局限。

Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is fundamental to statistics and machine learning, yet determining causal direction without interventions necessitates structural assumptions. Existing identifiability research primarily focuses on continuous variables under additive noise models, often neglecting mixed datasets containing ordinal scales, counts, and continuous measurements. This paper investigates causal discovery in Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) where nodes follow either an ordinal distribution (via an ordered logit model) or a regular one-parameter exponential family distribution. We prove that the edge direction between an ordinal and an exponential family node is distributionally identifiable for generic parameter values. Our findings generalize previous Ordinal-Poisson results to the broader exponential family. Computationally, we introduce a score-based exhaustive search and a masked continuous optimization framework using DAGMA for larger graphs. Numerical results validate the theory, recovering edge orientations within a Markov equivalence class that are unidentifiable under classical structural equation models.

</details>


### [277] [Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20744)
*Haocheng Xi,Yiming Xie,Hexu Zhao,Yiwen Zhang,Michael Liu,Thomas Creavin,Kurt Keutzer,Xiuyu Li,Zhaoyang Lv,Chenfeng Xu,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Video DeltaNet（VDN），将局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆结合，通过 Video Delta Attention 按帧更新记忆，在保持生成质量的同时显著加速视频扩散模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型在去噪过程中需反复处理长时空 token 序列，注意力成为主要计算瓶颈。线性注意力虽在近期大语言模型中被广泛采用，但直接用于视频模型往往难以保留高质量生成所需的细粒度交互。

Method: VDN 将局部 Softmax 注意力与用于长程视频上下文的双向线性记忆结合。其线性分支提出 Video Delta Attention（VDA），每帧通过联合纳入该帧空间 token 更新一次记忆（逐帧而非逐 token）。两个分支采用独立的输出投影与可学习门控进行校准（calibrate），并以分阶段教师对齐（staged teacher-alignment）策略将新路径逐步引入预训练模型。在 MiniMax H3 上实例化：对视频到视频交互采用混合注意力，涉及文本或音频的交互仍保留 Softmax。此外采用八步蒸馏与优化的 SGLang 服务栈。

Result: VDN-H3 在 8 张 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上，对 14.3 秒、768p 视频完成 DiT 去噪仅需 6.70 秒；相较同 GPU 数量下的 50 步稠密 H3 基线，实现 14.5 倍加速。

Conclusion: VDN 验证了局部 Softmax 注意力与逐帧更新的双向线性记忆混合方案在视频扩散模型中的有效性，可在保留细粒度生成交互的同时大幅提升推理效率。

Abstract: Video diffusion models repeatedly process long spatiotemporal token sequences during denoising, making attention a major computational bottleneck. Linear attention offers an appealing alternative and has been widely adopted in recent large language models, but directly applying it to video models often fails to preserve the fine-grained interactions required for high-quality generation. We present Video DeltaNet (VDN), which combines local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range video context. Its linear branch introduces Video Delta Attention (VDA), which updates memory once per frame by jointly incorporating its spatial tokens. Separate output projections and learnable gates calibrate the two branches, while a staged teacher-alignment recipe progressively introduces the new pathway into pretrained models. We instantiate VDN on MiniMax H3, applying the hybrid to video-to-video interactions while retaining Softmax for interactions involving text or audio. With eight-step distillation and an optimized SGLang serving stack, VDN-H3 completes DiT denoising for a 14.3-second, 768p video in 6.70 seconds on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, corresponding to a 14.5x speedup over the 50-step dense H3 baseline on the same GPU count.

</details>


### [278] [Calibrated RF-Fingerprinting Under Interference With Heterogeneous Transmission Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20765)
*Tariq Abdul-Quddoos,Xiangfang Li,Lijun Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究同信道干扰下的射频指纹识别，将其建模为多标签分类问题并用1D CNN配合校准方法，在POWDER 5G测试床真实数据上验证，准确率最高97%，校准后仍保持鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有RF指纹识别研究几乎只考虑单发射机场景，忽略了多信号在时间和频率上重叠的同信道干扰情况，限制了其在实际高竞争无线环境中的适用性，因此需要研究共信道干扰下的指纹识别。

Method: 将同信道干扰下的RF指纹识别形式化为多标签分类问题，采用1D卷积神经网络（CNN）建模；并对模型进行校准，为标签概率导出置信度阈值，保证平均假阴性数量的上界，从而在一定置信度下不漏检真实的频谱政策违规。使用POWDER 5G测试床的真实数据进行验证，涉及Wi-Fi 802.11a、4G LTE和5G NR波形。

Result: 根据信道条件不同，校准后准确率最高达97%，最低为73%；针对不同的平均假阴性上界进行校准时，micro recall分数约等于（1 - 校准假阴性），且校准对分布外干扰具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提方法在真实高竞争无线环境下展现出潜力，能够同时处理多发射机同信道干扰的RF指纹识别并控制漏检风险，具备实际频谱监测应用价值。

Abstract: Radio Frequency(RF)-Fingerprinting is a spectrum monitoring technique that identifies specific transmitters based on hardware impairments imprinted within the emitted signal. Although widely researched, studies almost exclusively consider scenarios where only one transmitter is emitting at a time, limiting real world applicability. In this work, we further the study of RF-Fingerprinting by considering co-channel interference, with multiple emitted signals interfering with each other, overlapping in time and frequency. Specifically, we formulate this problem as a multi-label classification problem and employ a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN). Furthermore, the models are calibrated such that the confidence thresholds for the label probabilities are derived, with guarantees on the upper bound on the average number of False Negatives, providing a degree of confidence in not missing a true spectrum policy violation. The proposed method is validated using real world data from the POWDER 5G testbed on devices transmitting 802.11a(Wi-Fi), 4G LTE, and 5G NR waveforms. The results show accuracy as high as 97% and as low as 73% after calibration depending on channel conditions. Also calibrating for various average false negatives upper bounds achieves micro recall scores of approximately (1 - calibrated false negatives) with the calibration robust to out-of-distribution interference, demonstrating the potential of the proposed method in a realistic high contention wireless environment

</details>


### [279] [PosteriorBench: From Point Estimates to Posterior Matching in Evaluating Generative Inverse Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20794)
*Jiachen Yao,Zi-Siang Hsu,Xi Deng,Aditi Gupta,Xin Ju,Sally M Benson,Gege Wen,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 PosteriorBench 基准，用于评估生成式逆问题求解器对整个后验分布的恢复精度，而非单点重建准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式逆问题评估多关注能否产生单一合理重建，这对稀疏/含噪观测下的病态逆问题不足：多解可能同时与观测一致，方法可能点估计准确却因模式坍塌、过度自信不确定性或对不相容解的混叠而未能刻画真实后验。

Method: 构建 PosteriorBench，涵盖四个物理逆问题（Darcy 流反演、Poisson 源恢复、碳捕集与封存、光传输材质推断）；对每个任务用拒绝采样、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛等高算力成熟方法构造高保真参考后验；配套五项后验评估指标：后验均值误差、后验标准差误差、最大均值差异(MMD)、切片 Wasserstein 距离、径向平均功率谱误差；统一 pipeline 覆盖稀疏传感、低分辨率观测、非线性前向模型、不同噪声水平及多峰先验。

Result: 实验揭示当前求解器存在显著分布匹配差距；神经算子提升分辨率鲁棒性；引导权重与生成噪声是后验方差校准的关键。

Conclusion: 分布级评估对病态逆问题必要，PosteriorBench 提供统一基准与方法学指标，可系统衡量求解器恢复完整解集及不确定性量化的能力。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly used to solve scientific inverse problems, but existing evaluations still focus primarily on whether a method can produce a single plausible reconstruction. This is insufficient for ill-posed problems, where multiple solutions may be consistent with the same sparse or noisy observations. In these settings, a method can achieve strong pointwise accuracy while still failing to capture the true posterior through mode collapse, overconfident uncertainty, or averaging incompatible solutions. We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for evaluating the distributional accuracy of generative inverse solvers. PosteriorBench evaluates four physics-based inverse problems: Darcy flow inversion, Poisson source recovery, carbon capture and storage, and light transport material inference. For each task, we construct high-fidelity reference posteriors using computationally heavy but established procedures such as rejection sampling and Markov chain Monte Carlo, enabling direct assessment of whether solvers recover the full set of solutions rather than the single best sample. We pair these references with a five-metric posterior evaluation suite: posterior-mean error, posterior-standard-deviation error, maximum mean discrepancy, sliced Wasserstein distance, and radially averaged power-spectrum error. These metrics assess pointwise accuracy, marginal uncertainty, distributional alignment, and global frequency fidelity. The benchmark spans sparse sensing, low-resolution observations, nonlinear forward models, varying noise levels, and multimodal priors, with a unified pipeline for distribution matching and uncertainty quantification. Our experiments reveal substantial distribution-matching gaps across current solvers, while showing that neural operators improve resolution robustness, and guidance weights and generation noise are key to posterior-variance calibration.

</details>


### [280] [Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20807)
*Martin Marek,Max Ryabinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出大语言模型强化学习中的训练-推理不匹配（TIM）引发的稳定性问题主要源于训练与推理引擎间的持续偏差（drift），并提出加性"分数中心化"校正项以消除drift，从而稳定RL训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型强化学习对训练与推理引擎间的微小差异极为敏感，即训练-推理不匹配（TIM）。然而完全消除TIM并不现实，因为这会大幅牺牲rollout效率。因此需要一种在保留TIM的前提下稳定RL的方法。

Method: 作者分析表明，TIM下RL的不稳定性主要由drift引起——即训练与推理引擎之间随每步训练累积的持续偏差。为此推导出一个加性的"分数中心化"（score centering）校正项，通过抵消drift来稳定RL。此外，由于该校正为加性，可与重要性采样（importance sampling）组合使用。

Result: 在0.6B至30B参数模型上训练时，分数中心化单独使用即可匹配或超越量化条件下基于重要性采样的方法，且不匹配越严重，优势越明显。在staleness（陈旧度）实验中，分数中心化与重要性采样的组合优于纯重要性采样基线。

Conclusion: TIM下RL的不稳定性主要归因于drift，而加性分数中心化校正能有效抵消drift、稳定训练，且兼容重要性采样，在多种规模和失配情境下表现优异，是一种实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models is notoriously sensitive to small differences between training and inference engines, often referred to as the training-inference mismatch (TIM). However, completely eliminating TIM is impractical, as it would come at a major cost to rollout efficiency. In this paper, we show that the instability of RL under TIM is primarily caused by drift: a persistent bias between training and inference engines that accumulates with every training step. We derive an additive "score centering" correction term that stabilizes RL under TIM by canceling drift. When training models from 0.6B to 30B parameters, score centering alone matches or outperforms methods based on importance sampling under quantization, with the gap growing as the mismatch becomes more severe. Because the correction is additive, score centering also composes with importance sampling -- their composition outperforms pure importance-sampling baselines in our staleness experiments.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

### [281] [A Mathematical Model of Motivated Emotional Mind - Cognitive Embodied System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20437)
*Wiesław L. Galus,Janusz A. Starzyk*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文对“动机性情绪心智”认知架构进行数学形式化，核心是刻画前馈、侧向与反馈构成的重入回路，以及semblions（联想记忆结构）的表征竞争与选择机制，服务于具身智能系统的稳态维持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为具身智能系统建立可严格分析的认知架构形式化，弥补标准强化学习在需求阈值、目标生成与转换、身体状态、资源约束和动作不确定性等方面的不足，使动机性学习更贴合由需求、情感与调控状态塑造的动力学。

Method: 以广义强化学习为基础构建“动机性学习”数学模型：将外感受与内感受信号、身体-动机情境及记忆痕迹绑定为semblions，建模其在进一步加工与自上而下重构中的竞争；整合次级知觉、表征竞争、好奇心、程序性缺口与动作选择，以limiting allostatic violations为导向，并引入全局情感作为调制学习率、表征效价及探索-利用平衡的中心控制信号。

Result: 给出了重入回路（前馈处理、侧向交互、反馈通路）与表征选择机制的严谨形式化，明确了semblions的绑定与竞争流程；相较标准强化学习，模型显式纳入需求阈值、目标生成与目标切换、身体状态、资源约束与动作不确定性，从而更充分地解释调控压力下的反应选择，并将全局情感置于核心调控地位。

Conclusion: 该模型是认知现象更严谨形式化的一步，可作为后续理论分析、计算机仿真以及受生物过程启发的人工智能系统实现的基础。

Abstract: This article presents a mathematical model of the Motivated Emotional Mind cognitive architecture developed for embodied intelligent systems. Such a system learns to maintain its homeostasis through a generalized form of reinforcement learning based on its internal motivations, termed motivated learning (ML). The principal contribution of this article is a rigorous formalization of the re-entrant loop integrating feedforward processing, lateral interactions, and feedback pathways, together with the representational selection mechanisms that govern adaptive system responses. The model specifies how ongoing exteroceptive and interoceptive signals, bodily-motivational context, and memory traces are bound into associative memory structures termed semblions, which compete for access to further processing and top-down reconstruction. The formalization encompasses secondary perception, representational competition, curiosity, procedural gaps, and action selection directed toward limiting allostatic violations. Within this framework, motivated learning is tailored to embodied systems whose dynamics are shaped by needs, affect, and the current regulatory state. Unlike standard reinforcement-learning models, the proposed approach incorporates need thresholds, goal generation and shifting goals, bodily state, resource constraints, and action uncertainty, thereby providing a more adequate account of response selection under regulatory pressure. Global affect functions as a central control signal, modulating the learning rate, representational valence, and the balance between exploration and exploitation. The model presented here is a step toward a more rigorous formalization of cognitive phenomena and may provide a basis for further theoretical analysis, computer simulation, and implementation in artificial-intelligence systems inspired by biological processes.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [282] [AthenaZero: A low-inertia, bimanual robot for dynamic manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19194)
*Andrew S. Morgan,Gregory Xie,Capprin Bass,Rachel Thomasson,Chunpeng Wang,Erfan Shahriari,Harrison Busa,Oluwaseun Araromi,Joseph Aronov,Michael Burgess,Velin D. Dimitrov,Matthew A. Estrada,Faris Hamdi,Samuel Kendig,Taeyoon Lee,Jose Oscar Mur-Miranda,Emma Sommers,Paul Titchener,Margaret Wang,Achu Wilson,Mark Yeatman,Osman Dogan Yirmibesoglu,Alfred A. Rizzi,Annan Mozeika,Nicolas Rojas,Lael Odhner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出双臂机器人平台 AthenaZero，通过准直驱驱动与传动远程化降低惯量，实现接近人类的末端等效质量，并在棒球式投掷、接球与击球任务中验证其高速动态操作能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器人操作臂惯量大、力矩透明性差，难以在毫秒级时间尺度上完成高加速度的动态交互任务。作者希望在不牺牲控制权限（control authority）的前提下最小化惯量，使机器人具备接近人类的动态操作能力。

Method: 采用准直驱驱动（quasi-direct drive actuation）与传动远程化（transmission remotization）技术构建双臂机械手，以降低末端等效质量；并结合系统固有的力矩透明性，面向动态操作进行设计。文中给出了该设计的方法论，并通过棒球式任务进行能力验证。

Result: AthenaZero 的末端等效质量约为人类的量级，比传统机械臂低约一个数量级；投掷速度超过 30 m/s，在 7.3 m 短距离内接球与击球速度超过 14 m/s。随后完成了机器人-机器人与人类-机器人两种形式的击球练习与接球对练。

Conclusion: AthenaZero 在需要高加速度、毫秒级时间敏感的任务中展现出有效性与适应性，证明低惯量、高力矩透明性的双臂设计适用于高速动态操作。

Abstract: AthenaZero is a bimanual manipulator designed to minimize inertia without compromising control authority. By utilizing quasi-direct drive actuation and transmission remotization techniques, the system achieves an effective endpoint mass comparable to that of a human---about an order of magnitude less than conventional robot manipulators. This characteristic, combined with its inherent torque transparency, makes AthenaZero exceptionally well-suited for dynamic manipulation. We describe the methodology} that led to this design and demonstrate the robot's capabilities on three baseball-inspired tasks: throwing, catching, and batting, which showcase complex interactions on human-comparable timescales where milliseconds matter. AthenaZero was capable of throwing at speeds in excess of 30 m/s, with catching and batting at speeds in excess of 14 m/s over a short 7.3 m distance. Batting practice and a game of catch were subsequently performed in robot-to-robot and human-to-robot variations, showcasing the efficacy and adaptability of our system in tasks that require high acceleration.

</details>


### [283] [DITTO: Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19196)
*Joaquin Palacios,Katelyn Lee,Cheng Zhang,Zhanpeng He,Matei Ciocarlie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DITTO 通过解剖学驱动的灵巧 7-DOF 机械手与运动学等价的电动外骨骼协同设计，在单一平台上统一了野外手持数据采集与带关节级力反馈的双边遥操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高自由度灵巧手的操作数据采集困难：接口既要捕捉丰富的手部运动，又要呈现精细操作所需的接触交互。现有方案存在两难——遥操作保证部署一致性但缺乏力反馈；手持/野外系统具备自然力透明性，却在部署时引入视觉具身差异。

Method: 提出 DITTO（Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation），基于解剖学信息对 7-DOF 灵巧机械手与运动学等价的电动外骨骼进行协同设计；外骨骼与机械手之间采用 1:1 执行器映射，从而在同一平台中统一手持（野外）数据采集与关节级力反馈的双边遥操作。

Result: 实验表明 DITTO 外骨骼可覆盖操作者食指到拇指的自然工作空间，并通过在接触密集型任务上学习到的策略展示了其灵巧操作能力。

Conclusion: 运动学等价的外骨骼—机械手协同设计可同时兼顾部署一致性与力透明性，为高自由度灵巧操作的数据采集提供统一方案。

Abstract: Collecting data for manipulation with high-DOF hands is challenging, as interfaces must capture rich hand motion while rendering the contact interactions essential for precise manipulation. Existing data collection approaches face a trade-off: teleoperation ensures deployment consistency but lacks force feedback, while handheld (in-the-wild) systems provide natural force transparency but introduce a visual embodiment gap at deployment. We present DITTO, a Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation, which resolves this through the anatomically informed co-design of a dexterous 7-DOF robotic hand and a kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton. A 1-to-1 actuator mapping between the exoskeleton and robotic hand enables handheld (in-the-wild) data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback unified in a single platform. We demonstrate that the DITTO exoskeleton spans the operator's natural index-to-thumb workspace, and showcase DITTO's dexterous capabilities via learned policies on contact-rich tasks.

</details>


### [284] [ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19200)
*Masato Kobayashi,Takeru Tsunoori*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ULOHA：面向水下双臂模仿学习的软硬件一体平台，将定制主从式硬件与LeRobot扩展结合，实现遥操作、多视角感知、数据采集、策略训练与自主部署，并系统评测ACT、Diffusion Policy与SmolVLA在水下扰动环境中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下视觉运动策略学习多局限于单机械臂，双臂模仿学习则主要在空气中研究，缺乏面向水下双臂操作的统一实验平台，以及空气环境下学习方法/执行策略在水下耦合感知与物理效应（气泡扰动、浮力驱动运动）中是否适用的系统评估。

Method: 构建ULOHA平台：定制主从式（leader–follower）硬件 + LeRobot软件扩展，集成遥操作、多视角传感、示教采集、策略训练与自主部署。在真机上采集协调双臂行为（臂间传递、共享物体操作、浮力驱动拦截）数据，评测ACT、Diffusion Policy与VLA模型SmolVLA，并分析气泡扰动、浮力驱动物体运动、动作执行时域（execution horizon）与实时分块（real-time chunking）。另设单臂实验，考察空气与水中之间的策略迁移，比较跨介质示教对双介质执行的支持。

Result: 真机实验实现了多类协调水下双臂行为（臂间传递、共享物体操作、浮力驱动拦截）；在平台完成对ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA的对比评测，并揭示气泡扰动、浮力驱动运动、执行时域与实时分块对策略性能的影响。单臂研究表明，在测试条件下，同时覆盖空气与水的示教数据可支持两种介质中的执行。

Conclusion: ULOHA为研究水下双臂机器人学习提供了统一实验平台，可在感知与物理效应耦合的水下环境中系统考察模仿学习方法和执行策略；跨介质示教具备支持空气与水下执行的可行性。

Abstract: Underwater visuomotor policy learning has focused primarily on single manipulators, while bimanual imitation learning has been studied largely in air. We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform. We investigate how learning methods and execution strategies developed for manipulation in air perform underwater, examining bubble disturbances, buoyancy-driven object motion, action-execution horizons, and real-time chunking. A separate single-arm study examines policy transfer between air and water and shows that demonstrations spanning both media support execution in both under the tested conditions. ULOHA provides a unified experimental platform for studying underwater bimanual robot learning under the coupled perceptual and physical effects of underwater environments. Additional material: https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/

</details>


### [285] [REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19204)
*Geoffroy Keime,Nicolas Cuperlier,Benoit R. Cottereau*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出REACT——一种完全脉冲化的状态空间模型,逐事件处理原始事件流,无需时间累积,在TTC估计上以4.6 ms端到端延迟达到9.59%相对误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中的机器人视觉感知需要随传感流持续演化,而事件相机虽具备微秒级时间分辨率与异步感知能力,但多数学习方法把事件累积成帧或时间bin,引入积分延迟,限制了快速反应能力。

Method: REACT是面向事件驱动时间感知的完全脉冲状态空间模型,逐个处理原始事件、不做时间累积。核心是复数脉冲神经元C-SiLIF,由物理事件间隔驱动其连续时间动力学,使内部状态以单事件时间分辨率演化。在手势识别与TTC估计(全视场事件流、无目标框/定位先验)上评估。

Result: EvTTC上相对TTC误差9.59%,端到端延迟4.6 ms,距最优学习方法仅0.15个百分点且无需目标先验;该延迟对应车辆仅4 cm位移,而最快竞争方法为1 m。支持anytime TTC预测、跨驾驶序列零样本迁移和INT8量化,能耗由18.5 mJ降至2.8 mJ/32,768事件。

Conclusion: 事件驱动的脉冲状态空间动力学可为反应式机器人系统提供低延迟、持续更新的时间感知。

Abstract: Robotic systems operating in dynamic environments require visual perception that evolves continuously with the incoming sensory stream. Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, but most learning-based methods accumulate events into frames or temporal bins, introducing an integration delay that can limit fast reaction. Here we propose REACT, a fully spiking state-space model for event-driven temporal perception that processes raw events one by one, without temporal accumulation. REACT uses a complex-valued spiking neuron, C-SiLIF, whose continuous-time dynamics are driven by the physical inter-event interval, allowing its internal state to evolve at the temporal resolution of individual events. We evaluate REACT on gesture recognition and time-to-collision (TTC) estimation from full-field event streams, without a target bounding box or localization input. On EvTTC, REACT achieves a 9.59% relative TTC error with 4.6 ms end-to-end inference latency, within 0.15 percentage points of the best learned method while requiring no target prior. At the dataset's mean approach speed, this latency corresponds to only 4 cm of vehicle motion, compared with 1 m for the fastest competing learned method. REACT further supports anytime TTC prediction, zero-shot transfer to a different driving sequence, and INT8 quantization, reducing the estimated energy consumption from 18.5 to 2.8 mJ per 32,768 events. These results show that event-driven spiking state-space dynamics can provide low-latency, continuously updated temporal perception for reactive robotic systems.

</details>


### [286] [4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19216)
*Xumin Wu,Jun Zhou,Jilin Mei,Chen Min,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文综述4D毫米波雷达感知算法，按感知任务与算法演进组织，涵盖从信号处理、目标检测到语义分割、运动估计、占据预测与动态场景重建，并比较纯雷达学习、多模态融合和跨模态监督/知识蒸馏，强调高程、多普勒与雷达物理先验的利用，总结数据集与评测协议，讨论挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D毫米波雷达感知研究近年快速发展，任务范围从信号处理和目标检测扩展到语义分割、运动估计、占据预测和动态场景重建，领域缺乏按感知任务演进的系统性梳理，需要一篇任务导向的综述来整合方法与数据集支撑。

Method: 采用任务导向的综述方法：先介绍雷达基础、数据表示与质量增强方法；再按目标级感知、运动与定位、局部与稠密空间感知、动态场景理解等方向组织文献；在各方向比较纯雷达学习、多模态融合、跨模态监督与知识蒸馏三类范式；并重点分析高程、多普勒测量和雷达物理先验在不同任务中的利用方式。

Result: 归纳了各研究方向的任务覆盖、输入数据、标注和评测协议，明确了不同研究方向的经验支撑；梳理了三类学习范式在各任务中的适用性与差异；总结了高程、多普勒和物理先验在跨任务中的具体作用。

Conclusion: 该综述提供了从稀疏目标感知到动态空间理解转变的任务导向视角，并指出4D雷达感知在自动驾驶中的共性挑战与未来方向。

Abstract: Research on 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms has flourished in recent years, extending from signal processing and object detection to semantic segmentation, motion estimation, occupancy prediction, and dynamic scene reconstruction. This review organizes the field according to the evolution of perception tasks and algorithms. It first introduces radar fundamentals, data representations, and quality-enhancement methods, and then reviews object-level perception, motion and localization, local and dense spatial perception, and dynamic scene understanding. Across these directions, we compare radar-only learning, multimodal fusion, and cross-modal supervision and knowledge distillation. Particular attention is paid to how elevation, Doppler measurements, and radar physical priors are exploited across tasks. We further summarize the task coverage, input data, annotations, and evaluation protocols of existing datasets, clarifying the empirical support for different research directions. Finally, we discuss the common challenges and future directions of 4D radar perception for autonomous driving. This review provides a task-oriented perspective on the transition from sparse object perception to dynamic spatial understanding.

</details>


### [287] [Grasping by interconnection: robust closing motions from coarse object templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19228)
*Julien Vanderheyden,Guillaume Drion,Fulvio Forni,Pierre Sacré*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于虚拟模型控制的抓取运动规划器，使闭合运动本身具备鲁棒性，在不依赖反馈的情况下容忍约1cm尺寸误差及数厘米、数十度的位姿误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧手抓取时物体形状、尺寸和位姿往往只能粗略已知，现有抓取规划器通常依赖精确物体模型或依靠反馈纠错，而闭合运动自身能容忍多大不准确性尚不明确。论文旨在探究并证明鲁棒性可被设计进闭合运动本身，而非仅依赖反馈。

Method: 运动规划器基于四个原则设计：物体的粗略模板、人类抓取类型、以物体为中心的交互，以及采用顺应性滑动接触而非预设接触点；并通过虚拟模型控制实现，在Shadow Dexterous Hand上进行评估。

Result: 无反馈条件下，规划的闭合运动可容忍约1cm的尺寸误差及数厘米、数十度的位姿误差；在27个测试条件中的25个条件下，容错范围优于当前最先进的数据驱动规划器；对80件日常物品抓取成功率达82.5%，并在自主流程中取得成功。

Conclusion: 鲁棒性可以被设计进闭合运动本身，而不必仅依赖反馈。该规划器为不确定环境下的可靠操作开辟了路径，未来将结合物理手上的自适应反馈控制进一步推进。

Abstract: Dexterous robot hands must often grasp objects whose shape, size, and pose are known only approximately. Grasp planners typically require accurate object models or correct errors with feedback, but how much inaccuracy a closing motion can tolerate on its own remains unclear. To address this question, we designed a motion planner based on four principles: a coarse template of the object, human grasp types, an object-centric interaction, and compliant, sliding contacts instead of prescribed contact points. This paper presents the planner, implemented through virtual model control, and its evaluation on a Shadow Dexterous Hand. Without feedback, the planned closing motions tolerated size errors of about 1cm and pose errors of several centimeters and tens of degrees, a wider range than a state-of-the-art data-driven planner in 25 of 27 tested conditions. They also grasped 82.5% of 80 everyday objects and succeeded within an autonomous pipeline. Robustness can thus be designed into the closing motion itself, rather than left only to feedback. This planner opens a path toward reliable manipulation in uncertain settings, which we will pursue by combining it with adaptive feedback control on the physical hand.

</details>


### [288] [Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19272)
*William D. Compton,Zachary Olkin,Ryan Bena,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 RoM-Nav，将人形机器人导航问题分解为降阶动力学导航策略与全阶动力学策略两阶段训练，结合泊松安全滤波，在 Unitree G1 上实现无地图多层导航，垂直位移超 10m、路径超 100m。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单阶段强化学习导航流水线难以扩展到多层级、多楼层地形，主要瓶颈在于人形机器人复杂地形交互（如上下楼梯）的学习难度大。

Method: 将导航问题分解为两部分：先用降阶动力学模型配合完整 3D LiDAR 观测训练导航策略；再用该导航知识引导全阶人形动力学策略的训练，并在回路中冻结运动（locomotion）策略；同时对导航策略输出施加泊松安全滤波器。

Result: 泊松安全滤波器在分布外障碍物情形下恢复安全性，且不降低导航成功率；在 Unitree G1 上完成无地图多楼层导航，测试涵盖超 10m 垂直位移与超 100m 路径长度。

Conclusion: 分阶段利用降阶动力学先验知识可有效提升人形机器人复杂多层地形导航的可扩展性，配合安全滤波兼顾安全性与成功率。

Abstract: Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length. Project page with videos https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ .

</details>


### [289] [OHRID-Retail: An Open Multimodal Dataset of Human Activity in Retail Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19302)
*Xiangrui Wang,Yuetong Wu,Jalen Beeman,Robert Cook,Yu Gu,Nathanial Pearson,Trevor Smith,Read Hayes,Boyi Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文发布OHRID Retail数据集，采集16名健康成人在三种机器人交互条件下完成货架拣选任务的多模态数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 描述人类在共享环境中行为的数据集有限，尤其是涉及移动机器人、结合移动、伸取、物体操作与机器人引导的零售场景数据稀缺。

Method: 16名健康成人在无机器人、低速机器人引导、高速机器人引导三种被试内条件下进行模拟货架拣选任务，每条件2次试验；用17个Xsens Awinda惯性传感器记录全身运动学，用Delsys Trigno表面肌电在10个位置测量肌肉活动。

Result: 描述性分析显示，不同机器人交互条件和身体部位的全身运动强度与肌肉激活存在差异；同时公开原始记录、处理后指标、文档与可复现分析资源。

Conclusion: OHRID Retail可支持人类活动识别、多模态传感器融合、职业生物力学、人体工程学、人感知机器人导航及人机交互等研究。

Abstract: Open datasets describing human behavior in environments shared with mobile robots remain limited, particularly for retail activities that combine locomotion, reaching, object handling, and robot guided movement. This paper introduces OHRID Retail, an open, human centered multimodal dataset collected from 16 healthy adults performing a simulated shelf picking task under three within participant conditions: no robot, low speed robot guidance, and high speed robot guidance. Each participant completed two trials per condition. Whole body kinematics were recorded using 17 Xsens Awinda inertial sensors and muscle activity was measured at 10 locations using Delsys Trigno surface electromyography sensors. Descriptive analyses demonstrate variation in whole body movement intensity and muscle activation across robot interaction conditions and body locations. OHRID Retail provides openly available raw recordings, processed measures, documentation, and reproducible analysis resources. The dataset can support research in human activity recognition, multimodal sensor fusion, occupational biomechanics, ergonomics, human aware robot navigation, and human robot interaction in retail and related shared environments.

</details>


### [290] [GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19315)
*Ruiyang Wang,Hao-Lun Hsu,Swarajh Mehta,Jiwoo Kim,Zhihao Dou,Miroslav Pajic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GAVEL：基于显式图世界模型的LLM长时程规划验证与修复框架，在BEHAVIOR-1K上显著提升单任务与多任务成功率并降低搜索代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽提供灵活的长时程机器人规划接口，但生成计划常违背具身约束、难以从规划错误中恢复，且在部分可观测条件下推理能力不足。

Method: 构建显式图世界模型，编码物体关系、动作前置条件与效果、以及对未观测物体位置的概率信念；在执行前预测LLM动作后果、检测违规并修复可直接由世界模型推导的错误；仅在需要语义推理时调用LLM重新规划；对多任务指令，基于物体位置分布重排剩余子任务以最小化期望搜索成本。在BEHAVIOR-1K上评测100个单任务与500个多任务指令，使用Qwen3-8B等模型。

Result: 使用Qwen3-8B时，单任务成功率从41.2%提升至91.8%，多任务成功率从19.9%提升至92.6%；分布式信念推理相较静态变体减少约5.4%的移动距离。

Conclusion: 显式图世界模型外壳可显著提升长时程具身规划的可靠性与效率，适用于紧凑型及前沿托管LLM能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.

</details>


### [291] [A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19328)
*Eri Sawada,Kazuki Sugihara,Ayano Miyamichi,Kunio Kojima,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种"变形旋翼分布式空中机器人"，采用柔性连续体连杆（兼具软体操作臂功能）并在连杆上分布推进器，同时实现高形状适应性与扩展的可行力旋量空间，并通过复合板簧结构与抑振控制实现稳定飞行与多样空中操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中操作是拓展空中机器人应用的关键。实现多功能空中操作有两大方向：(i) 用软体操作臂获得高环境适应性；(ii) 沿操作臂分布推进器以扩展可行力旋量空间。但此前没有空中机器人能同时满足这两项要求。

Method: 提出带柔性连续体连杆的变形旋翼分布式空中机器人。柔性连续体连杆作为软体操作臂，被动顺应环境形状；沿连杆分布的推进器扩展可行推力旋量空间，使末端执行器能施加较大交互力。为抑制轻质连续体连杆的振动，开发了兼具高扭转与垂直刚度的复合板簧结构，以及抑振控制方法。

Result: 借助上述实现，展示了稳定飞行以及多种空中操作任务。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个使用集成推进器的柔性连杆实现空中操作的工作，同时满足形状适应性与扩展力旋量空间两项需求。

Abstract: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a morphing rotor-distributed aerial robot with flexible continuum links that achieves both high shape adaptability and an expanded wrench space. The flexible continuum links function as soft manipulators, passively conforming to the shape of the environment, while the thrusters distributed along the continuum links expand the feasible thrust wrench space and enable the end-effector to exert large interaction forces. To realize the proposed robot, it is essential to suppress vibrations of the lightweight continuum links. Thus, we develop a composite leaf-spring structure that provides both high torsional and vertical stiffness, and vibration-suppressing control methods. Using these implementations, we demonstrate stable flight and a variety of aerial manipulation tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to realize aerial manipulations using flexible links with an integrated thruster.

</details>


### [292] [SemSafe-3DGS: Semantic Risk-Aware Active Navigation in Uncertain 3D Gaussian Splatting Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19330)
*Amirhossein Mollaei Khass,Athanasios Cosse,Nader Motee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种语义风险感知的安全主动感知框架，在属性化3D高斯地图中实现导航，通过类别风险权重调制AVaR碰撞间隙模型并构建CBF-QP统一约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全方法主要基于几何推理，几何相似但语义后果不同的场景元素会产生相近的控制响应，无法体现语义差异对安全的影响。

Method: 在属性化3D高斯地图中，用语义属性通过类别相关风险权重调制Average Value-at-Risk（AVaR）碰撞间隙模型，使安全关键高斯基元在复合障碍函数中权重更大；加权间隙聚合为控制障碍函数（CBF），并引入轨迹相关的主动感知障碍项以降低机器人预期运动方向上的几何地图不确定性；二者统一集成于CBF-QP，将语义风险感知避碰作为硬约束，在信息获取与安全或任务进度冲突时放松信息采集项。

Result: 实验表明该方法实现了高效的安全约束，通过主动感知改善了导航表现，产生了语义相关的轨迹自适应，并在Ackermann动力学下完成了实机验证。

Conclusion: 将语义风险注入安全约束并用统一CBF-QP协调安全与主动感知，可在部分可观测环境中兼顾避碰安全性与感知信息增益。

Abstract: Autonomous robots operating in partially observed environments must navigate safely while acquiring observations that improve future planning. Existing safety formulations generally reason primarily about geometry. Consequently, geometrically similar scene elements may induce comparable control responses despite having different semantic consequences. We present a semantic risk aware safe-active perception framework for navigation in attributed 3D Gaussian maps. Semantic attributes modulate an Average Value-at-Risk collision clearance model through class dependent risk weights, allowing safety-critical Gaussian primitives to receive greater influence in the composite barrier. The resulting weighted clearances are aggregated into a control barrier function, while a trajectory-relevant active perception barrier promotes observations that reduce geometric map uncertainty along the robot's anticipated motion. Both objectives are integrated in a unified CBF-QP that enforces semantic risk-aware collision avoidance as a hard constraint while relaxing information acquisition when it conflicts with safety or task progress. Experiments demonstrate efficient safety constraint, improved navigation through active perception, semantic dependent trajectory adaptation, and real-robot execution under Ackermann dynamics.

</details>


### [293] [Dynamic-LIVO: A Dynamic-Aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry System Using Spatio-Temporal Normals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19336)
*Zhixin Zhang,Samuel Ahiwe,Matthew Hale,Liang Zhao,Pawel Ladosz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 Dynamic-LIVO，一种具备动态感知能力的 LiDAR-惯性-视觉里程计系统，用于动态环境下的鲁棒状态估计与静态彩色建图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中的移动物体会污染 LiDAR 与视觉观测，破坏状态估计精度并导致地图中出现动态残影，因此需要有效识别并剔除动态特征。

Method: 采用时空（Spatio-Temporal, S-T）法向分析识别动态 LiDAR 点，并将分类结果传播至 LiDAR-惯性更新与视觉-惯性更新，阻断动态观测对状态估计和建图的影响；针对新观测和空间稀疏区域中 S-T 法向估计不可靠的问题，引入时间延迟 S-T 法向估计策略，延迟对约束不足点的分类，在获得更多观测后重新评估。

Result: 在多种传感器配置的公开数据集与自采数据集上的大量实验表明，Dynamic-LIVO 在挑战性动态环境中提升了定位精度，并生成了更干净的静态彩色地图。

Conclusion: Dynamic-LIVO 通过动态感知与时间延迟法向估计策略，实现了动态环境下鲁棒的状态估计与静态彩色建图，源码与自采数据集将在论文录用后公开。

Abstract: This paper proposes Dynamic-LIVO, a dynamic-aware LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry (LIVO) system for robust state estimation and static colored mapping in dynamic environments. Dynamic-LIVO employs Spatio-Temporal (S-T) normal analysis to identify dynamic LiDAR points and propagates the resulting classification to both LiDAR-inertial and visual-inertial updates, preventing dynamic LiDAR measurements and their associated visual observations from affecting state estimation and mapping. However, S-T normal estimation can be unreliable in newly observed and spatially sparse regions due to insufficient spatio-temporal observations. To address this issue, we introduce a time-delayed S-T normal estimation strategy that defers the classification of insufficiently constrained points and re-evaluates them as additional observations become available. This strategy improves dynamic classification reliability while preserving valid static points for map construction. Extensive experiments on public and self-collected datasets with diverse sensor configurations demonstrate that Dynamic-LIVO improves localization accuracy and produces cleaner static colored maps in challenging dynamic environments. The source code and self-collected dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [294] [ViLoMan: Learning Visual-Proprioceptive Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation Skills for Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19340)
*Zejie Tian,Ruibing Hou,Bingpeng Ma,Börje F. Karlsson,Shiguang Shan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ViLoMan：将部分人体-物体交互演示转化为物理可执行的人形机器人轨迹，并通过教师-学生蒸馏学习统一全身控制策略，仅凭机载深度与本体感知完成自主移动操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人移动操作需全身协调地整合运动与物理交互。当前自主移动操作学习面临两大瓶颈：缺乏多样且物理可执行的机器人-物体交互数据；难以直接从机载观测学习统一的全身控制。

Method: 1) 将人体-物体交互的部分运动学演示转化为完整、物理可执行的机器人体轨迹（数据生成/轨迹重定向）；2) 在这些轨迹上采用教师-学生蒸馏框架，学习将自我中心深度观测与本体感知直接映射到关节级全身动作的统一策略；部署时无需参考运动或中间指令。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界中，针对多种门配置和机器人初始条件评估关门任务。单一策略使 Unitree G1 人形机器人仅依赖机载深度感知与本体感知完成完整任务，并能稳健泛化到任务变化，实现有效的仿真到现实迁移。

Conclusion: 该工作提出可扩展的自主人形移动操作框架，验证了以轨迹生成加蒸馏方式获取统一全身策略的可行性，实现了无需外部参考与中间命令的端到端机载感知-控制。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires adaptive whole-body coordination to seamlessly integrate locomotion and physical interaction. Despite recent advances, learning autonomous loco-manipulation remains challenging due to the scarcity of diverse, physically executable robot-object interaction data and the difficulty of learning unified whole-body control directly from onboard observations. We present ViLoMan, a scalable framework for autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation. ViLoMan first transforms partial kinematic demonstrations of human-object interactions into complete, physically executable robot trajectories. It then leverages these trajectories within a teacher-student distillation framework to learn a unified policy that maps egocentric depth observations and proprioceptive measurements directly to joint-level whole-body actions. During deployment, the policy requires neither reference motions nor intermediate commands. We evaluate ViLoMan on door-closing tasks across diverse door configurations and robot initial conditions in both simulation and the real world. Experimental results demonstrate that a single policy enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to complete the full task using only onboard depth sensing and proprioception, while generalizing robustly across task variations and transferring effectively from simulation to reality. Project page: viloman-anonymous.pages.dev.

</details>


### [295] [Kinematics-Grounded Agentic AI for Robotic Additive Manufacturing Process Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19347)
*Jingzhan Ge,Ruimin Chen,Azadeh Haghighi,Jiong Tang,Farhad Imani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 A-RAM——一种"智能体-专家-工具"框架，将用户意图与零件文件转化为可追溯、可直接执行的机器人增材制造规划，并在六轴机械臂 AM 单元上通过多案例验证其运动学与挤出性能优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人增材制造使挤出打印摆脱龙门运动学限制，但导致工艺规划依赖具体机器人：切片决策与零件朝向共同决定生成路径，而零件朝向与工作空间摆放又影响其运动学可实现性，在零件坐标系中看似有利的方案可能在机械臂上不可行或不优。现有 AM 工具、基于大模型的决策支持方法及数字孪生系统均缺乏对这些耦合决策的一体化执行前评估。

Method: A-RAM 采用智能体-专家-工具架构：LLM 负责解读制造目标与约束，识别规定变量与可搜索规划变量，并将推理编码为模式约束（schema-constrained）的请求；确定性规划智能体据此实例化相应搜索流程；领域工具则计算切片、摆放、逆运动学、轨迹时间、Joint-6 抖动与挤出等量化证据。

Result: 在六轴机械臂 AM 单元上开展三类案例研究，涵盖专家指定规划、仅目标规划、目标相关填充筛选以及几何相关朝向-摆放选择。在评估的候选集中，所选方案相比最不利的可行候选，最大 Joint-6 抖动降低达 53.5%，平均绝对 Joint-6 抖动降低 48.3%；目标特定填充筛选使运动规划完成时间最多缩短 40.1%，挤出路径最多缩短 12.7%。

Conclusion: A-RAM 通过将 LLM 的意图理解与确定性搜索流程和领域量化工具结合，实现了机器人增材制造中切片、摆放与运动学的耦合式执行前评估与可追溯规划，在抖动、时间与路径长度等指标上显著优于次优可行方案，验证了智能化、可执行规划框架的可行性。

Abstract: Robotic additive manufacturing (AM) extends material-extrusion printing beyond gantry kinematics but makes process planning robot-dependent. A slicer-generated plan that appears favorable in part coordinates can become infeasible or robotically unfavorable on a manipulator because slicer-process decisions and part orientation determine the generated path, while part orientation and workspace placement affect its kinematic realization. Existing AM tools, large language model (LLM)-based decision-support methods, and digital-shadow systems do not provide integrated pre-execution evaluation of these coupled decisions. This paper presents agentic robotic additive manufacturing (A-RAM), an agent-specialist-tool framework that converts user intent and a part file into traceable, execution-ready plans. The LLM interprets manufacturing objectives and constraints, identifies prescribed and searchable planning variables, and encodes this reasoning in a schema-constrained request; a deterministic Planning Agent instantiates the corresponding search workflow, while domain tools compute quantitative evidence for slicing, placement, inverse kinematics, trajectory timing, Joint-6 jerk, and extrusion. The framework is evaluated on a six-axis robotic-arm AM cell through three case studies covering expert-specified planning, goal-only planning, objective-dependent infill screening, and geometry-dependent orientation-placement selection. Across the evaluated candidate sets, selected plans achieve up to 53.5% lower maximum Joint-6 jerk and 48.3% lower mean absolute Joint-6 jerk than the least favorable valid candidates, while objective-specific infill screening yields motion-plan completion times up to 40.1% shorter and extrusion paths up to 12.7% shorter than the corresponding least favorable screened patterns.

</details>


### [296] [Design and Experimental Validation of a 3D Printed Torsional Series Elastic Actuator for Safe Human Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19367)
*Joel Hidalgo Pisco,Melissa Cobos Condo,Luigi Miranda,Dennys Paillacho*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文设计、仿真并实验验证了一种用于串联弹性驱动器（SEA）的低刚度3D打印TPU扭转弹簧（Ks=0.066 Nm/度），并提出带力矩阈值切换的混合位置控制器，实现安全的人机物理交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向社交与服务机器人，物理人机交互（pHRI）的本质安全是硬性要求。串联弹性驱动器虽提供基于硬件的柔顺性，但传统金属设计往往需要复杂的多零件装配，成本高、制造难度大，因此需要一种低成本、易制造且具备柔顺特性的弹性元件与配套控制方案。

Method: 以3D打印热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）为材料，设计并制造低刚度扭转弹簧，开展有限元分析（FEA）与实验验证；针对标准位置受限伺服电机，设计带力矩阈值切换的混合位置控制器，并进行非平稳轨迹跟踪与外部扰动顺从性实验。

Result: 弹簧呈现高度线性的力矩—变形响应（Ks=0.066 Nm/度），与数值预测偏差小于3%，偏差归因于FDM结构各向异性；系统能够准确跟踪非平稳轨迹并在外部扰动下安全顺从；TPU的固有材料阻尼起到被动低通滤波作用，抑制控制模式切换时的高频振荡。

Conclusion: 该架构为安全pHRI提供了一种低成本、可靠且易于制造的解决方案。

Abstract: Ensuring intrinsic safety in physical human robot interaction (pHRI) is a critical requirement for social and service robots. While Series Elastic Actuators (SEAs) offer hardware based compliance, traditional metallic designs often require complex, multi part assemblies. This paper presents the design, finite element analysis (FEA), and experimental validation of a low stiffness, torsional spring for SEAs, manufactured via 3D printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU). The compliant element exhibits a highly linear torque deformation response (Ks = 0.066 Nm/degree), matching numerical predictions with under 3% deviation, a variance attributed to FDM structural anisotropy. To accommodate external interactions using standard position limited servomotors, a hybrid position controller with torque threshold switching was implemented. Experimental evaluations demonstrate the system ability to accurately track non stationary trajectories and safely yield to external disturbances. Furthermore, the inherent material damping of the TPU acts as a passive low pass filter, preventing high frequency oscillations during control mode transitions. The proposed architecture offers a cost effective, reliable, and easily manufacturable solution for safe pHRI.

</details>


### [297] [Enhancing the Perception of Safety and Comfort during Physical Human-Robot Handshake Interactions by Integrating Flexible Elements into a Robotic Arm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19375)
*Joel Hidalgo,Dennys Paillacho,Melissa Cobos,Luigi Miranda*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究通过让10名志愿者分别与刚性关节和串联弹性驱动器（SEA）关节的机械臂握手，结合客观末端轨迹数据与主观感知问卷，评估SEA对物理交互安全性与社交接受度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机物理交互中的安全与舒适是社会技术发展的关键问题，而握手等自然手势因涉及直接物理接触而成为挑战。采用串联弹性驱动器（SEA）吸收冲击被视为有利于更安全交互的设计策略，但其对感知安全与交互体验的实际影响尚需实验验证。

Method: 设计刚性关节与SEA弹性关节的直接对比实验。10名志愿者（6男4女）分别与两种机械臂各完成一次握手交互；测试过程中采集末端执行器轨迹等客观数据，并通过聚焦安全性、自然度和信心的感知问卷收集主观信息。

Result: 问卷结果表明，装配SEA的机械臂在安全感和舒适度方面获得更高的主观评价，显示出其在提升人机交互物理安全与社交接受度方面的潜力。

Conclusion: 在机械臂中引入SEA能够改善握手交互中的感知安全与舒适度，支持其作为促进更安全、更易被社会接受的人机交互的设计策略。

Abstract: Safety and comfort in human-robot physical in-teractions are essential aspects in the development of social technologies, where natural gestures, such as handshakes, represent a challenge due to their direct physical contact. The implementation of series elastic actuators (SEA) to absorb impacts is proposed as a design strategy that favors safer interactions. This paper presents an experimental study aimed at evaluating how the incorporation of SEAs in robotic arms influences perceived safety and the interaction experience dur-ing handshaking. The design allows a direct comparison of the effect of rigidity versus the incorporation of elastic elements, in order to identify the advantages of SEAs in improving the physical safety and social acceptance of robotic systems in everyday contexts. The experiment was carried out with 10 volunteers (6 men and 4 women), who performed two interactions with each robotic arm: one with rigid joints and the other with flexible joints using SEA. During testing, objective data on end-effector trajectories were collected, as well as subjective information through a perception survey focused on safety, naturalness, and confidence during the handshake. The survey results show increased perceptions of safety and comfort with the SEA-equipped arm, supporting its potential to facilitate safer and more socially accepted human-robot interactions.

</details>


### [298] [Task-Oriented Active Learning of Residual Dynamics for Model Predictive Path Integral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19378)
*Nobuaki Aoki,Hojin Lee,Stefan Sosnowski,Sandra Hirche*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出面向任务的主动学习准则ToIA，用于MPPI控制中的在线高斯过程残差学习，通过估计早期观测对同一 rollout 后期状态预测不确定性的削减并加权任务相关性，在越野导航中显著提升成功率并保持20 Hz实时控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线残差学习可减小预测控制中的模型失配，但被动数据采集难以覆盖任务后期关键状态；任务无关主动学习虽探索不确定或信息量大的区域，但所获信息未必提升任务性能。因此需要一种面向任务、能在MPPI rollout 内评估信息价值的主动学习准则。

Method: ToIA在MPPI在线GP残差学习框架下，对每个采样的控制序列估计 rollout 早期观测对同一 rollout 后期状态预测不确定性的削减量，并以该 rollout 与任务的相关性加权。评分直接在现有MPPI rollout批次上评估，无需采样未来观测，也无需在假设后验更新下重新优化控制。

Result: 在异构地形的留出地图越野导航仿真中，ToIA相比被动GP学习将到达目标成功率提升19.3和27.4个百分点，并在密集与稀疏在线学习间隔下均优于任务无关主动学习基线。消融研究显示任务相关性在稀疏模型更新下尤为重要。实现可在NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti上以20 Hz进行在线控制。

Conclusion: ToIA为MPPI在线残差学习提供了一种计算高效、面向任务的主动信息采集准则，能在不增加未来观测采样与重优化开销的前提下提升任务成功率，尤其适用于稀疏更新场景，并满足实时控制需求。

Abstract: Online residual learning can reduce model mismatch in predictive control, but passive data collection may fail to adequately cover states that become important later in the task. Task-agnostic active learning targets uncertain or informative regions, but information acquired in such regions does not necessarily improve task performance. This paper introduces Task-Oriented Information Acquisition (ToIA), an active-learning criterion for model predictive path integral control (MPPI) with online Gaussian process (GP) residual learning. For each sampled control sequence, ToIA estimates how much an observation obtained early in the rollout would reduce predictive uncertainty at later states on the same rollout, and weights this reduction by the rollout's relevance to the task. The score is evaluated over the existing MPPI rollout batch without sampling future observations or re-optimizing control under hypothetical posterior updates. In simulated off-road navigation across held-out maps with heterogeneous terrain, ToIA improved the goal-reaching success rate over passive GP learning by 19.3 and 27.4 percentage points and outperformed task-agnostic active-learning baselines across dense and sparse online-learning intervals. An ablation study indicates that task relevance is particularly important under sparse model updates. The implementation supports online control at 20 Hz on an NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti.

</details>


### [299] [From Rollout to Reset: A Graph-Based Harness for Autonomous Long-Horizon Manipulation Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19413)
*Jing Jiang,Yue Yang,Xinkai Jiang,Gedas Bertasius,Daniel J. Szafir,Rudolf Lioutikov*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HALTER 是一个面向长时域机器人操作任务的自主评估与场景重置框架，通过在学习到的原子重置技能库上规划来恢复场景，并利用场景图与大模型完成评分、重置规划和重置验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人评估仍依赖人工重置场景，耗费操作时间且初始状态分布不明确，导致结果难以复现。现有自动化系统 AutoEval 仅适用于单步任务，因为长时域 rollout 的终止状态组合爆炸，单一学习重置策略无法覆盖。

Method: HALTER 将演示成本与原子重置技能库规模而非终止状态数量挂钩；在线从点云与视觉基础模型构建空间场景图，并由 LLM 在该图上推理，完成 rollout 评分、重置规划与重置成功验证，无需为任何任务采集带标注的成功图像。方法还支持组合泛化，并包含场景表示与图更新频率的消融。

Result: 在 Franka 机械臂的四项长时域任务上，HALTER 在 76% 的 episode 中成功恢复场景，AutoEval 为 52%，运动规划重置为 65%；完成技能比例估计正确率为 90%，对比 76%；重置验证判定正确率为 91%，对比 78%；相对人工重置将评估活动的操作时间减少 72%。在三项留出任务上，HALTER 重置成功率为 74.7%，而逐任务重置策略仅 1.3%。

Conclusion: HALTER 通过原子技能库规划与场景图—LLM 推理，实现了长时域机器人任务的可扩展自主评估与重置，显著优于现有自动化方案和逐任务策略，并大幅降低人工成本，同时展现出组合泛化能力。

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies are improving quickly, and real-robot evaluation remains the standard evidence for that progress. It still relies on a human to reset the scene between rollouts, which consumes operator time and leaves the initial state distribution unspecified, so results reproduce poorly. A recent system, AutoEval, automates both reset and scoring, but only for single-step tasks, because a long-horizon rollout can terminate in combinatorially many configurations that no single learned reset policy covers. We present HALTER, a Harness for Autonomous Long-horizon Task Evaluation and Reset, which restores the scene by planning over a library of learned atomic reset skills, so demonstration cost scales with the size of that library rather than with the number of terminal states. HALTER builds a spatial scene graph online from point clouds and vision foundation models, and an LLM reasons over this graph to score the rollout, plan the reset, and verify that the reset succeeded, without collecting labeled success images for any task. On four long-horizon tasks on a Franka arm, HALTER restores the scene in 76% of episodes, against 52% for AutoEval and 65% for a motion-planning reset, and it estimates the completed-skill fraction correctly in 90% of episodes, against 76%. Its reset-verification verdict is correct in 91% of episodes, compared with 78% for AutoEval. It also cuts the operator time of an evaluation campaign by 72% relative to manual reset. We further measure compositional generalization on three held-out tasks, where HALTER resets 74.7% of episodes against 1.3% for a per-task reset policy, and we ablate the scene representation and the graph update rate.

</details>


### [300] [Predict Before You Deploy: Offline Prediction of Quantization-Induced Task Degradation for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19441)
*Jiuyi Xu,Jinjia Guo,Meida Chen,Jing Du,Yangming Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PreDE框架，通过离线动作偏差预测量化导致的WAM任务性能退化，实现量化配置的提前筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型依赖视频生成骨干，部署时内存与计算开销大；训练后量化可降低内存并加速推理，但位宽、分组、量化器构成庞大配置空间，穷举闭环评估以找到保性能配置代价高昂。

Method: PreDE基于离线动作偏差预测量化引起的任务退化。利用小规模开发集的闭环结果标定两个阈值，在设定内标签序假设下，用固定观测日志对新配置给出接受、拒绝或延迟决策（在所有与开发标签一致的阈值取值均同意时才决策）。

Result: 跨5个WAM、4个基准设定，量化损失依赖配置，无法仅由位宽或统一偏差阈值解释。两个策略的28个留出配置中，PreDE在观测闭环结果前给出21个决策（75%覆盖率），全部与真实标签一致；延迟项同时包含可接受结果与33个百分点损失。450次Franka Research 3试次中，高偏差组配置均显著退化，低偏差组无显著退化。实机上W4A4取得1.37倍动作查询加速、峰值内存降约44%。

Conclusion: 支持采用策略特定的行为标定进行量化配置选择，并识别需要闭环评估的候选配置。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) rely on video-generation backbones, requiring substantial memory and compute for deployment. Post-training quantization reduces memory and can accelerate inference, but bit width, grouping, and quantizer choice define a large configuration space. Identifying configurations that preserve task performance through exhaustive closed-loop evaluation is costly. We propose PreDE (Predict Before You Deploy), a policy-calibrated framework for predicting quantization-induced task degradation from offline action deviations. Using closed-loop outcomes from a small development set, PreDE calibrates two thresholds and accepts, rejects, or defers new configurations using a fixed observation log. Under a within-setting label-ordering hypothesis, the rule issues decisions where all thresholds consistent with the development labels agree. Across five WAMs and four benchmark settings, quantization produces configuration-dependent task losses that cannot be explained by bit width alone or a shared deviation threshold. Across 28 held-out configurations from two policies, PreDE issued 21 decisions before observing closed-loop outcomes (75% coverage), all matching the observed acceptable or degraded labels. Deferred candidates included both acceptable outcomes and a 33-percentage-point loss. In 450 Franka Research 3 trials across two independently fine-tuned policies, all configurations assigned to high-deviation groups before testing showed significant degradation, while low-deviation comparisons showed no statistically significant degradation. On the real robot, W4A4 achieved a 1.37x action-query speedup and approximately 44% lower peak memory. These results support policy-specific behavioral calibration for quantization configuration selection while identifying candidates that require closed-loop evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/PreDE.

</details>


### [301] [From Wizard-of-Oz Human-Robot Dialogue Collection to a Taxonomy of Robot Response Decisions: A Retrospective Analysis of Assistive Pilot Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19447)
*Guangping Liu,Nicholas Hawkins,Tipu Sultan,Flavio Esposito,Madi Dian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 通过回顾性分析一项Wizard-of-Oz试点研究，本文提出了一套用于机器人在不完整自然语言指令下进行交互决策的分层分类体系，并验证了其标注一致性及用于训练视觉语言模型的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常室内环境中，人类指令常省略关键信息（如视野外物体身份、目标地点或用户意图）。现有数据集缺乏真实情境对话，也缺少基于实践的准则来判断机器人何时应采取行动、确认、澄清或拒绝，导致机器人在面对不完整话语时决策不一致。

Method: 回顾性分析一项Wizard-of-Oz试点研究：五名参与者在轮椅安装的移动机械臂上执行开门、开抽屉、喂食、饮水、清洁等室内任务，操作者无正式沟通策略地作出响应。基于40个episode，归纳出六种响应模式（ANSWER、REPORT_DONE、REFUSE、CONFIRM、CLARIFY、ACT）和四类歧义（意图、指代、空间、可理解性）的分层分类体系。由两名人类标注者和一名AI标注者将分类体系应用于试点数据，并微调LLaVA-1.6-7B模型。

Result: 干净标签率分别为91%和89%；在决策点、响应模式及歧义层级上，Cohen's kappa在人类-人类与人类-AI比较中均处于0.72至0.95之间。基于分类体系标签对LLaVA-1.6-7B进行微调，在ACT和CLARIFY任务上表明使用该分类体系标注训练视觉语言模型具有可行性。

Conclusion: 该分类体系能够支持一致的人类与AI标注，并可有效用于训练视觉语言模型。决策点识别和REPORT_DONE中的边界案例问题，提示需要建立受限协议以实现更一致的对话数据采集。

Abstract: Robots that follow natural-language instructions in everyday indoor environments must act on incomplete human utterances. Instructions often omit essential information, such as the identity of an out-of-view object, an intended destination, or the user's goal. Existing datasets contain little real-world situated dialogue and provide few practice-grounded criteria for deciding when a robot should act, confirm, clarify, or refuse. We retrospectively analyze a pilot Wizard-of-Oz study in which five participants performed everyday indoor tasks, including door opening, drawer opening, feeding, drinking, and cleaning, with a wheelchair-mounted mobile manipulator while the wizard responded without a formal communication policy. This preserved authentic user behavior but produced inconsistent robot-side decisions, motivating an explicit decision scheme. From 40 episodes, we derived a hierarchical taxonomy of six response modes (ANSWER, REPORT_DONE, REFUSE, CONFIRM, CLARIFY, ACT) and four ambiguity types (intent, referential, spatial, intelligibility). Two human annotators and an AI annotator applied the scheme to the pilot data. Clean-label rates were 91% and 89%, and Cohen's ranged from 0.72 to 0.95 across decision-point, mode, and ambiguity levels for both human-human and human-AI comparisons. Fine-tuning LLaVA-1.6-7B on taxonomy-derived labels for ACT and CLARIFY indicates the feasibility of training vision-language models using annotations from our taxonomy. Remaining boundary cases in decision-point identification and REPORT_DONE motivate a constrained protocol for more consistent dialogue collection.

</details>


### [302] [Winning a Won Game: Strict Reach-Avoid-Stay Control Barrier Functions for High-Dimensional Black-Box Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19449)
*Donggeon David Oh,Duy P. Nguyen,Gongkai Yuan,Qingchen Li,Jaime Fernández Fisac,Haimin Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种严格到达-保持-驻留（sRAS）Q控制屏障函数（CBF）安全滤波器，面向有界不确定性下的高维黑箱系统，通过结合驻留值与到达-规避值构造有效的鲁棒离散时间CBF，并借助基于可达性的对抗强化学习实现可扩展近似，在四足机器人跨越沟槽与F1TENTH竞速中验证了安全性与任务保持能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人不仅要完成任务，还须在全程避免安全失效并维持已取得的成果。严格到达-保持-驻留（sRAS）要求系统安全到达目标并在首次进入后无限期驻留其中。现有方法通常依赖已知动力学、仿射结构、值函数的导数或人工设计的屏障函数，难以适用于高维黑箱系统，因此需要一个不依赖这些先验、能处理有界不确定性且可扩展的sRAS安全滤波器。

Method: 提出sRAS Q-CBF安全滤波器。构造上，将编码目标子集内安全永久驻留的"驻留值"与编码安全可达该子集且规避无法保证安全驻留的目标状态的"到达-规避值"相结合，证明二者联合构成有效的鲁棒离散时间CBF，并将其提升为状态-动作Q函数以支持运行时干预。在精确值及测度零条件下，该滤波器可从几乎每个可获胜初始状态保持sRAS可行性，并在首次进入后对抗所有可容许不确定性实现持续安全驻留。采用基于可达性的对抗强化学习，仅通过黑箱交互进行可扩展的值函数近似。合成与部署均无需已知动力学、仿射结构、值导数或手工设计的屏障。

Result: 在四足机器人跨越沟槽任务中（仿真与硬件），机器人成功跨越沟槽、安全落地并在之后保持安全；仿真F1TENTH竞速进一步展示了安全超车与保持领先的能力。

Conclusion: 所提sRAS Q-CBF安全滤波器为高维黑箱系统在有界不确定性下提供了不依赖动力学模型与手工屏障的可扩展安全保证，理论与实验均验证了其在严格到达-保持-驻留任务中的有效性与安全性。

Abstract: Robots must complete their tasks and maintain the achieved outcomes while avoiding safety failures at all times. Strict reach-avoid-stay (sRAS) formalizes this requirement: safely reaching a target and remaining there indefinitely after first entry. We propose an sRAS Q-control barrier function (CBF) safety filter for high-dimensional black-box systems under bounded uncertainty. Our construction combines a stay value encoding safe permanent residence in a target subset with a reach-avoid value encoding safe reachability of this subset while avoiding target states from which safe permanent residence cannot be guaranteed.
