Method: V2-STRep是零样本框架，将生成视频运动转换为可复用机器人技能，核心是VLM驱动的结构化任务表示。该表示指定运动阶段、参考对象及任务相关约束，目标由最小几何结构描述：点、点法向、轴、平面与完整6D位姿。将VLM提供的2D图像空间线索借助RGB-D观测提升至3D，重建任务几何与候选抓取位姿。基于几何特定规则将运动迁移到新场景；任务约束轨迹优化将抓取选择与完整机器人运动规划耦合，在满足任务要求的同时利用剩余旋转自由度适应关节限制。更新部署时的grounding与约束即可在新兼容指令下复用，无需重新生成视频。

Result: 在六个真实世界操作任务上，执行成功率优于基线，成功习得技能可跨场景可靠迁移，并能适应变更后的部署指令。

Conclusion: 该方法通过结构化任务表示与几何规则，将生成视频中的单一场景运动抽象为可复用技能，实现零样本跨场景迁移与指令级复用，为无演示机器人技能获取提供有效路径。

Abstract: Human manipulation videos provide rich motion and interaction cues for acquiring robot skills without robot demonstrations. Video generation models synthesize such demonstrations from an initial scene image and task instruction, avoiding the need to record demonstrations for each task. However, the recovered motion captures only one scene-specific realization, leaving task structure, geometric relations, and constraints implicit. We present V2-STRep, a zero-shot framework that converts generated video motion into reusable robot skills through VLM-grounded structured task representations. The representation specifies motion phases, references, and task-relevant constraints, with targets described by minimal geometric structures: points, point-normals, axes, planes, and full 6D poses. VLM-provided 2D image-space cues are lifted into 3D using RGB-D observations to reconstruct task geometry and candidate grasp poses. Geometry-specific rules transfer motion to new scenes, while task-constrained trajectory optimization couples grasp selection with complete robot motion planning. It preserves task requirements while using remaining rotational freedom to accommodate joint limits. Updating deployment grounding and constraints enables reuse under new compatible instructions without generating another video. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved execution success over baselines, reliable cross-scene transfer of successfully acquired skills, and adaptation to changed deployment instructions.

</details>


### [373] [CoRef-GS: Cooperative Referring Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Agent Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20586)
*Zhikun Zhou,Kunyu Peng,Runyi Yang,Junhao Cai,Di Wen,Ruiping Liu,Danda Pani Paudel,Yi Zhou,Luc Van Gool,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出协作指代高斯落地问题（CoRef-GS），通过实例感知开放词汇高斯地图、跨智能体几何-语义对齐和视角条件掩码关系图实现融合地图上的指代目标定位，并构建CoQuad-Ref双四足机器人基准，仿真旋转误差降至0.15°，真实mIoU从52.6%提升至68.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身机器人指代场景理解需要从指定视角对物体与关系语言查询进行落地。单个智能体的局部语义高斯地图可支持该能力，但协作场景下多智能体独立重建的地图经对齐融合后，被指代目标或上下文地标可能来自其他智能体的观测，而空间关系仍需从查询机器人视角解读。现有语言感知高斯方法多面向单地图查询，高斯配准方法则只优化几何或光度对齐，未保持面向语言落地的语义兼容性。

Method: 提出CoRef-GS协作指代高斯泼溅框架：先构建局部开放词汇、实例感知的高斯地图；再通过跨智能体对齐模块，基于几何与语义一致性对齐部分重叠地图；最后利用视角条件掩码关系图进行查询落地。同时构建CoQuad-Ref双四足机器人基准，覆盖真实与仿真室内场景。

Result: 仿真场景中，CoRef-GS将旋转误差从粗初始化后的2.58°经细化降至0.15°；真实场景指代mIoU由ReferSplat的52.6%提升至68.8%。基准与源码将公开。

Conclusion: 该工作形式化定义协作指代高斯落地任务，需满足几何可对齐性、实例级语义可比性与视角条件关系推理三项要求，并验证了语义-几何联合对齐与视角条件关系建模在协作指代落地中的有效性。

Abstract: Referring scene understanding for embodied robots requires grounding object- and relation-centric language queries from a designated viewpoint. While a local semantic Gaussian map can support such grounding within one agent's observations, cooperative settings require this ability to remain effective after independently reconstructed maps are aligned and fused. In this setting, the referred target or its contextual landmark may come from another agent's observations, while spatial relations must still be interpreted from the querying robot's viewpoint. We formulate this problem as cooperative referring Gaussian grounding over fused maps, which requires geometric alignability, instance-level semantic comparability, and view-conditioned relation reasoning. Existing language-aware Gaussian methods mainly focus on single-map querying, whereas Gaussian registration methods optimize geometric or photometric alignment without preserving language-grounding-oriented semantic compatibility. We propose CoRef-GS, a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework. CoRef-GS constructs local open-vocabulary instance-aware Gaussian maps, then aligns partially overlapping maps with a cross-agent alignment module by geometric and semantic consistency, and grounds queries using a view-conditioned mask relation graph. We further introduce CoQuad-Ref, a dual-quadruped benchmark spanning both real-world and simulated indoor scenes. Experiments show that, on simulated scenes, CoRef-GS reduces the rotation error from 2.58° after coarse initialization to 0.15° after refinement, and improves real-world referring mIoU over ReferSplat from 52.6% to 68.8%. The established benchmark and source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git.

</details>


### [374] [Semantic SLAM in Precision Agriculture using Bayesian Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20604)
*Ruben Beumer,Sander Doodeman,René van de Molengraft,Duarte Antunes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向精准农业自主机器人的实时语义世界建模框架，将贝叶斯推断的概率对象/语义属性建图与基于g²o的图优化SLAM结合，实现不依赖GPS的定位与建图，并在Gazebo仿真和Spot机器人实物实验中验证可实时建图至少400株植物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准农业中的自主机器人需要在作物田间同时完成定位、建图与语义理解，而仅依赖GPS的方案在精度和可靠性上存在不足，因此需要一种融合语义信息、不单纯依赖GPS的实时世界建模框架。

Method: 框架将对象及其语义属性的概率建图（通过贝叶斯推断更新）与基于g²o图优化的SLAM方法集成；利用植物种类、尺寸、健康状态等语义信息支持机器人在建图与定位的同时执行任务；训练YOLOv8n目标检测模型从深度相机观测中提取对象与语义数据。

Result: 通过Gazebo仿真以及使用Boston Dynamics四足机器人Spot在含人工植物的室内田地的实物实验进行验证；结果表明系统可成功实现至少400株植物的实时建图。

Conclusion: 所提出的语义世界建模框架能够在不单纯依赖GPS的情况下实现精确的实时建图与定位，并具备在精准农业场景中扩展到数百株植物规模的应用潜力。

Abstract: This paper presents a real-time semantic world modeling framework specialized for precision agriculture using autonomous robots. The framework combines probabilistic mapping of objects and their semantic attributes, updated through Bayesian inference, with a graph-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) approach implemented using $g^2o$, a general framework for graph optimization. This integration enables accurate mapping and localization without relying solely on GPS. By leveraging semantic information such as plant type, size, and health, the robot can perform tasks while mapping and localizing itself within a field of crops. The proposed framework was validated through Gazebo simulations and physical experiments on an indoor field with artificial plants using Boston Dynamics' robot dog Spot. A YOLOv8n object detection model was trained to extract object and semantic data from depth camera observations. These simulations and experiments demonstrate that the system can successfully perform real-time mapping of up to at least 400 plants.

</details>


### [375] [Bayesian Continuum Robot Dynamics and State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20605)
*James M. Ferguson,Tucker Hermans,Alan Kuntz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因子图的连续体机器人动力学状态估计方法，通过将惯性与阻尼项建模为等效外载荷，使Cosserat杆动力学平衡保持静力学代数形式，从而在保持精度的同时实现动态运动下的状态估计与外载荷推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续体机器人因子图状态估计方法主要适用于准静态场景，或依赖白噪声运动先验进行时空估计。当惯性效应显著时，这些近似无法准确刻画底层物理规律，导致动态运动过程中估计精度下降。作者希望突破这一局限，将真实动力学纳入估计框架。

Method: 作者对连续体机器人的Cosserat杆动力学进行近似建模。核心技巧是将惯性力与阻尼力写成等效施加载荷的形式，从而使得动力学平衡方程在代数结构上与先前准静态工作的静力学平衡方程保持一致，便于复用已有因子图构建方式。在无主干（backbone）观测时，该框架退化为机器人运动的随机前向仿真；在具备观测时，则可联合优化运动学与动力学状态，并推断外载荷等隐状态。

Result: 作者通过仿真与实验进行了验证，成功实现了随机前向仿真，并在腱驱动连续体机器人上完成了状态估计，证明了该方法在动态条件下的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作将连续体机器人状态估计从准静态扩展至动态场景，通过等效载荷建模统一了静力学与动力学形式，为动态运动下的状态估计、外载荷推断及随机前向仿真提供了一种可行且可验证的因子图框架。

Abstract: Recent factor graph approaches to continuum robot state estimation have been successful for quasi-static applications and spatiotemporal estimation using white-noise kinematic motion priors. However, when inertial effects are significant, these approximations may fail to capture the underlying physics, limiting accuracy during dynamic motions. In contrast, our approach approximates the Cosserat rod dynamics of continuum robots. We write inertia and damping as equivalent applied loads, so that the dynamic balance retains the algebraic form of the static one from prior work with quasi-static robots. Without backbone observations, the framework reduces to a stochastic forward simulation of the robot's motion. Given observations, it jointly refines kinematic and dynamic states and infers external loads, among other states. We validate the approach through simulation and experiments, demonstrating stochastic forward simulation as well as state estimation on tendon-driven continuum robots.

</details>


### [376] [INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20615)
*Di Wen,Kailun Yang,Wenhao Guo,Yitian Shi,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Ruiping Liu,Jiale Wei,Rania Rayyes,Kunyu Peng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 INSPECT 框架，让机器人从智能眼镜助手的使用记录中学习视角偏好，用于装配检验中的部件存在性与安装正确性判断，无需目标域视角标签即可训练视角选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在装配检验中需判断零件是否存在及安装是否正确。第一人称装配辅助场景中，头部运动与工件操作提供了检验证据，语音状态确认则将观察与工序结果关联。但如何在无目标域视角标签的条件下，让机器人自主选择合适视角以获取可验证证据，仍是一个待解决的问题。

Method: 提出 INSPECT 框架，从智能眼镜助手的问答与下一步指导记录中学习机器人视角偏好。核心组件包括：Presence-Invariant TwinSwap（PI-TwinSwap），通过成对身份干预校准物体证据；Claim-indexed supervision，将证据需求与相机可复现的观察变化分离；Object-centered calibration，将相对视角偏好适配到机器人位姿；Clause-level screening，检验预测证据。机器人仅依赖当前观察与已知位姿选择视角，无需候选图像。

Result: 在物理齿轮箱装配图像上，INSPECT 在非 oracle 策略中取得最高视角效用，并将人工评定的完全可验证率从保持当前视角的 34.8% 提升至 41.7%。在 IMPACT 的商业角磨机记录上，迁移的相对视角选择器在冻结感知头的情况下，将正确决策率从 50.6% 提升至 54.3%。

Conclusion: INSPECT 表明可从辅助记录中习得机器人视角偏好，并在无目标域视角标签的条件下有效提升装配检验的可验证性与决策正确率，具备跨域迁移能力。

Abstract: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.

</details>


### [377] [Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20822)
*Bingxin Xu,Yuzhang Shang,Zhen Dong,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次评估编码智能体在安全约束下的机器人操作能力，发现其规划阶段忽视安全约束导致碰撞，提出SafeHarness框架以解决该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体（语言模型编写机器人控制器程序）已成为机器人操作的范式，无需机器人特定训练即可运行，但其安全性尚未被研究。作者希望探究该范式在安全约束下是否可靠。

Method: 设计安全约束任务（每个任务包含操作目标与不可触碰障碍物），评估编码智能体行为；将操作分解为路径阶段（route phase）与接触密集时刻（contact-rich moment），定位失败根源；提出SafeHarness框架，包含两个障碍感知组件：障碍感知路径规划（将物体表示为边界框并生成基于路径点的候选路径，先规划、验证、必要时重规划再执行）和障碍感知接触执行（选择接触位置使接触本身避开障碍物）。

Result: SafeHarness取得71.9%任务成功率和87.5%避碰率，分别超越此前SOTA 6.5%和27.0%；相比同一智能体无SafeHarness时提升2.3倍和1.5倍。

Conclusion: 编码智能体在安全约束下失败并非感知或指令问题，而是规划未能将约束优先化；SafeHarness通过障碍感知的路径规划与接触执行有效弥补该缺陷，显著提升安全性与成功率。

Abstract: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.

</details>


### [378] [A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20620)
*Khalid Halba,Kylie Cooper,James G. Bellingham*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出SPAR仿真框架，将实时C语言AUV控制软件与LLM编排层耦合，用于在无可靠通信条件下对自主水下航行器的故障恢复进行闭环集成评估，并通过480次试验比较前沿模型与本地部署LLM的诊断与决策表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AUV在超出可靠通信范围作业时，必须在无人工干预下自主从故障中恢复；传统确定性分层控制只能处理常规运行，面对未预期故障时需要可调用的诊断与恢复规划能力，而LLM的随机性又要求用集成测试而非单次演示来严格评估。

Method: 构建SPAR（Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery）闭环仿真架构：实时C语言载具软件与上层编排层耦合，支持基于物理的故障注入、结构化提示、语言模型交互、任务文件生成、验证、执行与LLM-judge评分；在质量偏移故障下进行480次试验，变化故障实现、提示结构、推理模型与任务条件，评估1个前沿模型和3个可本地部署的现成LLM。

Result: 模型选择主导诊断效果：前沿模型在85–90%的试验中将CG-shift机理列入前三假设，最佳本地模型为60–78%；推理分析显示本地模型成功与遵循完整诊断流程相关，而较弱模型常在执行器仍跟踪指令时过早断定升降舵故障；在本数据集上诊断性能与操作决策性能未表现出耦合关系。

Conclusion: 论文贡献为两点：一是将未预期故障恢复从检测扩展到缓解的架构，二是面向低功耗AUV上LLM辅助任务管理的集成评估方法论。

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. The framework, which we call SPAR (Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery), supports evaluation across fault realizations, prompt structures, reasoning models, and mission conditions. We vary these for a mass-shift fault over 480 SPAR trials, evaluating a frontier model and three off-the-shelf locally deployable LLMs. Model choice dominates diagnosis: the frontier model places the CG-shift mechanism in its top three hypotheses in 85-90% of trials, versus 60-78% for the best local model. Reasoning analysis indicates that local-model success is associated with following the complete diagnostic procedure, whereas weaker models often commit prematurely to elevator failure even though the actuator tracks its command. Diagnosis and operational decision performance do not appear to be coupled in this dataset. The contributions are an architecture extending unanticipated-fault recovery from detection to mitigation and an ensemble methodology for evaluating LLM-assisted mission management on low-power AUVs.

</details>


### [379] [SmellDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Quadruped Navigation with Olfactory Scene Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20624)
*Faith Ogunwoye,Iana Zhura,Hajira Amjad,Timofei Kozlov,Didar Seyidov,Dmitrii Plotnikov,Fedor Fedorov,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 SmellDiffusion 仿真流程，在开放词汇嗅觉场景图中表示特定气体区域，并在经典与扩散规划器之间共享目标，通过峰值局部几何门控实现选择性源校正与气体引导轨迹生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人需在指定气体泄漏任务中保持气体身份、估计气源并导航到目标；而浓度峰值与真实源存在偏移时，直接估计会造成较大定位误差，需要一种能选择性校正、且与气体引导规划协同的方法。

Method: 构建开放词汇嗅觉场景图，表示物种特异的气体区域；经典规划器与扩散规划器共享同一场景图源估计作为目标；采用仅依赖源的几何门控，在观测峰值处触发前向匹配（forward-matching）校正；扩散规划实现气体引导的轨迹生成。

Result: 424 个源-风配置中 28 例峰值偏移超过 0.5m；门控在 10 个留出偏移中检出 9 个，精度 0.64；校正将偏移情形平均误差由 1.468m 降至 0.592m（降 60%），仅对 14/204 例启用匹配；全情形平均误差由 0.205m 降至 0.180m。扩散 best-of-ten 气体暴露为 0.0476，与气体引导 A* 的 0.0455 相当；单次扩散提议 41.7ms，快于气体引导 A* 的 72.3ms，但 best-of-ten 序贯采样增加总时长；Plain A* 以最快、最短路径到达同一目标；6 次匹配 Gazebo 实验中 A* 与扩散的机器人与源平均误差分别为 0.39m 与 0.31m。

Conclusion: 选择性峰值局部几何门控能在少量触发下有效纠正峰值-源偏移，显著降低定位误差并改善整体估计；扩散规划在单次提议效率上具优势，暴露水平与气体引导 A* 相当，并在 Gazebo 中取得更低的机器人到源误差，但最快路径仍由 Plain A* 保持。

Abstract: A robot sent to a named gas leak must preserve gas identity, estimate the source, and navigate to the resulting goal. We present SmellDiffusion, a simulation pipeline that represents species-specific gas zones in an open-vocabulary olfactory scene graph and shares the selected goal between classical and diffusion planners. Its key components are a peak-local geometric gate for selective source correction and diffusion-based, gas-guided trajectory generation. Among 424 unique source-wind configurations in solved flow, 28 have a concentration peak displaced more than 0.5m from the source. A source-independent geometric gate, calibrated only on the training split and evaluated at the observed peak, detects 9 of 10 held-out displacements at 0.64 precision. Gating a precomputed forward-matching correction reduces mean error on the displaced cases from 1.468m to 0.592m (60%), using matching for only 14/204 cases. All-case mean error falls from 0.205m to 0.180m. All planners receive the same scene-graph source estimate as their goal. In a controlled comparison, best-of-ten diffusion achieves mean gas exposure comparable to gas-guided A* (0.0476 versus 0.0455). A single diffusion proposal takes 41.7ms, compared with 72.3ms for gas-guided A*, although best-of-ten sequential sampling increases total runtime. Plain A* also reaches the same goal and remains the fastest and shortest-path method. Six matched Gazebo runs give mean robot-to-source errors of 0.39m for A* and 0.31m for diffusion.

</details>


### [380] [RTK-Vision PPO for Autonomous Micro UAV Recovery on an Airborne Carrier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20629)
*Aashish Sahu,R Prasanth Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种RTK-视觉融合的强化学习框架，使小型无人机能够自主从飞行中的大型载机起飞、执行任务、返回并对接降落，实现完整的“部署—任务—回收”闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复用的小型无人机需要自主回收至移动的空中载机平台，但该过程耦合了远距离会合、近距离感知、载机运动、气动干扰以及不连续的接触事件，传统方法难以统一处理。

Method: 两机均搭载RTK-GNSS，载机持续共享导航状态；近端由朝下相机与标记检测器提供相对位姿线索。终端回收阶段采用PPO策略，在MuJoCo物理仿真中训练，引入传感器噪声模型、气动扰动代理与标记延迟随机化，再迁移至真机；底层稳定由PX4负责，确定性安全门独立授权下降。

Result: PPO检查点在2000个留出随机终端回合中成功率99.55%，优于同条件下调优PD基线的78.4%，终端平面误差中位数6.62 cm；14次室外试验中完整任务成功13次（92.9%），涵盖近区回收及载机移离释放点后的回收。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了完整的自主空中部署—回收循环，而非孤立的降落动作，为巡检、监视与移动物流等场景中可复用的载机—子机协同运行提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Autonomous recovery of a micro unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) onto a moving airborne carrier enables reusable deploy-mission-recover operation, but couples long-range rendezvous, close-range perception, carrier motion, aerodynamic interaction, and a discontinuous contact event. This paper presents an RTK-vision-guided reinforcement-learning framework in which a child UAV is physically transported by a larger carrier, takes off from the carrier while airborne, executes an independent sortie, returns to the carrier's current position, redocks, and subsequently descends with the carrier. Both vehicles carry RTK-GNSS, and the carrier continuously shares its navigation state with the child. Near the recovery deck, RTK remains active while a downward-facing camera with a fiducial marker detector provides marker-relative alignment cues. A proximal policy optimization (PPO) policy governing the terminal recovery phase is trained in a physics-based MuJoCo simulation environment with explicit sensor noise models, an aerodynamic disturbance surrogate, and marker-latency randomization, then transferred to hardware. PX4 retains low-level stabilization, and a deterministic safety gate authorizes descent independently of the learned policy. The PPO checkpoint achieves 99.55% success over 2,000 held-out randomized terminal episodes, compared with 78.4% for a tuned PD baseline under identical conditions, with a median planar terminal error of 6.62 cm. Across 14 outdoor trials, the full mission succeeds in 13 trials (92.9%), spanning both near-region recovery and recovery after the carrier translates away from the release point. The results demonstrate a complete autonomous aerial deployment-and-recovery cycle rather than an isolated landing maneuver, establishing a practical basis for reusable carrier-child operation in inspection, surveillance, and mobile-logistics applications.

</details>


### [381] [TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20646)
*Jiaxuan Zhang,Ruizhe Liu,Yu Zhang,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 TraceFlow：利用成功与失败 rollout 的动作密度构造有界引导场，在不更新权重的前提下纠正冻结的 flow-matching 动作专家，并以 TraceBank 存储带终止标签的轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略权重固定后，早期 rollout 的成败无法影响当前动作块生成；已有测试时方法依赖检索成功样本、critic、验证器或动力学模型，但均未将机器人自身的失败 rollout 作为负证据，更未仅用终止结果位加以利用。

Method: TraceFlow 将检索到的成功与失败 rollout 的动作密度转化为对冻结 flow-matching 动作专家的有界修正，每条 rollout 仅需一个终止结果位、无其他标注。TraceBank 存储时间有序的状态-动作记录及终止标签，初始来自目标任务训练轨迹，后续接纳部署机器人自身的 rollout。该方法为 progress-aligned guidance field。

Result: 真实机器人有序装箱任务：基线 50 次试验中 21 次按序完成，TraceFlow 达 39 次，无权重更新且经一轮 stacking 后为 47 次，错误序列回合从 20 降至 0。仿真中增益具选择性：按套件选参后，RoboMemArena Sequence 任务成功率 78.92%→91.50%，Transferring 在 stacking 第 2 轮 54.41%→62.00%；26 任务总体不变，Counting 与 Occlusion 分别下降 1.12 与 1.42 分，LIBERO-Plus (Long) +1.27 分（p = 0.0733）。Stacking 增益有限，各分支均在第 10 轮前达峰；TraceBank 的成功-失败比无法预测检索分配。

Conclusion: 仅凭终止结果位、无需权重更新的测试时引导可显著改善有序任务并消除错误序列，但收益具有任务选择性与饱和性，且成功-失败比对检索分配无预测力。

Abstract: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a flow-matching action expert generates each action chunk (a short command sequence) by integrating a learned velocity field; once its weights are fixed, the success or failure of an earlier rollout cannot change the chunk generated now. Concurrent test-time methods give a frozen policy such an input from retrieved successes, a learned critic, a verifier, or a dynamics model, but none uses the robot's own failed rollouts as negative evidence with nothing but a terminal outcome bit. We introduce TraceFlow, a progress-aligned guidance field that turns the action densities of retrieved successful and failed rollouts into a bounded correction to a frozen flow-matching action expert, using one terminal outcome bit per rollout and no other label. Its TraceBank stores traces, time-ordered state-action records with a terminal label, starts from the target-task training traces, and later admits the deployed robot's own rollouts. On an ordered real-robot packing task the base completes 21 of 50 trials in order, TraceFlow 39, and one stacking round without any weight update 47, with wrong-sequence episodes falling from 20 to 0. In simulation the gain is selective: with per-suite selected settings, TraceFlow raises RoboMemArena Sequence from 78.92\% to 91.50\% task success and Transferring from 54.41\% to 62.00\% at stacking round 2, leaves the 26-task aggregate unchanged, lowers Counting and Occlusion by 1.12 and 1.42 points, and changes LIBERO-Plus (Long) by +1.27 points (p = 0.0733). Stacking gains are finite, every branch peaking before round ten, and the bank's success-to-failure ratio predicts no retrieval allocation.

</details>


### [382] [SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20648)
*Kaivalya Agrawal,Md Ashiqur Rahman,Raymond A. Yeh,Zachary Kingston*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkipVLA 将预训练 VLA 与经典运动规划器结合，仅在接触丰富的技能上调用 VLA，其余自由空间运动由规划器完成，从而在保持任务成功率的同时将任务完成速度提升至 2.5 倍并降低能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型测试时推理速度慢，尤其长时程任务需大量策略查询。已有加速方法（蒸馏小模型、异步动作块重叠、搭配快速低层策略）仍需学习策略贯穿全任务运行；而经典运动规划器虽能快速生成无碰撞轨迹，却缺乏语义理解且需要显式目标。因此需要一个兼顾语义理解与运动效率的混合方案。

Method: 提出 SkipVLA 混合策略：自由空间运动交由经典运动规划器处理，仅在抓取、放置等接触丰富技能上查询 VLA。复用 VLA 冻结的视觉-语言主干来预测每次规划运动的目标位姿，并利用大 VLA 已学得的知识训练该预测器，无需引入额外演示数据。

Result: 在仿真中基于三种 VLA 在 13 个 LIBERO 任务上评估，并在物理 6 自由度 YAM 机械臂上测试三个抓放任务：任务完成速度最高提升 2.5 倍，能耗显著降低，且任务成功率相当。

Conclusion: 通过将 VLA 语义理解与经典规划器的快速无碰撞运动结合，SkipVLA 在不牺牲成功率的条件下显著提升推理效率、降低能耗，为长时程机器人策略的实用化提供了一种高效混合范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

</details>


### [383] [DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20649)
*Yan Qin,Yue Chen,Wenwei Lin,Shujia Liu,Chuqiao Lyu,Kailun Su,Chenze Yu,Ping Luo,Wenbo Ding,Tianxing Chen,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexTouch-WM是一个动作条件世界模型，利用可扩展的人类触觉数据，联合预测未来RGB观测与双手触觉动态，实现人-机器人操作动态的知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富的灵巧操作需要稠密触觉交互数据，但在真实机器人上规模化采集成本高，且数据与特定本体传感器强绑定，难以通用。作者希望借助可扩展的人类触觉交互来缓解机器人数据瓶颈。

Method: 核心洞察是人类与机器人操作在触觉观测和动作空间兼容后共享可迁移接触动力学。方法上在人手与灵巧机器人手上部署相同传感布局的柔性压阻阵列，并将人体动作重定向到机器人动作空间；模型将预训练视频专家与轻量触觉专家耦合，采用解剖感知触觉token与对齐的动作条件进行联合预测。

Result: 在人到机器人扩展实验中，固定5小时真实机器人监督，将人类交互从0增至100小时，尽管人机任务集不相交，仍在留出的机器人域视觉、几何与接触预测上取得显著提升。世界模型还可作为策略评估的代理环境，并生成合成轨迹用于真实机器人策略学习。

Conclusion: 可扩展的人类交互为学习灵巧机器人世界模型提供了互补的数据维度，验证了跨本体触觉动力学迁移的可行性。

Abstract: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

</details>


### [384] [HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20659)
*Zimu Han,Yiming Zeng,Jiyao Zhang,Zihao Zhao,Yuanfei Wang,Yixiang Jin,Shiqi Li,Shuangben Chen,Wei Huang,Ruodai Li,Hui Shen,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HIL-UMI：一种策略引导的 UMI 框架，实现"无机器人"的人在环 VLA 后训练，通过能量分数触发数据采集与在线优势预测精修，改进 SFT 并优于 HG-DAgger。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 VLA 模型提供强先验，但适配具体部署仍困难。任务示范上的 SFT 存在两个固有限制：静态数据对分布外状态覆盖不足；标准模仿目标无法区分"有推进价值"的行为与低价值数据。交互式后训练可缓解上述问题，但通常需要在物理机器人上反复执行策略并依赖人工干预，成本高、可扩展性差。

Method: HIL-UMI 在手持 UMI 示范过程中，将当前策略在同一观测流上进行查询但不执行其预测动作。利用 Energy Score 比较人类动作轨迹与策略推理结果，当二者差异指示分布外区域时触发数据采集。另一反馈回路中，通过低在线优势预测定位关键片段，用于精修基于进展（progress-based）的优势估计器；更新后的估计器以基础示范与新策略数据的均衡混合，引导优势条件行为克隆。

Result: 在覆盖长时序与精细操作的四项真实任务上，HIL-UMI 相对 SFT 取得一致提升，并同时受益于定向采集与优势精修。在 Clean Up Table 任务上优于 HG-DAgger，且单帧采集时间更低。

Conclusion: 该设计在保留人在环学习的迭代性与策略感知特性的同时，将数据采集与机器人部署解耦，为跨操作者、跨地点的 VLA 后训练提供了一条可扩展路径。

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

</details>


### [385] [Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20669)
*Zhongbo Zhang,Zaibin Zhang,Yifan Wang,Changbo Yan,Lijun Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Movement Trend Guidance，用短历史观测学到的紧凑潜在表示提供未来导向条件，以仅增3.52%参数改进3D扩散策略DP3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D扩散策略擅长基于当前观测生成几何可行的动作，但成功操作需要预判交互走向；现有策略多依赖动作学习隐式获得这种前瞻，缺乏显式引导。

Method: 从短观测历史学习交互演化的紧凑潜在表示；训练时用稀疏未来夹爪状态监督该表示，推理时仅保留潜在作为未来导向条件与当前观测共同输入。潜在用于动作生成全局条件，另加门控FiLM分支仅作用于UNet瓶颈层。

Result: 相比DP3仅增3.52%参数，保留原密集动作与滚动时域形式；RoboTwin2.0 50任务混合训练62.8% vs 56.1%，LIBERO-40 71.93% vs 37.08%，五类真实机器人任务72.0% vs 49.0%。

Conclusion: 扩散策略可从"知道交互走向"中显著受益，而无需明确被告知应移动到哪里。

Abstract: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

</details>


### [386] [MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20670)
*Haozhe Lei,Ruibin Chen,Yuhan Jiang,Ali Rasteh,Aditya Dhananjay,Sundeep Rangan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MAGNETAR在一次异步RF多径快照下，联合推断发射机的平面位置与朝向后验分布，采用按候选朝向条件化的共享2D U-Net在离散位置-朝向网格上归一化得分，并通过实-仿标定的10 GHz仿真与少量实测数据训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人定位无线电发射机时，仅靠点估计不足：在杂乱房间中，单次测量常与多个发射机位置一致；由于中高频段天线具有方向性，测量还与多个朝向一致，因此需要能够表达多模态不确定性的联合后验推断。

Method: MAGNETAR基于单次异步RF多径快照（由到达角与信噪比估计表示），结合房间布局与接收机位姿，推断平面位置与朝向的联合后验。在五种神经评分器中，采用共享2D U-Net对每个候选朝向进行条件化，并在离散的位置-朝向网格上联合归一化得分。训练使用实-仿标定的10 GHz仿真数据及少量实测子集。

Result: 在留出仿真中，基于网格的联合后验优于参数化后验；按朝向条件化的评分器在机器人实测数据上的迁移效果最好；融合联合后验优于融合仅位置边缘分布。

Conclusion: 研究表明，面向RF发射机定位应显式建模位置-朝向联合后验，网格化联合分布与朝向条件化评分器能提升仿真性能与实测迁移，且联合后验融合优于位置边缘融合。

Abstract: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

</details>


### [387] [Towards Scaling Marine Perception with Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20680)
*Haoyu Ma,Onur Bagoren,Anja Sheppard,Elias Fandi,Ashrith Edukulla,Tanner Aslan,Natasha Sieh,Jingyu Song,Katherine A. Skinner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作扩展了基于IsaacSim的水下感知模拟器OceanSim，新增合成数据生成（SDG）流水线，可自动生成大规模、带标注、照片级真实感的水下数据集，并在真实海胆检测任务上评估其sim-to-real迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下环境中可扩展的机器学习受限于缺乏真实世界标注数据，这类数据采集与整理成本高、耗时长，而模拟数据有望弥合这一差距。

Method: 在IsaacSim-based水下感知模拟器OceanSim基础上，构建SDG流水线，支持生成大规模自动标注、照片级真实感的数据集，场景外观、结构与传感器设置均可配置；并在真实海胆检测任务上评估不同合成场景变化形式对sim-to-real性能的影响。

Result: 实验中分析了不同形式的合成场景变化对sim-to-real性能的影响，并总结了相关发现、当前流水线的主要局限。

Conclusion: 提出了面向水下感知的合成数据生成方案，并指出未来在提升水下渲染保真度、场景多样性以及sim-to-real泛化评估方面的改进方向，代码已开源。

Abstract: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.

</details>


### [388] [Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20691)
*Andrea Capuozzo,Fabio Ruggiero,Vincenzo Lippiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文为混合空水两栖无人机提出了PX4固件扩展，新增手动与自主水面航行模式，并集成到标准PX4任务流程与QGroundControl界面中，实现了空水混合任务的统一规划与执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水环境测绘与监测需要既能在空中飞行又能在水面航行的混合无人机，以在同一任务中结合飞行与水面导航能力，但现有PX4固件缺乏对水面航行模式及空水混合任务规划的支持。

Method: 在PX4固件上进行扩展开发，引入手动与自主水面航行模式，并将其与标准PX4任务流水线及QGroundControl地面站界面相集成；在保留原有飞行功能与安全机制的前提下，支持区分空中与水面航点的统一任务规划与执行。

Result: 通过仿真案例验证了该实现方案，并在平静与波浪条件下展示了稳定的水面航行性能。

Conclusion: 所提框架可在不牺牲原有飞行功能与安全机制的情况下，实现混合空水任务的统一规划与执行，仿真结果表明其水面航行具备良好的稳定性。

Abstract: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

</details>


### [389] [HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20694)
*Pranay Meshram,Charuvahan Adhivarahan,Prithvi Poddar,Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani,Chen Wang,Souma Chowdhury,Karthik Dantu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HOPHY分层越野规划框架,利用超图组织语义区域与关键区域,支持无需重建层次的状态更新,在公里级真实越野地图上实现100%规划成功率与<0.01%中位代价偏差,多机器人任务分配计算量较像素A*降低79倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害响应、搜索救援与战术UGV任务需在地形、智能体类型和目标变化时反复进行路径与任务规划。像素网格搜索在公里级重复查询下代价高昂,而语义抽象方法必须在条件变化时维持有效的代价与连通性,现有方法难以兼顾效率与正确性。

Method: HOPHY是一种可复用的分层地形表示:将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通的语义区域(GSNodes)、保持连通性的关键区域(Coarse Regions),以及编码地形、智能体与天气上下文的带类型超边,通过超边相交选择受影响区域与关联边进行状态更新而不重建层次结构。

Result: 在覆盖公里级区域的真实越野地图上,规划成功率100%,相对oracle(像素A*)的中位代价偏差小于0.01%,查询与重规划延迟显著低于像素及抽象基线;在多机器人任务分配(MRTA)中,总计算量较像素A*减少79倍、较最快抽象基线减少7.2倍,任务完工时间与像素A*相当;在实体Clearpath Jackal上完成1.5公里、八任务的混合地表户外任务及一次阻塞触发的重规划路径。

Conclusion: HOPHY通过超图式分层表示实现了高效且可复用的越野规划,在保持接近oracle的规划质量的同时显著降低查询、重规划与任务分配计算开销,并具备实体机器人长距离多任务验证的可行性。

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

</details>


### [390] [MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20709)
*Jiayu Wang,Bin Zhu,Yue Yu,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MoWAM 用显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，在训练时通过 Mixture-of-Transformer 学习未来视觉动态并联合预测运动与动作，推理时完全去除视频生成，兼顾效率与分布外鲁棒性，并支持推理时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models 通过引入未来动力学提升机器人策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频带来巨大计算开销；若直接去除未来生成虽提升效率，却使未来动态仅隐式编码于观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。因此需要一种既高效又保留显式未来表征的方法。

Method: 提出 MoWAM：以显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，将结构化机器人运动建模为未来场景的紧凑抽象，而非重建完整未来画面。采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构，在训练阶段学习未来视觉动态，同时联合预测运动与动作；推理阶段完全移除视频生成，保留显式未来表征。紧凑运动表示还支持高效的推理时扩展：采样多组运动-动作候选，并用运动感知的任务进展验证器进行筛选。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM 取得强分布内性能、更优的分布外鲁棒性，以及高于代表性 WAM 基线的真实世界平均成功率；随着探索候选数量增加，性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 显式未来运动预测是高效且有效的替代方案：既避免了推理时视频生成的开销，又保留了显式未来表征以增强鲁棒性，并为推理时扩展提供了良好基础。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [391] [Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20731)
*Yuheng Zhou,Haiyang Cheng,Yanqi Feng,Pangkit Fong,Mei Xuan Lee,Marcus Gee,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于自主水下航行器（AUV）的立体视觉伺服框架，通过目标特定深度提取与卡尔曼滤波获得稳定3D相对状态，并采用解耦控制与自适应模型融合MPC实现实时目标跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的水下目标跟踪面临深度测量不可靠和目标运动未知两大挑战，现有框架难以兼顾测量稳定性与实时控制性能。

Method: 感知层面：利用颜色、视差和时间线索构建目标深度掩膜以筛选可靠目标像素，对深度测量与检测图像中心分别滤波，获得稳定3D相对状态；控制层面：将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免计算昂贵的多自由度耦合优化，实现实时平移MPC，并采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合匀速与零速目标模型，依据历史预测误差更新模型权重，在驱动、跟随距离和视场约束下计算平移指令。

Result: 通过仿真和真实实验验证框架有效性，性能优于现有框架。

Conclusion: 所提立体视觉伺服框架可有效应对水下深度测量不可靠与目标运动未知问题，在实时性与跟踪性能上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

</details>


### [392] [MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20747)
*Thomas Steinecker,Denis Trescher,Alexander Bienemann,Thorsten Luettel,Mirko Maehlisch*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MILER是一个端到端策略框架，通过语义中层表征（MLR）模拟器和轨迹对齐策略，实现感知与控制的零样本sim-to-real迁移，在真实非结构化道路上完成17.3公里自主驾驶。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习具备超越人类表现和自学习策略的潜力，但在真实世界自动驾驶中应用稀少，尤其在非结构化环境中，核心障碍是sim-to-real迁移困难。

Method: 离线阶段采用定制的语义中层表征（MLR）模拟器，用强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型；部署阶段用BEVFusion处理相机与LiDAR数据，生成与MLR模拟器一致的语义鸟瞰图表征；策略网络输出的动作不直接作用于实车，而是通过轨迹对齐策略实现感知和控制的零样本迁移。

Result: 在包含多种障碍物、发夹弯、最高33.6 km/h速度及越野路段的3.0 km测试赛道上，用两辆不同车辆无人工干预行驶17.3 km；整套软件栈运行于Jetson AGX Orin。

Conclusion: 该框架验证了非结构化环境下端到端强化学习策略零样本sim-to-real迁移的可行性，感知与控制均可迁移且算力需求适配嵌入式平台。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

</details>


### [393] [OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20756)
*Damiano Da Col,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Kashyap Chitta,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Konrad Schindler,Christos Sakaridis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出OPTED，将强化学习与端到端驾驶策略后训练解耦：用特权教师（向量化输入）经RL训练后，在闭环中对预训练学生模型进行监督式微调，避免直接RL的高昂仿真成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠扩大预训练数据收益递减，后训练在自动驾驶等物理AI领域愈发重要。端到端策略用行为克隆在开环下预训练，闭环部署时的复合误差会使车辆偏离训练分布，带来安全风险；而闭环后训练对基于传感器的策略而言需要昂贵的仿真。

Method: OPTED将RL与端到端策略后训练解耦：先在向量化输入（HD地图与边界框）上用RL训练一个特权教师，再由该教师在闭环后训练中为预训练学生提供监督信号。作者将OPTED应用于两个相机模型TransFuser和VaVAM，在AlpaSim中利用真实驾驶日志的神经重建（3DGS）进行微调。

Result: 驾驶分数分别提升1.6倍（TransFuser）和9.5倍（VaVAM）。在受控实验中，OPTED达到与直接RL后训练相当的闭环性能，但所需仿真交互次数约少三个数量级，同时更接近人类先验。

Conclusion: OPTED通过特权教师监督的方式实现了高效、低成本的闭环后训练，显著提升端到端驾驶策略性能，并在效率上远优于直接RL后训练。

Abstract: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

</details>


### [394] [Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20761)
*Hanchu Zhou,Brendan Lynch,Raman Goyal,Dechen Gao,Begum Kasap,Boqi Zhao,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TARO，一种轻量敏捷的触觉世界动作模型，通过共享潜空间直接实现视觉-触觉到动作的流匹配，并引入多时间尺度多模态预测，在9个仿真和5个真实接触丰富任务上优于最强基线，真实实验成功率相对提升29.4%，推理延迟仅11.9 ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有触觉世界动作模型依赖大规模预训练生成式骨干网络来建模接触丰富的物理动力学，导致推理效率低、部署灵活性差，难以满足精确高频的机器人控制需求。

Method: TARO将视觉与触觉观测编码到共享潜空间，作为直接视觉-触觉到动作流匹配过程之源，联合生成动作块的潜表示与未来视觉/触觉潜表示；并基于视觉与触觉信号时间尺度差异（视觉帧间高度相似、触觉在接触时突变），提出多时间尺度多模态预测：以较大时间偏移监督视觉潜表示，同时预测下一帧触觉潜表示以捕捉细粒度接触动力学。

Result: 在9个仿真与5个真实世界接触丰富操作任务上表现强劲且稳健，成功率超越最强基线且保持低推理延迟；五个真实实验中总体成功率相对提升29.4%，推理延迟11.9 ms。

Conclusion: 结果表明，多模态世界动作模型可用敏捷架构实现，适用于精确且高频的机器人控制。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

</details>


### [395] [GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20776)
*Xin Chen,Sen Chen,Yujuan Ding,Jian Liu,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Heng Tao Shen,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 GeoAAC——一种基于几何的自适应动作分块方法，利用 Flow Matching 去噪轨迹的几何特征为流式 VLA 策略动态确定动作视界，无需额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略普遍使用固定动作视界，但一次 rollout 中不同任务阶段对动作连续性、控制精度与闭环反馈的需求不同，固定视界无法适应变化的控制需求。

Method: 发现 Flow Matching 去噪轨迹的几何特性可提供过程级信息以刻画预测可靠性，且动作前缀间的几何变化与预测不确定性正相关；据此构造前缀级几何到视界级几何剖面，从单次生成中自适应确定动作视界，无需额外训练。

Result: 在 GR00T N1.5 与 π0.5 上，于 LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365 及真实机器人操作任务中，一致优于固定视界基线和现有自适应方法；仿真最高提升 8.7 个百分点，真机平均成功率由 53.3% 提升至 74.4%。

Conclusion: 几何化的过程信号可作为预测可靠性的有效代理，实现免训练、单次生成的自适应动作分块，显著提升流式 VLA 策略的控制表现与泛化性。

Abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

</details>


### [396] [StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20791)
*Jinbang Huang,Yuanzhao Hu,Zhiyuan Li,Ran Qi,Yixin Xiao,Yangzheng Wu,Tengyue Ba,Zhanguang Zhang,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出StageGuard——一种智能体蒸馏框架，用于准确高效的阶段转换（子任务完成判断）决策。它结合教师模型推理与示范轨迹生成结构化解释，并蒸馏到轻量学生VLM中以实现实时监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层规划框架整合多个机器人控制策略以完成长时程任务，关键在于判断何时终止当前技能并进入下一子任务。现有方法依赖预先设计的完成信号检查器，在真实执行中难以获得；而大型视觉语言模型（VLM）虽具备强推理能力，但其决策边界与任务完成标准并不天然对齐，且云端部署与冗长推理带来显著延迟，无法支持实时监控。

Method: StageGuard采用智能体蒸馏框架：结合教师模型推理与示范轨迹，生成关于子任务完成与策略切换的结构化解释；再用这些解释训练一个轻量级学生VLM，使其生成紧凑的自我解释，并通过监督微调完成知识蒸馏，从而支持高效的在线阶段转换预测。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上评估了阶段转换预测，并通过集成到BEHAVIOR-1K上的分层机器人控制中评估闭环任务成功率，同时在真实机器人上做了进一步验证。结果显示阶段转换预测有显著提升，并支持高效的在线监控。

Conclusion: StageGuard通过教师推理蒸馏到轻量学生VLM，兼顾了阶段转换决策的准确性与在线部署效率，为长时程分层机器人控制中的子任务终止判断提供了可行且实用的方案。

Abstract: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.

</details>


### [397] [Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20820)
*Nitish Dashora,Douglas Chen,Idan Shenfeld,John Marangola,Pulkit Agrawal,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"工作空间令牌"(workspace token)这种轻量级潜在记忆表示，通过在训练阶段用VLM蒸馏任务相关的当前与历史信息，部署时无需在环VLM推理，即可使策略解决记忆密集型机器人操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂的机器人操作任务常需对过去事件与动作的长期记忆。直接以完整历史作为条件会引入伪相关并降低性能；现有方法多在部署时于环调用昂贵的VLM查询来压缩历史信息、仅保留任务显著信息，计算代价高、效率低。

Method: 将计算密集的VLM查询移至训练阶段：先用VLM识别完成任务所需的当前与历史信息，再通过集合重构(set-reconstruction)解码器损失将这些信息蒸馏进轻量的workspace token中，使其可在部署时高效查询，并作为观测的即插即用替代。

Result: 在仿真与真实硬件上均验证，workspace token可替代部署时的观测输入，使策略在无需在环VLM推理的情况下完成记忆密集型任务；且相比基线更轻量，同时带来更好的策略性能。

Conclusion: 将VLM推理从部署阶段转移到训练阶段来学习轻量潜在记忆，是解决策略长期记忆问题的有效且高效的替代方案，兼顾计算效率与策略表现。

Abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [398] [Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning: Stability under Constant Stepsizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19170)
*Xingguo Chen,Zhaohui Wu,Jinguo Ye,Chao Li,Shangdong Yang,Guang Yang,Skylar Liang,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构造双状态反例证明ETD均值映射收缩但采样乘积具有正Lyapunov指数，并提出正则化强调TD（RETD）以修正冲击后动力学，给出收敛性证明与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强调时序差分学习（ETD）虽能稳定期望离策略TD更新并改变投影几何，但这两条性质均不能决定恒定步长下的采样动力学；需要厘清期望收缩与采样稳定性之间的差异，并修复采样动力学的不稳定。

Method: 构造遍历性双状态反例，其中ETD均值映射收缩而采样乘积的顶部Lyapunov指数为正；用再生周期分析将符号问题与follow-on迹的无穷方差分离；提出RETD：归一化的一阶冲击后修复，保持迹与重要性比不变，将强调TD信号存入泄漏标量状态并释放延迟修正；其原始平衡点为ETD平衡点的仿射平移，单/双正则化读出可精确恢复ETD不动点；通过调和递减步长证明几乎必然收敛，并借助马尔可夫随机乘积界给出一致步长下的条件矩收缩结果。

Result: RETD在双状态构造和一个Baird点上具有可证负指数，而Baird上ETD的正号仍仅为数值观察；配对10000次运行实验验证了两种分离、不动点恢复、非单调稳定域及任务依赖性；RETD改变冲击后动力学，但不降低共享的follow-on迹方差。

Conclusion: ETD的期望稳定性和投影几何不足以保证恒定步长采样稳定性；RETD通过冲击后修复实现可证的指数稳定与不动点恢复，但其稳定性区域非单调且依赖任务，且未减少follow-on迹方差。

Abstract: Emphatic temporal-difference learning (ETD) stabilizes the expected off-policy TD update and changes its projection geometry, but neither property determines constant-stepsize sampled dynamics. We construct an ergodic two-state counterexample in which the ETD mean map contracts while the sampled product has a positive top Lyapunov exponent. Regenerative-cycle analysis separates this sign from the infinite variance of the follow-on trace. We introduce regularized emphatic TD (RETD), a normalized first-order post-shock repair that leaves the trace and importance ratios unchanged, stores the emphatic TD signal in a leaky scalar state, and releases a delayed correction. RETD's raw equilibrium is an affine shift of the ETD equilibrium; single- and two-regularization readouts recover the ETD fixed point exactly. We prove almost-sure convergence for harmonic diminishing stepsizes and a conditional constant-stepsize moment-contraction result from a Markovian random-product bound. RETD has certified negative exponents on the two-state construction and one Baird point, whereas the positive Baird ETD sign remains numerical. Paired 10,000-run experiments validate both separations, fixed-point recovery, a nonmonotone stability region, and task dependence. RETD changes post-shock dynamics; it does not reduce the shared follow-on-trace variance.

</details>


### [399] [BioPhys-Bridge: A Benchmark for Interdisciplinary Scientific Reasoning in Physics-Grounded Biological Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19180)
*Qingyang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 BioPhys-Bridge，一个面向生物物理文献、以证据落地为核心的跨学科科学推理基准，含500个案例、1517个任务，并要求模型融合证据、定量物理模型与生物机制进行问答与RAG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在跨学科科研文献分析中面临独特挑战：生物物理研究中，忠实回答需将观测数据锚定于原始证据，经定量物理模型解释，并关联到生物机制。现有基准难以同时约束证据归因、定量落地与机制推理。

Method: 构建 BioPhys-Bridge 基准数据集。每个案例包含证据块、稳定证据ID、定量数值、单位、方程、假设、机制及后续决策，作为QA与RAG的落地目标。初版含500案例、1517个面向智能体的任务，覆盖6个生物学领域与9个物理模型族（其中3个稀疏族预留扩展）。设置严格质量门控：模式、证据完整性、定量落地、来源许可、去重、单位归一化，并对81个案例进行领域专家评审与标注。初步评估对比 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.7-Max、GPT-4o-mini。

Result: 初步评估中，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 获得最高证据ID F1（0.360），其次为 Qwen3.7-Max（0.316）与 GPT-4o-mini（0.294），整体分数偏低，显示任务难度较大。

Conclusion: BioPhys-Bridge 是用于评估归因、忠实性、幻觉抑制及生物实验设计的跨学科基准，支持复杂多步科学推理。未来将扩大数据规模与复杂度并开展全面评估，代码与数据已在 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 开放。

Abstract: Language models face unique challenges in analyzing interdisciplinary scientific research literature. In biophysics research, faithful answers require grounding observed data in source evidence, interpreting it through a quantitative physics model, and linking it to a biological mechanism. To address this challenge, we introduce BioPhys-Bridge, a novel benchmark dataset for evidence-grounded scientific reasoning over biophysical literature. Each case contains evidence blocks, stable evidence IDs, quantitative values, units, equations, assumptions, mechanisms, and next decisions as grounding targets for question answering (QA) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The initial release contains 500 cases, 1,517 agent-facing tasks, and covers six biological domains and nine physical model families, including three sparse families reserved for future expansion. We enforce strict quality gates for all cases in schema, evidence-integrity, quantitative-grounding, source-license, duplicate, unit-normalization, with domain expert review and annotation for 81 cases. Preliminary evaluations show that DeepSeek-V4-Flash obtain the highest evidence-ID $F_1$ score (0.360), followed by Qwen3.7-Max (0.316) and GPT-4o-mini (0.294). BioPhys-Bridge is an interdisciplinary benchmark for evaluating attribution, faithfulness, hallucination reduction, and biological experiment design with complex, multi-step scientific reasoning. Future works will increase the size and complexity of the dataset and perform comprehensive evaluations. Code and data are available in the GitHub repository and on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [400] [What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19182)
*Chao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文系统梳理了2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv上14,767篇评测资源论文，揭示LLM评测需求本身的变化趋势：任务目标愈发强调行动、交互与专业应用，设计要素新旧并存，模型参与评测（尤其是模型打分）增长不均，并提出"评测扩展是否带来独立证据、抑或复制模型偏好与盲区"的核心问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注模型排行榜与性能对比，但排名本身难以反映评测要求（即研究者对LLM的期待与成功标准）如何演变。作者希望从基准资源供给端切入，刻画评测设计规范与能力预期的变迁。

Method: 构建涵盖14,767篇2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv评测资源论文的语料库，采用分阶段筛选与自动化全文编码，系统提取并分析目标系统与领域、评测材料与条件、评分机制三类维度的变化，并区分agent与非agent分组进行比较。

Result: 评测资源呈现对行动、交互与专业应用的持续增强关注；成熟与新近设计要素高频共存。模型参与度发展不均：LLM作为评分者在agent与非agent组中均上升，而模型生成的评测材料在近期批次中未见同等持续增长。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了公共研究如何将能力预期转化为具体测试与成功标准。随着AI参与测试构建、任务执行与结果评判，评测扩展未必等价于独立证据的增加，可能带来复制参与模型偏好与盲区的风险。

Abstract: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examine changes in target systems and domains, evaluation materials and conditions, and scoring mechanisms. The collection shows growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, while established and newer design elements frequently coexist. Model participation also develops unevenly: LLM-based scoring grows within both agent and non-agent groups, whereas model-generated materials show no comparable sustained increase in recent cohorts. These findings illuminate how public research translates capability expectations into concrete tests and criteria for success. As AI participates in constructing tests, performing tasks, and judging responses, they also raise a question: does expanding evaluation provide more independent evidence, or risk reproducing the preferences and blind spots of its participating models?

</details>


### [401] [Position: It is Time to Virtualize Foundation Models with a Self-evolving Operating System Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19203)
*Suparna Bhattacharya,Tarun Kumar,Cong Xu,Satish Kumar Mopur,Jiahao Li,Ashish Mishra,Aalap Tripathy,Annmary Justine Koomthanam,Martin Foltin,Ian Foster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张为从单体基础模型转向复合智能体系统的AI应用构建"基础模型操作系统"（FMOS）：在系统层虚拟化基础模型交互，使应用获得专属、可信、能力近乎无限的基础模型实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI技术栈高度碎片化：尽管MCP、A2A等协议缓解了工具与智能体的连接问题，但各框架仍各自嵌入隐式的运行时（状态、记忆、预算、护栏），导致行为不可移植、治理脆弱。作者将此类比为"操作系统出现之前的计算机时代"——每个程序都要重新实现基础服务，因此需要一层统一的操作系统抽象。

Method: 作为立场论文，本文不提出具体实现，而是提出FMOS的概念架构与设计主张：对外，FMOS像虚拟机抽象物理硬件那样虚拟化基础模型交互，向应用提供专属、可信、能力近乎无限的基础模型实例假象；对内，FMOS负责三大能力——跨记忆层级的知识编排、模型选择与资源分配、验证与策略执行。同时借鉴人脑"快直觉/慢审慎"的双系统切换机制，使FMOS学会判断何时介入、何时放任推理直接进行，并依据运行经验持续自适应调整策略。

Result: 本文未提供实验或量化结果，其"结果"为概念性论证：指出当前碎片化技术栈与操作系统前时代同构，论证FMOS作为系统层抽象的必要性与可行方向。

Conclusion: 作者结论是：AI领域需要一个基础模型操作系统作为统一的系统层，以虚拟化方式封装状态、记忆、预算、护栏等运行时服务，实现应用行为可移植与治理可控，并通过自适应策略在"快/慢"推理模式间智能切换。该主张为后续系统研究设定了议程。

Abstract: AI applications have shifted from single, monolithic foundation models (FM) to compound agentic systems. Yet today's stacks remain fragmented: even as protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) ease tool/agent connectivity, each framework embeds an implicit runtime for state, memory, budgets, and guardrails, making behavior non-portable and governance brittle. It mirrors computing before operating systems, when every program re-implemented basic services. This position paper argues that the field now needs a Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) -- a system layer that virtualizes FM interactions analogous to how virtual machines abstract physical hardware, giving applications the illusion of dedicated, trustworthy FM instances with effectively unbounded capabilities. Internally, the FMOS orchestrates knowledge across memory tiers, model selection and resource allocation, and verification and policy enforcement. Like the human brain switching between fast intuition and slow deliberation, the FMOS learns when to intervene and when to let inference proceed directly and continuously adapting its policies based on operational experience.

</details>


### [402] [What Do Current Systematic Generalization Tasks Miss? A Reasoning-Centered Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19212)
*Chengwen Qi,Deheng Ye,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出TranSGrid测试平台，将演绎、归纳与溯因推理统一于同一任务，用以更全面地刻画系统泛化能力，指出既有任务的简化会削弱归纳与溯因需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统泛化（通过重组已知原子元素解决新问题）是人类智能的核心，但难以在受控条件下严格研究。现有研究依赖三类简化：近似线性的动作组合、基于产出性的测试、以及动作显式的目标。这些简化便于研究，却遗漏了系统泛化的若干本质方面，因此需要一个新的测试平台来揭示这些简化遗漏了什么。

Method: 作者采用以推理为中心的视角，构建TranSGrid测试平台，将演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理整合进统一任务。使用七个Transformer模型在4,800个TranSGrid实例上进行实验，并设置两个变体：一个使动作近似线性组合（降低归纳需求），另一个使目标动作显式化（降低溯因需求），以检验单一简化是否足以将任务退化为普通留出测试集。

Result: 所有模型在TranSGrid上的表现显著低于留出测试集：最大模型在测试集上解决79.6%，在TranSGrid上仅55.3%，在最难子集上仅15.8%。该差距在训练长度范围内依然存在，表明仅凭产出性不足以评估系统泛化。引入两个简化变体后，解决率均回升至接近测试集水平，说明任一简化单独就足以将TranSGrid降为普通留出测试集。

Conclusion: 现有任务降低或同时降低了归纳与溯因需求；要全面衡量系统泛化，需要同时涉及演绎、归纳与溯因三种推理形式的任务。

Abstract: Systematic generalization, the ability to solve novel problems by recombining known atomic elements, is central to human intelligence but difficult to study rigorously under controlled settings. Existing studies therefore rely on simplifications such as approximately linear action composition, productivity-based tests, and action-explicit goals, which make systematic generalization easier to study but omit some essential aspects of this capability. To characterize what these simplifications miss, we adopt a reasoning-centered lens and introduce TranSGrid, a testbed that brings deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning together within a unified task. Experiments with seven Transformers on 4,800 TranSGrid instances show that all models perform much worse on TranSGrid than on a held-out test set: the largest model solves 79.6% of the test set, but only 55.3% of TranSGrid and 15.8% of the hardest subset. The gap remains within the training length range, showing that productivity alone is not sufficient to evaluate systematic generalization. Additionally, we reintroduce the other two simplifications into TranSGrid: one variant makes actions compose almost linearly (reducing the inductive demand), the other makes goals action-explicit (reducing the abductive one). In both, solve rates return to roughly the test set level, showing that either simplification alone is enough to reduce TranSGrid to an ordinary held-out test set. Together, our results show that existing tasks reduce either or both of the inductive and abductive demands, and that comprehensively measuring systematic generalization requires a task that involves all three forms of reasoning.

</details>


### [403] [Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19244)
*Mahsa Amani,Seungeon Lee,Abhisek Dash,Asmaa El Fraihi,Yunah Jang,Elisabeth Kirsten,Qinyuan Wu,Krishna P. Gummadi,Manish Gupta,Abhilasha Ravichander,Muhammad Bilal Zafar,Soumi Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个跨ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四大平台的智能体搜索生命周期研究，结合真实用户交互与API控制实验，揭示联网决策、查询策略、域偏好与结果转化各环节的平台差异及可靠性风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式LLM智能体日益依赖Web搜索，但其"智能体搜索"的端到端生命周期（何时检索、如何构造查询、返回何种结果、如何生成回答）仍缺乏系统理解，亟需刻画其质量与潜在偏见。

Method: 采用双重方法：invivo（真实用户交互数据）与invitro（通过各平台API调用相同模型进行控制实验）相结合，覆盖ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四个主流对话平台，考察四个环节——触发Web搜索的智能体决策质量、查询构造策略、搜索结果中的域偏好、以及将检索结果转化为有据回答的选择行为。

Result: 联网搜索决策在不同平台与模型间差异显著，且更频繁触发搜索并不必然带来更高质量回答；各对话智能体采用不同的复杂查询策略；平台特定搜索引擎倾向于返回其偏好域名的结果；回答虽大体基于搜索结果，但部分论断依赖未被引用的检索结果，引发归因与可靠性担忧。

Conclusion: 该研究首次系统刻画了对话式智能体搜索的全生命周期，揭示决策异质性、域偏好与引用不完整等关键问题，对未来面向对话检索优化的AI智能体与Web搜索工具设计具有重要启示。

Abstract: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search results they receive, and the choices they make when transforming search results into grounded responses. We find that Web-search decisions vary substantially across platforms and models, while more frequent Web-search invocation does not necessarily yield better response quality. We further show that conversational agents employ different complex querying strategies and that platform specific search engines return search results from their preferred domains. Finally, although responses are largely grounded in search results, some claims rely on uncited search results, raising concerns about attribution and reliability. Our findings have important implications for the design of future AI agents and Web search tools optimized for conversational retrieval.

</details>


### [404] [Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19387)
*Ambika Sharan,Grigory Chirkov,Soheil Abbasloo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoTuring 通过在固定智能体与问题空间的前提下，仅改变"问题是否有语义"这一变量来区分智能体是真正理解架构，还是在对无意义参数做盲目搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有报告只能证明设计被改进了，却无法说明改进的成因：智能体可能真的在推理机器结构，也可能只是熟练地在它从未理解含义的旋钮上搜索，而只有前者才能迁移到下一个架构。既有评测无法区分二者，因为它们改变的是智能体，而把问题的表述固定不变。

Method: AutoTuring 采用相反的做法：让同一个智能体两次面对同样的 15 维加速器空间——一次是带模拟器计数器的具名架构旋钮，一次是 [0,1] 上的匿名变量；评测器、合法空间与可达最优解保持完全一致，唯一变量是问题是否有意义。两者之间的差距即为测量量。实验在九核 FP16 GEMM 测试集上进行。

Result: 语义带来收益：架构师智能体平均比建模的 H200 高 5.4%，比其盲版本高 12.3%，且模拟器调用减少 70.1%。但该收益并非独有：批判者回路（critic loop）能为盲版本挽回大部分差距，而对架构师版本毫无增益，说明架构知识与结构化批判之间是替代关系而非互补关系。

Conclusion: 作者将结果作为初步发现报告——每个条件 5 至 6 次运行，仅限单一建模加速器——并认为贡献在于这一比较方法本身，而非加速器设计成果。

Abstract: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. An agent that improves an accelerator may be reasoning about the machine, or may be searching competently over knobs whose meaning it never recovers -- and only the first transfers to the next architecture. Existing evaluations cannot tell the two apart, because they vary the agent while holding the framing of the problem fixed. We do the opposite. AutoTuring hands the same agent the same 15-dimensional accelerator space twice: once as named architectural knobs with simulator counters, once as anonymous variables on [0,1], with the evaluator, the legal space and the reachable optima held identical, so that the only thing that varies is whether the problem means anything. The gap between the two is the measurement. On a nine-kernel FP16 GEMM basket, meaning pays: the architect beats a modeled H200 by 5.4% and its blind counterpart by 12.3% on average, with 70.1% fewer simulator calls. It does not pay uniquely: a critic loop recovers most of that gap for the blind agent and buys the architect nothing, so architectural knowledge and structured critique behave as substitutes rather than as complements. We report these as preliminary findings -- five to six runs per condition on a single modeled accelerator -- and take the comparison itself, not the accelerator, to be the contribution.

</details>


### [405] [MAGS: Multi-agent Auto-formalization Guarantees Safety for Agentic Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19391)
*Albert Wu,Nicholas Roberts,Tzu-Heng Huang,Haoran Lin,Gil Friedman,Sungjun Cho,Gabriel Orlanski,Frederic Sala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MAGS：多智能体框架，以Dafny为验证中间表示，为LLM生成的代码提供形式化安全保证，在220个样例上实现100%成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM编码智能体生成复杂程序的规模使人工审查愈发困难，安全与安全（security）失败风险上升。模糊测试、静态分析、LLM-as-a-Verifier等方法虽有检测能力，但难以覆盖所有边界情况；形式化验证可提供机器可检验的保证，却历来依赖大量人工规格编写与证明工程。

Method: 提出统一多智能体框架MAGS：将人工审核过的API与安全需求形式化并冻结；把生成的代码翻译为验证感知中间表示Dafny；利用验证器反馈修复违规；再将验证通过的程序编译回可执行代码。

Result: 在100个CUDA内核、100个终端脚本、20个机械臂任务共220个样例上，针对冻结规格生成具有非平凡安全保证的程序，成功率达100%。独立的安全性与功能性评估在三个领域均表现强劲，同时暴露出当自动形式化语义未能完全刻画目标行为时出现的失败案例。

Conclusion: MAGS通过“冻结规格+Dafny验证+反馈修复”的闭环，将形式化验证引入LLM代码生成流程，实现了可扩展的机器可检验安全保证；其局限在于自动形式化语义的保真度，语义刻画不足会导致验证通过但行为不符的失败。

Abstract: LLM coding agents now generate complex programs at a scale that makes thorough human review increasingly difficult, raising the risk of safety and security failures. Common approaches, including fuzz testing, static analysis, and LLM-as-a-Verifier, can detect many failures but struggle to cover all possible edge cases. Formal verification addresses this by providing machine-checkable guarantees over specified properties, but traditionally demands substantial manual specification and proof engineering. We introduce a unified multi-agent framework, MAGS, that generates executable programs with formal safety guarantees, using Dafny as a verification-aware intermediate representation where safety properties can be mechanically checked. MAGS formalizes and freezes human-audited APIs and safety requirements, translates generated code into Dafny, repairs violations using verifier feedback, and compiles verified programs back into executable code. We evaluate MAGS on 100 CUDA kernels, 100 terminal scripts, and 20 robotic-arm tasks. Across all 220 examples, it achieves a 100% success rate in producing programs with non-trivial safety guarantees against frozen specifications. Independent safety and functional evaluations further show strong performance across all three domains, while revealing failures when the auto-formalized semantics do not fully capture the target behavior.

</details>


### [406] [Closed-World Resolution Against Tool Hallucination in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19425)
*Laxmipriya Ganesh Iyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文指出工具增强LLM智能体存在一个结构性盲区：幻觉工具调用（调用不存在的工具、传入无schema声明的参数），现有工具选择与安全门控方法都预设调用指向真实工具，因而无法拦截。作者给出五类工具幻觉分类（H1–H5）、提出训练无关的闭世界解析器Resolution Rung，并论证幻觉防御必须先于任何因果门控。他们跨十个托管模型测量到322次真实幻觉，并扩展到MCP场景（第二套分类M1–M5）测得154次幻觉，同时发布HTB基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有防御分两类：工具选择（选对工具）与门控（约束智能体对真实工具的使用）。二者都预设"发出的调用指向真实工具"，因此对幻觉调用天然失效——幻觉调用在构造上就不是任何门控所做的决策，门控无法拒绝它。这构成一个未被工具选择或工具安全方法覆盖的结构性盲区，需要专门测量与基准化。

Method: 采用测量与基准研究范式：(1) 建立五类工具幻觉分类（H1–H5）；(2) 提出参考实现Resolution Rung——训练无关的闭世界解析器，由注册表成员检查与签名校验组成，重点不在其计算内容而在其应处位置；(3) 给出形式化论证：幻觉防御必须先于任何因果门控，并刻画唯一不可约残余（借用参数与合法调用在schema上不可区分）；(4) 在两个调用接口下对十个托管模型测量；(5) 扩展到Model Context Protocol，提出第二套分类（M1–M5）并在实时MCP接口上测量。
