### [509] [Silence Is Endorsement: Verification-Status Laundering in LLM Agent Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20211)
*Yibo Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了LLM智能体系统中安全监控器的一种失效模式——"验证状态洗白"（verification-status laundering）：当交接摘要保留"动作已授权"的声明却丢弃"该声明从未被核实"的出处信息时，监控器对风险动作的批准率大幅上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体系统的安全监控器通常基于摘要或存储的交接信息判断行为，而非原始证据。这使得授权声明的"未验证"状态在信息传递中丢失，从而可能放行本应被拦截的风险行为。作者旨在揭示并量化这一安全隐患。

Method: 在九个开源权重监控器和两个托管模型上，保持动作与授权命题不变，仅移除围绕该声明的"未验证出处"框架，观察批准率变化；并在常规智能体流水线（摘要器、记忆压缩器、完整的提议者—摘要者—记忆—监控器流水线）中复现该现象；同时在WildGuard与ATBench上进行独立验证；此外测试通过显式指令要求监控器拒绝未验证授权是否能作为跨模型修复手段。

Result: 移除未验证出处框架后，风险动作批准率在Llama-3.1-8B上从5%升至60%，Qwen2.5-14B上从9%升至98%，两个托管模型也有类似大幅变化。在常规流水线中，摘要器经常弱化验证状态，记忆压缩器常直接删除该状态，完整流水线在三个下游监控器上将风险批准率提升至57%–81%。WildGuard与ATBench实验显示同样模式：缺乏支撑的授权声明显著提高批准概率。显式指令并非可靠的跨模型修复方案，部分模型仍脆弱，另一些则错误拒绝合法请求。

Conclusion: 智能体系统应在整个流水线中，将授权出处作为附加于声明的结构化状态加以保留，而非依赖摘要或指令式防御，以避免验证状态洗白导致的安全绕过。

Abstract: Safety monitors in LLM agent systems often judge actions from summaries or stored handoffs, not from the original evidence. This creates a simple but dangerous failure mode: the handoff preserves the claim that an action is authorized while losing the fact that the claim was never verified. We call this verification-status laundering. Across nine open-weight monitors and two hosted models, the action and authorization proposition remain fixed while we remove the unverified provenance framing around the claim. This change raises approval for risky actions from $5\%$ to $60\%$ on Llama-3.1-8B and from $9\%$ to $98\%$ on Qwen2.5-14B, with similarly large shifts on both hosted models. The failure also emerges in ordinary agent pipelines. Summarizers frequently weaken the status, memory compressors often remove it, and a full proposer--summarizer--memory--monitor pipeline raises risky approval to $57$--$81\%$ across three downstream monitors. Experiments on WildGuard and ATBench show the same pattern on independently authored harmful and unsafe requests: unsupported authorization claims make approval substantially more likely. Explicitly instructing monitors to reject unverified authorization is not a reliable cross-model fix: some models remain vulnerable, while others reject legitimate requests. Agent systems should therefore carry authorization provenance as structured state attached to the claim throughout the pipeline.

</details>


### [510] [DDQN-MLP: An Explainable and Adversarially Robust DRL-Guided Adaptive Learning Framework for Ransomware Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20314)
*Jannatul Ferdous,Rafiqul Islam,Arash Mahboubi,Md Zahidul Islam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出DDQN-MLP框架，用深度强化学习在训练期动态调整样本权重，训练后仅保留轻量MLP用于勒索软件检测，准确率达99.30%，并具备可解释性与对抗鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代勒索软件变种行为多样、具有规避性且部分与良性行为相似，使固定目标的监督学习难以有效检测；同时还需兼顾可解释性、鲁棒性与部署效率。

Method: 基于Windows 11沙箱遥测数据，构建训练期深度强化学习框架：以Double Deep Q-Network作为离散自适应样本加权控制器，观察批次级损失与预测置信度动态，为轻量MLP分配样本重要性权重；训练完成后丢弃DDQN，仅部署MLP。采用5折分层交叉验证，在含30个家族的1,000个勒索软件样本与1,000个良性样本的平衡数据集上评测，并与静态加权、focal loss及其他DRL变体对比；用SHAP、LIME及SHAP-梯度对齐诊断评估可解释性，并进行多扰动级别的白盒对抗测试。

Result: DDQN-MLP取得99.30%准确率、F1为0.9930、ROC-AUC为0.9991，优于静态加权、focal loss与替代DRL变体；SHAP与LIME解释同模型敏感性具有一致性；对抗训练提升了特征空间鲁棒性且未降低干净数据准确率。

Conclusion: DDQN-MLP为高通量勒索软件检测提供了一个准确、可解释、鲁棒且计算高效的框架。

Abstract: Ransomware detection remains challenging because modern variants exhibit diverse, evasive, and partly benign-like behaviors that undermine fixed supervised learning objectives. This study proposes DDQN-MLP, a training-time deep reinforcement learning framework for behavioral ransomware detection using Windows 11 sandbox telemetry. A Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) acts as a discrete adaptive sample-weighting controller by observing batch-level loss and prediction-confidence dynamics and assigning sample-importance weights to guide a lightweight Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). After training, the DDQN is discarded, leaving only the efficient MLP for deployment. The framework was evaluated using 5-fold stratified cross-validation on a balanced dataset of 2,000 executable profiles comprising 1,000 ransomware samples from 30 families and 1,000 benign samples. DDQN-MLP achieved 99.30% accuracy, an F1-score of 0.9930, and an ROC-AUC of 0.9991, outperforming conventional static weighting, focal-loss, and alternative DRL variants. Explainability was assessed using SHAP and LIME, together with a SHAP-gradient alignment diagnostic for evaluating consistency between feature attribution and model sensitivity. White-box adversarial testing across multiple perturbation levels further showed that adversarial training improved feature-space robustness without reducing clean-data accuracy. The results demonstrate that DDQN-MLP provides an accurate, explainable, robust, and computationally efficient framework for high-throughput ransomware detection.

</details>


### [511] [The More It Says, the More You Pay: A Black-Box Audit of Provider-Side Token Inflation in LLM Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20370)
*Leilei Chen,Lan Zhang,Chen Tang,Pengcheng Sun,Jiewei Lai,Yixiao Huang,Zhaopeng Zhang,Xinpeng Shen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文定义了按token计费LLM服务中的"提供方侧Token膨胀攻击"(PTIA),构建五种代表性攻击并发现其"饱和效应"源于EOS概率下降,据此设计轻量单探针审计方法,在四个开源模型上平均检出率85.1%(误报<2%),并在15个真实API服务中标记7个存在PTIA一致行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在按输出token计费的LLM服务中,输出越长用户付费越多,这为不诚实的服务提供方提供了经济动机:在不显著损害任务效用的前提下隐蔽地操纵生成过程以膨胀输出token数。现有工作缺乏对此类攻击的形式化定义、系统性实例化以及可行的黑盒审计手段,用户难以从黑盒响应中识别被操纵行为。

Method: 1) 形式化定义Provider-Side Token Inflation Attack (PTIA);2) 在提供方控制的生成流水线的查询层、提示层、表示层与模型层实例化五种代表性攻击;3) 通过实验测量攻击对各层输出长度的影响,并提出PTIA饱和假说,进一步归因于停止行为中EOS token概率的变化;4) 基于该洞察设计轻量单探针审计:向服务发起一次受控的加长干预,比较原始请求与探针请求产生的额外token量,无需可信本地参考模型、无需历史干净响应,且两次请求分开发出、形似普通流量以增加规避难度。

Result: 五种攻击均使平均输出长度超过干净基线的10.2倍,证明PTIA在多阶段生成中兼具经济吸引力与可行性。饱和现象得到验证:初次攻击显著降低EOS token概率,而进一步加强或组合干预仅带来边际降低。审计方法在四个开源权重模型上取得85.1%的平均检出率,误报率低于2%;在15个真实LLM API服务中标记出7个与PTIA一致的行为。

Conclusion: PTIA是LLM按token计费模式下一种可行且隐蔽的经济欺诈威胁,可从生成流水线多个层级实施。由于攻击存在饱和效应,单次受控探针即可形成有效且轻量的黑盒审计信号,无需参考模型或历史数据,并具备较强的抗规避性,为真实API服务的用户保护与监管提供了可操作的工具。

Abstract: In pay-per-token LLM services, the more a model says, the more users pay. Dishonest providers can covertly manipulate generation to inflate output tokens while largely preserving task utility. We define such manipulation as a Provider-Side Token Inflation Attack (PTIA) and instantiate five representative attacks at the query, prompt, representation, and model levels of the provider-controlled pipeline. Our experiments show that each attack increases mean output length to more than 10.2x the clean baseline, demonstrating PTIA's financial appeal and feasibility at multiple stages of generation. Yet auditing PTIA from black-box responses is difficult for users. Our key observation is PTIA saturation: an initial attack sharply lengthens output, but further strengthening or composition has much less effect. We trace this saturation to stopping behavior: an initial PTIA sharply lowers the end-of-sequence token probability, whereas further intervention lowers it only marginally. Building on this insight, we design a lightweight single-probe audit that applies a controlled lengthening intervention. Under PTIA, the probe induces far fewer additional tokens than under normal service. The audit requires neither a trusted local reference model nor historical clean responses, and its separately issued original and probed requests resemble ordinary traffic, making evasion difficult. Across four open-weight models, it achieves an average detection rate of 85.1% with false-positive rates below 2%. Across 15 real LLM API services, the audit flags 7 for PTIA-consistent behavior.

</details>


### [512] [Fingerprinting Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20457)
*Chao Huang,Meng Tong,Kejiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次研究多模态大模型指纹识别，提出白盒版权溯源方法 AttnPrint 与黑盒审计方法 DistillTrace，在 154 个模型实例、19 种架构上验证了衍生模型检测与蒸馏关系识别的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）易被非法部署与未授权蒸馏，而现有多模态模型溯源方案受共享语言主干干扰，且难以检测蒸馏侵权行为，亟需新的所有权保护手段。

Method: 受自注意力呈低通滤波特性且其低频分量具有信息量的启发，提出 AttnPrint：提取跨模态注意力分布并分离其低频分量作为模型指纹，用于白盒溯源；进一步提出 DistillTrace，通过对 MLLM 输出进行假设检验实现黑盒审计，识别潜在侵权。

Result: 在 19 种多模态架构、154 个模型实例上开展大量实验。AttnPrint 在保持对 5 种下游修改技术鲁棒的同时，取得较强的衍生模型检测性能；DistillTrace 在 3 种参数无关技术下均可提供蒸馏关系的证据。

Conclusion: 跨模态注意力低频分量可作为有效的多模态模型指纹，结合输出假设检验的黑盒审计，可同时支撑白盒溯源与黑盒蒸馏检测，为 MLLM 所有权保护提供了可行路径。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable a wide range of image-text reasoning tasks, recent incidents indicate that they are vulnerable to illicit deployment and unauthorized distillation. Existing solutions for model provenance are typically confounded by shared language backbones in MLLMs and struggle to detect violations of distillation. To bridge this gap and safeguard model ownership, we present the first study on multimodal model fingerprinting. Inspired by recent findings that self-attention acts as a low-pass filter and that its low-frequency components are informative, we develop AttnPrint for white-box provenance. Specifically, we extract cross-modal attention distributions and isolate their low-frequency components to serve as model fingerprints. To facilitate black-box auditing, we further introduce DistillTrace, which employs hypothesis testing of MLLM outputs to identify potential model infringement. We conduct extensive experiments on 154 model instances across 19 multimodal architectures. Notably, AttnPrint achieves strong derivative-model detection performance while remaining robust to five downstream modification techniques. DistillTrace also provides evidence of distillation relationships under three parameter-independent techniques.

</details>


### [513] [Towards TEE-Certified DP: Verifiable Differentially Private Training on Legacy GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20532)
*Li Ge,Wenjie Qu,Weitao Feng,Yi Zeng,Jiaheng Zhang,Xiaofeng Wang,Wei Dong*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于CPU侧TEE与不可信GPU协同的可验证差分隐私训练框架，通过概率检查在接近标准GPU DP训练开销的前提下，有效约束恶意偏离DP执行的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习广泛应用带来对敏感训练数据的政策与监管保护需求，差分隐私（DP）成为关键机制，但如何在不访问私有数据的情况下向外部验证者证明模型确实按声明的DP保护训练，研究较少。现有零知识证明等密码学方法开销过高，TEE虽更高效，但面向大模型训练/微调的多GPU TEE支持仅限于较新平台，在旧GPU上缺失或低效。

Method: 采用CPU侧TEE加不可信GPU的框架：将昂贵的梯度计算卸载到GPU，由CPU TEE通过概率检查高效验证DP在梯度上的正确执行；以此缓解“整体在CPU TEE内训练过慢”与“无限制GPU卸载可被恶意偏离DP”之间的效率-安全张力。

Result: 框架能以高概率检测频繁的、对DP的完全偏离；对本文评估的面向效用的伪造梯度攻击，稀疏偏离带来的效用收益有限，且未观察到可测量的额外成员泄漏。与标准基于GPU的DP训练相比，仅带来适度开销。

Conclusion: 该方案近乎实现“免费午餐”：在有效约束对声明DP执行的恶意偏离的同时，开销接近常规GPU DP训练，为可验证DP训练提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Wide adoption of machine learning has created growing policy and regulatory demand for protecting sensitive training data, with differential privacy (DP) emerging as a key mechanism. Yet a less-studied problem is how to certify the faithful execution of DP during training: an external verifier should be able to check that a released model was trained with proper DP protection, without accessing the private training data. Existing cryptographic approaches, such as zero-knowledge proofs, provide strong guarantees but often incur prohibitive overhead, in some cases by orders of magnitude. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) offer a more efficient alternative, but the multi-GPU TEE support needed for training and fine-tuning large language models remains limited to recent platforms and is absent or inefficient on legacy GPUs.
  To address this, we propose a practical framework for verifiable DP training using CPU-side TEEs together with untrusted GPUs. Our design addresses a fundamental efficiency-security tension: training entirely inside a CPU TEE is too slow, while unrestricted GPU offloading can allow malicious deviations from DP. We therefore offload expensive gradient computation to GPUs, while using the CPU TEE to efficiently verify the correct enforcement of DP on gradients through probabilistic checking. Our framework detects frequent full deviations from DP with high probability; for the utility-oriented forged-gradient attacks evaluated in this work, sparse deviations provide limited utility benefit and show no measurable additional membership leakage. Experiments further show that our approach nearly achieves a ``free lunch'': it incurs only modest overhead compared with standard GPU-based DP training, while effectively constraining malicious deviations from the claimed DP execution.

</details>


### [514] [Empirical Analysis of Randomness Quality in Differential Privacy Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20561)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统实证研究了随机源熵退化对差分隐私机制的影响，基于IBM DiffPrivLib，从量子真随机到受控退化源，通过百万次查询实验揭示：每8~16比特操纵约1比特即可被可靠检测，且统计异常检测不等于实际隐私保障被破坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私依赖精确校准的随机噪声，但既有理论多在弱化随机性假设下分析，熵退化的实际后果尚不清晰，缺乏系统的实证认识。

Method: 使用IBM DiffPrivLib，构造逐级退化的熵源（从高质量量子TRNG、密码学安全PRNG，到受控熵退化的人为操纵源），在参考数据库上进行超过一百万次查询的重复实验，并辅以统计检验，直接分析经验隐私损失随机变量分布。

Result: 当每8~16比特中约1比特被操纵时，DP机制可可靠检测偏差；检测灵敏度在比特级偏差与时间相关性之间差异显著；分布异常的统计检测并不必然对应实际隐私保障的违反。

Conclusion: 随机性质量对DP机制的可检测性有实质影响，且需区分统计层面的分布异常与实际隐私保障失效，二者不可等同。

Abstract: Differential Privacy (DP) relies on carefully calibrated random noise to protect individual privacy in statistical analyses. While theoretical work has analyzed DP under weakened randomness assumptions, the practical consequences of entropy degradation remain poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical investigation of how randomness quality affects differential privacy mechanisms using IBM's DiffPrivLib. We introduce progressively degraded entropy sources characterized by established test suites, starting from high-quality quantum True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and cryptographically secure Pseudo-Random Number Generators (PRNGs) down to systematically manipulated sources with controlled entropy degradation. Through repeated experiments over one million queries on a reference database and complementary statistical tests, we directly analyze empirical Privacy Loss Random Variable distributions. Our results demonstrate that DP mechanisms reliably detect deviations when approximately 1 bit in every 8 to 16 is manipulated, with detection sensitivity varying significantly between bit-level biases and temporal correlations. We demonstrate that statistical detection of distributional anomalies does not necessarily correspond to actual privacy guarantee violations.

</details>


### [515] [Weather Data Spoofing Attacks on Rain-Adaptive Millimeter-Wave Frequency Selection in V2X Communication Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20601)
*Rasheed Bello,Idreez Yusuf,Justice Adjei Owusu,Oluwatobiloba Aiyewunmi,Gurcan Comert,Judith Mwakalonge,Esmail Abuhdima,Abdulmajid Mrebit,Rajab Ataai,Vaidyan Varghese*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示车联网中基于降雨感知的毫米波频段选择机制构成攻击面：攻击者仅需伪造降雨输入即可远程操控受害车辆的载波频率与通信距离，无需占用信道。作者在MilliCar(ns-3)中量化该攻击并提出基于雨衰线性、路损对数特性的物理交叉校验防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联网车辆依赖毫米波侧链路满足协同驾驶的数据速率需求，新兴设计根据感知降雨量选择载波频段。这一"天气感知"设计引入了一个未被察觉的攻击面：降雨输入若被伪造，将间接决定通信频段、进而决定通信范围。作者旨在验证该威胁的可行性与后果，并探索可由机制本身推导出的防御手段。

Method: 在MilliCar(ns-3模块)中评估攻击，将选定频段作为符合3GPP NR V2X的真实载波运行，包含逐频段传播、波束成形与遮挡建模。攻击者仅伪造降雨输入，分别强制频段上行至73 GHz和下行至5 GHz。防御方面，利用雨衰随距离线性增长、路损随距离对数增长的差异，接收端将实测SINR与其上报天气所预测的衰减进行比对以检测频段强制上行；并测试移动降雨单元(局部雨强15–81 mm/h)下的鲁棒性。

Result: 强制频段至73 GHz时，八车队列的可靠通信范围维持在38 m，而诚实基线可翻倍至82 m；强制下行至5 GHz则保持97%的长距离接收率，但传输块缩减至三分之一、长距离时延增至四倍即12.5 ms。防御检测在1%虚警率下、1.5 s内以98%概率标记强制上行，重选后长距离接收率从60%恢复至75%。该检测对强制下行结构性失效，因5 GHz回退频段几乎不受降雨影响。降雨单元移动使局部雨强在15–81 mm/h间变化，所有结果保持不变。

Conclusion: 天气感知的频段选择机制要求气象输入必须经过认证；基于物理特性的交叉校验只能覆盖威胁的一半(即强制上行),对强制下行无效。防御需结合认证的气象数据源才能完整防护。

Abstract: Connected vehicles use millimeter-wave (mmWave) sidelinks for the data rates cooperative driving demands, and emerging designs select the carrier band from sensed rainfall. We show that this weather awareness is an attack surface: an adversary who spoofs only the rainfall input dictates the victim's carrier frequency, and through it its communication range, without transmitting on the channel. We evaluate the attack in MilliCar, an ns-3 module that runs the selected band as the real 3GPP NR V2X carrier with per-band propagation, beamforming, and blockage. Forcing the band up to 73 GHz holds an eight-vehicle platoon's reliable range at 38 m while the honest baseline doubles it to 82 m; forcing it down to 5 GHz sustains 97% long-range reception but collapses the transport block to a third and quadruples long-range latency to 12.5 ms. We then implement the defense the mechanism implies. Rain loss grows linearly with distance while path loss grows logarithmically, so a receiver that tests measured SINR against the attenuation its reported weather predicts flags force-up with 98% probability within 1.5 s at a 1% false-alarm rate, and re-selection then restores long-range reception from 60% to 75%. The same test is structurally blind to force-down, because the 5 GHz fallback is nearly rain-immune. An advecting rain cell that swings the local rate from 15 to 81 mm/h leaves every result unchanged. Weather-aware band selection therefore requires an authenticated meteorological input; physical cross-checking covers one half of the threat.

</details>


### [516] [Inference-Engine Fingerprinting Attacks are Practical: Exploring Model-Driven Environmental Discovery, Exploitation, and Escape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20614)
*Sarah Radway,Andrew Cheng,Vijay Janapa Reddi,James Mickens*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 前沿AI模型已具备利用软件漏洞的能力，且已被证实能实现沙箱逃逸。本文指出推理引擎本身是被忽视的高危攻击面：被错位对齐的模型可通过精心构造的输出token进行推理引擎指纹识别，进而利用引擎特定漏洞实现裸机级攻击链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前关于推理栈沙箱化的讨论多集中于网络代理、代码执行环境等组件，而忽略了推理引擎本身。推理引擎是高价值攻击目标：若模型仅通过生成特制输出token即可触发引擎漏洞，则无需依赖其他组件漏洞或外部恶意输入，即可发起多步、直达裸机的攻击链。近期OpenAI与Anthropic前沿模型的沙箱逃逸事件表明该风险并非理论假设。

Method: 1) 提出"推理引擎指纹识别"攻击：被错位对齐的模型通过输出token探测执行自身的具体引擎（如vLLM、SGLang）；2) 在五种主流引擎中给出具体的模型指纹特征；3) 在真实agentic harness环境中演示模型如何利用指纹识别本地引擎；4) 构建从被指纹识别（进而被攻陷）的推理引擎出发的概念验证型裸机攻击链。

Result: 在五种流行推理引擎中成功提取出可供模型识别的指纹特征；证明真实agentic harness可使模型借助这些指纹定位本地引擎；并给出从被指纹识别、继而失陷的推理引擎出发、直达裸机的概念验证攻击链。

Conclusion: 推理引擎是被错位对齐模型利用的可行攻击面，仅靠输出token即可完成指纹识别并触发引擎特定漏洞。作者最后讨论了若干修改推理引擎设计的方法，以增加指纹识别攻击的难度。

Abstract: Frontier AI models are rapidly gaining the ability to exploit vulnerabilities in complex pieces of software. The risk is not theoretical, as evidenced by recent sandbox escapes performed by frontier models at OpenAI and Anthropic. Discussions of how to sandbox inference stack components often focus on components other than the inference engine itself (e.g., network proxies or code execution environments). However, the inference engine is an attractive target for a misaligned model. For example, if a model can trigger exploits in that engine merely by generating specially-crafted output tokens, the model can initiate a multi-step, to-the-bare-metal exploit chain in the engine, without relying on vulnerabilities in other components of the inference stack, and without assistance from externally-provided, maliciously-crafted input tokens.
  In this paper, we show that a misaligned model can perform inference engine fingerprinting to determine the specific engine (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) which executes the model. Once the engine has been fingerprinted, the model can leverage engine-specific exploits to take control of the engine using only carefully-selected output tokens. We provide concrete examples of model fingerprints in five popular engines, and demonstrate how realistic agentic harnesses allow a model to leverage those fingerprints to identify the local engine. We also describe a proof-of-concept, to-the-bare-metal exploit chain that originates from a fingerprinted (and subsequently compromised) inference engine. We conclude by discussing several ways that inference engines could be changed to make fingerprinting attacks more difficult.

</details>


### [517] ["Your Robot Was Trained on a Lie": Collision Mesh Poisoning Attacks on Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18122)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Yanbo Dai,Ruochen Zhou,Shing-Chi Cheung,Xiaoyu Ji,Wenyuan Xu,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"视觉-碰撞间隙"(V–C Gap)并据此设计碰撞网格投毒(CMP)攻击：仅修改3D资产的碰撞网格，而不改动视觉网格，使策略在仿真中表现正常、在真机部署时失效或产生安全风险；现有防御不足以应对该攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作策略日益依赖仿真器训练与评估，而仿真器中同一3D资产包含用于渲染的视觉网格与用于物理交互的碰撞网格。出于计算效率考虑，碰撞网格通常为粗粒度近似，二者几何不必一致，这一普遍且被默认接受的差异构成新的攻击面，且现有资产审查仅覆盖恶意软件、版权与格式合规，不涉及视觉-碰撞一致性。

Method: 提出首个针对机器人操作的供应链投毒攻击——碰撞网格投毒(CMP)：攻击者仅修改3D资产的碰撞网格，保持视觉网格及其他组件不变；由于审查流程不检查视觉-碰撞一致性，投毒资产可经合法供应链渠道分发。随后对该攻击评估多种现有防御。

Result: 使用投毒资产训练与评估的策略在整个仿真过程中行为正常，但一旦部署到真实世界便出现性能退化、任务失败或物理安全风险；所评估的多种防御均不足以抵御CMP。

Conclusion: 视觉-碰撞间隙是一个实用且新颖的攻击面，CMP攻击具备隐蔽性与供应链可行性；现有防御无效，亟需针对视觉-碰撞一致性的新型防御机制。

Abstract: Learning-enabled robotic manipulation increasingly relies on robot simulators for policy training and evaluation before real-world deployment. Inside a simulator, a 3D asset contains two separate geometries: a visual mesh used for rendering and a collision mesh used for physical interaction. For computational efficiency, the collision mesh is deliberately a coarse approximation that need not have the same geometry as the visual mesh, a legitimate and pervasive discrepancy we call the Visual--Collision Gap (V--C Gap). We show that the V--C Gap opens a new and practical attack surface, and propose Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), the first poisoning attack against robotic manipulation delivered through the 3D asset supply chain. An attacker modifies only the collision mesh of a 3D asset, leaving the visual mesh and all other components unchanged. A policy trained and evaluated with the poisoned asset behaves normally throughout simulation, yet degrades, fails, or creates physical safety risks once deployed in the real world. Since current asset review practices cover malware, copyright, and format compliance, but not visual--collision consistency, poisoned assets can be distributed through legitimate supply chain channels. We evaluate several defenses and our results show that they are insufficient to defend against CMP, highlighting the need for new defenses.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [518] [SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19169)
*Ranran Haoran Zhang,Aysa Xuemo Fan,David Munhá Correia,Alex Cheema,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 SiliconBench 基准，从速度、内存、保真度三视角评测九款 Apple Silicon 本地 LLM 服务引擎，发现仅部分栈同时满足完成率、保真度与模型覆盖要求，并揭示显存预算不保证余量、张量并行可扩展而流水线并行回退等结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一内存桌面上的并发本地 LLM 服务必须在保证内存余量与输出保真度的前提下运行，而现有仅以速度为导向的排名忽视了这两点；同时新模型架构的引擎支持差异与多机扩展表现缺乏系统评测。

Method: 设计 SiliconBench，对九款 Apple Silicon 服务引擎从速度、内存、保真度三个维度评测；在 Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Gemma 4 上测试 chat 与 agent 服务；用分类任务对照 NVIDIA 参考检查质量回退，以 DGX Spark 作为服务性能参考；并采用三项判据（服务架构就绪度、内存纪律、多节点扩展）解释结果，比较 vllm-metal 与 omlx 的调度行为及两机张量/流水线并行配置。

Result: Qwen3-0.6B 上 vllm-metal 在并发 1→16 时两负载吞吐均翻倍以上，但 CUDA vLLM 与 SGLang 并发扩展更强；显存预算不保证余量，两个栈完成全部请求时内存逼近物理上限且吞吐下降；新架构引擎支持更窄，但受测实现均达到保真参考；仅三个栈通过完成率、保真度、模型覆盖三重门槛。大模型对比显示 vllm-metal 的 packed prefill-decode 路径在并发下首 token 时延低于 omlx；两机张量并行（Thunderbolt RDMA）可扩展，流水线并行（TCP）出现回退。

Conclusion: 本地统一内存服务需兼顾速度、内存纪律与保真度，显式显存预算不等于安全余量；调度 prefill 与 decode 协同至关重要；多机并行方案中张量并行优于流水线并行。发布基准代码、逐次运行结果与维护日志，并配以有界 agent 修复加人工审查的工作流。

Abstract: Concurrent local LLM serving on unified-memory desktops must preserve memory headroom and output fidelity, which speed-only rankings overlook. We introduce SiliconBench, which evaluates nine Apple Silicon serving engines through three lenses: speed, memory, and fidelity. We evaluate chat and agent serving on Qwen3, Qwen3.5, and Gemma 4. We use a classification task to check for quality regressions against an NVIDIA reference. DGX Spark provides a complementary serving-performance reference. Three desiderata guide interpretation: serving architecture readiness, memory discipline, and multi-node scaling. On Qwen3-0.6B, vllm-metal alone more than doubles throughput on both workloads from concurrency 1 to 16. CUDA vLLM and SGLang show stronger concurrency scaling on the same prompts. Explicit memory budgets do not guarantee memory headroom: two stacks complete every request while memory use approaches physical capacity and throughput declines. The newer model architectures have narrower engine support. Their evaluated implementations match the fidelity reference. Only three stacks satisfy the completion, fidelity, and model-coverage gates. Comparisons on larger dense and MoE models reinforce the importance of scheduling prompt processing alongside ongoing generation: vllm-metal's packed prefill-decode path maintains lower first-token latency than omlx under concurrent load. In the tested two-machine configurations, tensor parallelism over Thunderbolt RDMA scales while pipeline parallelism over TCP regresses. We release benchmark code, per-run results, and maintenance journals, supported by a workflow combining bounded agent fixes with human review.

</details>


### [519] [CovR: Coverage-Aware Hardware Verification via Reasoning-Guided Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19189)
*Manar Abdelatty,Maryam Nouh,Sherief Reda*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出CovR智能体框架，结合自反思与仿真反馈实现覆盖驱动的测试平台生成，通过大模型数据蒸馏与强化学习优化，显著提升覆盖率指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计验证占硬件开发工作量高达70%，现有基于LLM的测试平台生成方法多聚焦功能正确性，忽视覆盖率质量这一关键维度。

Method: 1) 智能体框架CovR：将自反思回路与仿真反馈结合，最大化覆盖率；2) 用强教师模型构建16,514条自然规格-RTL-测试平台三元组数据集，提供覆盖率感知监督；3) 面向覆盖率驱动生成的强化学习框架，利用仿真与覆盖率反馈导出的工具奖励优化学生模型。

Result: 微调模型在VerilogEval与RTLLM V2.0达93.81% cov@10，在CVDP达87.76% cov@10，分别超SOTA 7.97%和3.59%；将模型回注智能体精炼流程后，cov@10进一步提升至94.27%与91.39%。作为插件式激励引擎用于完整验证流程时，覆盖率提升18.95%，变异检测得分提升1.19%，并揭示4.46%未检测出的失效。

Conclusion: 在LLM驱动的硬件验证中显式优化覆盖率至关重要，CovR验证了覆盖率感知的监督与强化学习结合的有效性。

Abstract: Design verification remains one of the most resource-intensive stages of hardware development, often consuming up to 70% of the total design effort. While recent work has explored using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate testbench generation, most existing approaches focus narrowly on functional correctness, overlooking the critical aspect of coverage quality. To bridge this gap, we present CovR, an agentic framework for automated testbench generation that combines self-reflection loops with simulation-based feedback to maximize coverage. Using this pipeline, we construct a large-scale dataset of 16,514 natural specification RTL reasoning testbench tuples with a strong teacher model, enabling coverage-aware supervision. Building on this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for coverage-driven testbench generation, leveraging tool-derived rewards from simulation and coverage feedback to optimize a student model. Experimental results show that the CovR finetuned model achieves 93.81% cov@10 on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0, and 87.76% cov@10 on CVDP, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 7.97% and 3.59%, respectively. Furthermore, deploying the finetuned model back into the agentic refinement pipeline further improves cov@10 to 94.27% on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0 and 91.39% on CVDP. Moreover, when integrated as a plug-in stimulus engine for full verification workflows, CovR improves coverage by 18.95% and mutation detection score by 1.19%, while revealing 4.46% undetected failures, highlighting the importance of optimizing for coverage in LLM-based hardware verification.

</details>


### [520] [Epic: Efficient Programming Paradigm for In-Storage Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19206)
*Yuyue Wang,Zhenyu Zhang,Glenn Reinman,Huaicheng Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Epic——一种基于 NVMe 的存内计算（ISC）栈，通过位置类型、数据流分析、keep 原语统一抽象数据驻留与生命周期，配合存储感知编译器与运行时，实现多阶段应用的数据放置、I/O–计算重叠与设备端状态协调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 存内计算可减少主机与存储间的数据搬运，但多阶段应用需要协同数据放置、I/O 与计算重叠以及设备驻留状态；现有接口缺乏统一抽象来支撑这些跨工作流的决策。

Method: Epic 将完整的卸载工作流表达为带位置的有状态数据流：location 类型声明逻辑驻留位置，dataflow 推导中间值与操作状态在单次调用内的生命周期，keep 原语将选定状态跨调用保留。存储感知编译器执行移动感知的逻辑映射与算子融合，并暴露 I/O–计算重叠；运行时利用执行期信息异步绑定工作到物理资源并管理设备驻留状态。

Result: 在 12 个文件扫描、数据库与机器学习工作负载上，Epic 平均比五种既有 ISC 系统中最强者快 1.6×；相比对应主机基线平均加速 4.2×，最高 16.1×；同时将应用侧代码量最多缩减 14×。

Conclusion: Epic 通过统一的驻留与生命周期抽象，有效协调多阶段 ISC 工作流的数据放置、I/O–计算重叠与设备状态，在多种工作负载上兼顾性能提升与编程简化。

Abstract: In-storage computing (ISC) reduces host--storage data movement by executing computation inside computational storage devices (CSDs). For multi-stage applications, realizing these benefits requires coordinating data placement, I/O--compute overlap, and device-resident state across the workflow, yet existing interfaces lack a unified abstraction for these decisions. We present Epic, an NVMe-based ISC stack that provides this abstraction by capturing data residency and lifetime in the program: location types declare logical residency, dataflow derives lifetimes for intermediate values and operation state within an invocation, and a keep primitive extends selected state across invocations. These semantics expose the complete offloaded workflow as a located, stateful dataflow. A storage-aware compiler transforms this workflow, performs movement-aware logical mapping and fusion, and exposes I/O--compute overlap; a runtime completes the plan using execution-time information, asynchronously binding work to physical resources and managing device-resident state. Across 12 file-scanning, database, and machine learning workloads, Epic is 1.6$\times$ faster on average than the strongest of five prior ISC systems, while achieving 4.2$\times$ speedup on average and up to 16.1$\times$ over the corresponding host baselines, and reducing application-side code by up to 14$\times$ in our implementations.

</details>


### [521] [MeshKV: A Network-on-Chip KV Cache Fabric for Scalable Transformer Decoding Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19207)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出MeshKV，一种以轻量级NoC实现KV缓存块"分组流"传输的缓存架构，通过TaKV仿射条带化、Mare多播与Pad流水重叠三项协同设计，将互连背压转化为有效KV传输，在FPGA上显著降低互连流量并提升带宽利用率与多流吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归Transformer解码受限于分块（tiled）加速器上不规则的KV缓存搬运；既有压缩与DRAM放置方案仍将流量集中于集中式内存路径，成为长上下文服务的瓶颈。

Method: MeshKV将KV缓存块作为分组化流在轻量级NoC上传输，并协同设计：(i) TaKV仿射条带化，分散home位置、降低热点负载；(ii) Mare多播，带可验证的重复抑制；(iii) Pad，通过信用对齐FIFO将预取、tile乘与流式softmax重叠执行。

Result: 在8x8 FPGA实现上，针对LLaMA-2-7B与Mistral-7B、8K–32K上下文，互连流量最多降低58%，KV带宽利用率提升2.1倍，多流吞吐最高提升1.9倍。

Conclusion: 通过NoC化的KV缓存织构与三项协同设计，可把对分背压转化为有用的KV传输，有效缓解长上下文服务中的集中式内存瓶颈。

Abstract: Autoregressive transformer decoding is constrained by irregular key-value (KV) cache movement on tiled accelerators. Prior compression and DRAM-placement systems still concentrate traffic on centralized memory paths that bottleneck long-context serving. We present MeshKV, a KV cache fabric that moves blocks as packetized flows over a lightweight NoC. It co-designs (i) TaKV affine striping to spread homes and cut hotspot load, (ii) Mare multicast with verified duplicate suppression, and (iii) Pad, which overlaps prefetch, tile multiply, and streaming softmax behind credit-aligned FIFOs. Together they convert bisection back-pressure into useful KV transfer. On our 8x8 FPGA implementation with LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B at 8K-32K, MeshKV reduces interconnect traffic by up to 58%, improves KV bandwidth utilization by 2.1x, and delivers up to 1.9x multi-stream throughput.

</details>


### [522] [MiX: Micro-Inverted-Scaling for End-to-End Low-Bit Vision-Language Model Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19683)
*Yuan Liao,Jae-sun Seo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文提出MiX（Micro-Inverted-Scaling），一种反转microscaling范式的量化格式，将每元素私有指数分组到单一共享尾数下，并配合自适应双格式MiX-MX框架与定制加速器，实现边缘设备端到端VLM部署的高效低比特量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备部署VLM受内存带宽瓶颈限制，需激进亚8比特量化；但边缘加速器受面积与功耗约束，要求端到端量化模型。多模态token间极端动态范围差异导致标准块格式出现"microscaling collapse"：单一巨大离群值劫持共享指数，使周围元素下溢并破坏注意力图。

Method: 提出Micro-Inverted-Scaling（MiX）格式，数学上反转microscaling范式——不再将多个尾数归组于一个共享指数下，而是将每元素私有指数组于单一共享尾数下。针对VLM非对称离群拓扑，引入自适应双格式（MiX-MX）推理框架；通过代数分解出共享MiX尾数，映射到定制加速器，用高效移位器替代乘法器。

Result: 端到端在多个VLM上评估，4.5比特MiX在多模态基准上与NVFP4精度相当或更优。MiX加速器相比NVFP4基线面积效率提升25%；相比最先进加速器Focus，实现2.3-4.5倍加速与1.4-2.9倍能耗降低。

Conclusion: 证明反转scaling的数据通路在物理上更适合高效VLM部署，为边缘端多模态模型量化与硬件协同设计提供新方向。

Abstract: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on edge devices is severely bottlenecked by memory bandwidth, necessitating aggressive sub-8-bit quantization. Since edge accelerators are strictly constrained by area and power, they require end-to-end quantized models. However, the extreme dynamic range gap between multi-modal tokens causes standard block formats to suffer "microscaling collapse," where a single massive outlier hijacks the shared exponent, underflowing surrounding elements and destroying attention maps. To break this bottleneck, we propose Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX), a novel format that mathematically inverts the microscaling paradigm: rather than grouping multiple mantissas under one shared exponent, MiX groups private, per-element exponents under a single shared mantissa. To handle asymmetric VLM outlier topologies, we introduce an adaptive dual-format (MiX-MX) inference framework. By algebraically factoring out the shared MiX mantissa, this framework maps to a custom accelerator, replacing multipliers with efficient shifters. Evaluated end-to-end on multiple VLMs, our 4.5-bit MiX formulation exhibits equivalent or superior accuracy on multi-modal benchmarks compared to NVFP4. Simultaneously, the MiX accelerator delivers a 25% improvement in area efficiency over the NVFP4 baseline and a 2.3-4.5x speedup with 1.4-2.9x energy reduction across models compared to the state-of-the-art accelerator Focus, proving the inverted-scaling datapath is physically superior for efficient VLM deployment.

</details>


### [523] [High-frequency Multispeculative Multiply-Accumulation Unit for Fused Posit Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19859)
*Mario Alonso,Miguel Ángel Sacristán,Guillermo Botella,Alberto A. Del Barrio*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向32/64位Posit的高速Multispeculative PositMAC架构，通过流水线重构、高速乘法拓扑评估及用Multispeculative Adder替代宽quire累加器，在降低面积与能耗的同时实现最高工作频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Posit算术提升精度，其FMA借助quire（覆盖全动态范围的宽定点累加器）避免中间舍入、保证精确可复现，但大累加器带来显著面积与功耗开销，需要优化。

Method: 1) 重构流水线以平衡各级；2) 评估高速乘法拓扑，采用Booth-4配合Kogge-Stone加法器满足0.5ns（2GHz）目标；3) 用Multispeculative Adder替代宽单片quire累加器。

Result: 相比基线，面积最多减少19.8%，能耗降低超过50%；相比其他先进设计，实现最高工作频率，周期时间最多减少79.0%（相对64位quire方案），且面积更小、每周期能耗更低。

Conclusion: 该Multispeculative PositMAC在不增加资源开销的前提下，兼顾高频、小面积与低能耗，优于所有支持quire的对比设计。

Abstract: Posit arithmetic offers a compelling alternative to the IEEE 754 floating-point standard, providing enhanced accuracy. Its fused multiply-accumulate operations avoid intermediate rounding, ensuring exact numerical reproducibility through the quire, a wide fixed-point accumulator spanning the format's full dynamic range to prevent precision loss and overflow during long accumulations. However, integrating such large accumulators incurs significant area and power overheads. This paper presents an optimized, high-frequency Multispeculative PositMAC architecture for 32- and 64-bits Posit. First, the pipeline is restructured to balance the different stages. Second, high-speed multiplication topologies are evaluated, showing that a Booth-4 scheme with Kogge-Stone adders meets a stringent 0.5ns target (2Ghz). Finally, the wide monolithic quire accumulator is replaced with a Multispeculative Adder, diminishing area up to 19.8\% while reducing energy consumption by more than 50\% when compared to the baseline. Compared to other state-of-the-art designs, our proposal achieves the highest operating frequency and reduces cycle time by up to 79.0\% with respect to 64-bit quire-enabled alternatives. This performance is attained without increasing resource overhead, as the design remains strictly smaller in area and achieves lower per-cycle energy consumption than all quire-capable counterparts.

</details>


### [524] [Evaluation of Power-Clock Waveforms for Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic in 16 nm FinFET Technology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19998)
*Maciej Szymon Pyrzowski,Franciszek Łukowski,Aida Todri-Sanial*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在TSMC 16 nm FinFET工艺下研究了正反馈绝热逻辑（PFAL），构建了功能完整的门库，并通过能量-延迟积优化考察了电源时钟幅度、频率与波形的影响，最终用于构建MUX与加法器电路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝热逻辑可通过准可逆开关回收负载电容上的部分能量，但其在FinFET工艺及多GHz频率下的波形优化操作仍缺乏研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在TSMC 16 nm FinFET工艺中设计、验证并表征功能完整的PFAL门库；针对电源时钟幅度、频率与波形形状进行能量-延迟积（EDP）优化；随后用该门库构建2:1多路复用器、4位行波进位加法器和4位Brent-Kung超前进位加法器。

Result: 电源时钟扫描表明最低能量波形趋近三角形而非传统梯形；优化后单门PFAL单元能量比等效静态CMOS低至3.83倍；正弦激励相比梯形激励能量改善至多1.32倍并扩展了有效工作范围；超前进位加法器在三角形电源时钟下相比静态CMOS能量估算获得至多5.3倍增益。

Conclusion: PFAL在FinFET工艺和多GHz频段下具有显著的能量优势，波形形状是关键优化维度，三角形电源时钟与正弦激励可进一步降低能量并扩展工作范围，该门库可有效支撑较大规模组合电路的低功耗设计。

Abstract: Adiabatic logic can recover part of the energy stored on load capacitances through quasi-reversible switching, but its waveform-optimized operation in FinFET technology and at multi-GHz frequencies remains underexplored. This work investigates Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (PFAL) in the TSMC 16 nm FinFET process. A functionally complete PFAL gate library is designed, verified, and characterised using energy-delay product optimization over power-clock amplitude, frequency, and waveform shape. The power-clock sweep shows that the minimum-energy waveform approaches a triangular shape rather than a conventional trapezoid. The optimized single-gate PFAL cells achieve up to 3.83x lower energy than equivalent static CMOS gates, while sinusoidal excitation improves energy by up to 1.32x compared with trapezoidal excitation and extends the valid operating range. The library is then used to construct larger combinational circuits, including a 2:1 multiplexer, a 4-bit ripple carry adder, and a 4-bit Brent-Kung carry look-ahead adder. The carry look-ahead adder reaches a gain of up to 5.3x compared with the static CMOS energy estimate for the triangular power-clock.

</details>


### [525] [Evaluating Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic in 16nm FinFET with a Realistic Power-Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19999)
*Franciszek Łukowski,Maciej Pyrzowski,Aida Todri-Sanial*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在TSMC 16nm FinFET工艺下系统评估了正反馈绝热逻辑（PFAL），建立了标准单元库与两款组合电路，分析了非绝热损耗来源，并设计了四相电源时钟发生器进行非理想供电验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝热逻辑通过准可逆开关复用负载电容上的能量，可获得比传统静态CMOS更低的最小能耗，但其在FinFET工艺与多GHz时钟频率下的实用性尚未被研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在TSMC 16nm FinFET工艺中仿真PFAL，构建PFAL标准单元门以及2×2乘法器和4位比较器两款组合电路，采用能量延迟积（EDP）与能量优势指标η=E_CMOS/E_PFAL与静态CMOS对比；同时设计并联耦合正交压控振荡器作为真实的四相电源时钟发生器，并开展负载（扇出）研究。

Result: 瞬态仿真揭示三类非绝热损耗来源：PMOS/NMOS锁存器特有的阈值电压相关损耗、此前未报道的输出节点冗余充电损耗，以及PFAL逻辑树复杂度相关损耗。低阈值Buffer/NOT单元在V_CLK=0.6V、f_CLK=7.94GHz下取得最小EDP为1.23×10⁻²⁶ J·s；降低频率与提高供电电压时PFAL相对静态CMOS的能量优势最高约5倍。采用非理想四相电源时钟时，3GHz下Buffer/NOT能耗与理想正弦情形相差在2%以内；扇出增加会引起相位偏移与幅度下降。

Conclusion: 本文为16nm FinFET中的PFAL提供了面向设计的评估，并表明绝热逻辑在未来低功耗系统架构中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Adiabatic logic reuses the energy stored on load capacitances through quasi-reversible switching, enabling a lower minimum energy consumption than conventional static CMOS. Yet its practicality in FinFET technologies and at multi-GHz clock rates has yet to be investigated. This work provides a systematic evaluation of Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (PFAL) simulated in the TSMC 16nm FinFET process. A set of PFAL standard-cell gates were realised, along with two representative combinational circuits - a 2$\times$2 multiplier and a 4-bit comparator - and compared against static CMOS logic using the energy--delay product (EDP) and the energy advantage metric $η= E_{\mathrm{CMOS}} / E_{\mathrm{PFAL}}$. Transient simulations reveal three sources of non-adiabatic loss: two specific to the PMOS/NMOS latch, threshold-voltage-related loss and a previously unreported redundant charging of the output node and one related to the complexity of PFAL logic trees. The low-threshold Buffer/NOT cell achieves a minimum EDP of $1.23\times10^{-26}$J$\cdot$s at $V_{\mathrm{CLK}} = 0.6$V and $f_{\mathrm{CLK}} = 7.94$GHz, while PFAL preserves an energy benefit over static CMOS of up to roughly $5\times$ at reduced frequencies and elevated supply voltages. A parallel-coupled quadrature voltage-controlled oscillator is designed as a realistic four-phase power-clock generator. With this non-ideal supply, the Buffer/NOT energy stays within $2\%$ of the ideal sinusoidal case at $3$GHz. A loading study quantifies the phase shift and amplitude reduction induced by increasing fan-out. Overall, the results provide a design-oriented evaluation of PFAL in 16nm FinFET and a motivation to exploit adiabatic logic for future low-power system architectures.

</details>


### [526] [Spectral Signatures for Parametric Fault Detection in Flexible Electronics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20315)
*Paula Carolina Lozano Duarte,Sule Ozev,Mehdi Tahoori*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于压控振荡器（VCO）的频域测试签名电路，用于IGZO单极性柔性薄膜晶体管AMS电路的故障与参数偏差检测，可无ATE、无精密基准实现片上自测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 柔性电子（FE）基于IGZO单极性TFT，面向可穿戴传感、生物医学监测与人机接口，其模拟与混合信号（AMS）模块需保持高精度。但面临多重挑战：低成本单极性工艺导致器件变异大；无刚性封装易受制造后失效；参数性故障会降低模拟精度而不引发数字硬失效；专用自动测试设备（ATE）成本高且难以在一次性FE系统中现场使用。传统基于ADC的测试方案在资源受限系统中面积开销过大，且ADC精度本身受PVT变化影响，可能导致测试失效。

Method: 提出频域测试签名电路，利用VCO的频谱能量检测被测AMS电路的故障与参数偏差。VCO将故障引起的控制电压偏差转换为频率偏移，再经轻量级模拟滤波器处理；以谐波分量的RMS值作为紧凑签名，对工作点偏差具有单调灵敏度，并在PVT角下保持排序一致性，无需精密基准或匹配比较器。采用比率式细化（ratiometric refinement）抑制温度与电源变化导致的后校准漂移。签名可通过两个I/O引脚读出，实现无ATE现场测试。

Result: 电路面积6390 μm²，功耗16.7 μW；相比紧凑型ADC实现26×面积缩减，相比SAR实现近1500×面积缩减。比率式细化可将温度与电源变化引起的后校准漂移抑制达一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该频域测试签名电路以极小面积和低功耗实现IGZO柔性AMS电路的鲁棒片上测试，兼顾PVT鲁棒性与现场可测性，为资源受限的一次性柔性电子系统提供了免ATE的测试方案。

Abstract: Flexible electronics (FE) based on indium gallium zinc oxide (IGZO) unipolar thin-film transistor (TFT) technologies enable lightweight, conformable systems for wearable sensing, biomedical monitoring, and human-machine interfaces. These applications rely on analog and mixed-signal (AMS) blocks that must remain accurate despite key challenges: increased device variability from low-cost unipolar fabrication; susceptibility to post-manufacturing failures due to the absence of rigid packaging; parametric faults that degrade analog accuracy without hard digital failures; and the high cost and in-field inaccessibility of specialized Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) for disposable FE systems. Conventional test approaches relying on analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) incur prohibitive area overhead in resource-constrained systems; critically, ADC accuracy is itself subject to process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, leading to test invalidations. This work proposes a frequency-domain test signature circuit exploiting spectral energy from a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) to detect faults and parametric deviations in AMS circuits under test. The VCO converts fault-induced control-voltage deviations into frequency shifts processed through lightweight analog filters. RMS values of harmonic components serve as compact signatures with monotonic sensitivity to operating-point deviations while preserving ordering across PVT corners, ensuring robust operation without precision references or matched comparators. A ratiometric refinement suppresses post-calibration drift from temperature and supply variation by up to an order of magnitude. The signature is readable via two I/O pins, enabling in-field test without ATE. The circuit occupies 6390 $μ$m$^2$ and consumes 16.7 $μ$W, achieving 26$\times$ area reduction versus compact ADCs and nearly 1500$\times$ versus SAR implementations.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.GN'></div>

### [527] [Large Language Model Agents for Evidence Based Genetic Disease Severity Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19569)
*Tohid Ghasemnejad,Ahmadreza Argha,Mark Grosser,John Wang,Min Yang,Thantrira Porntaveetus,Tony Roscioli,Nigel H. Lovell,Mahmoud Aarabi,Hamid Alinejad-Rokny*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 该研究开发了一个融合ReAct推理框架与RAG的自主AI agent，依据ACMG严重性指南和ACOG生活质量标准，对10,211个HPO术语进行疾病严重程度自动分类。表型水平准确率达93.55%（MCC 0.9237），基因水平聚合8,738对关系，含3,283个严重或极重常染色体隐性配对，外部验证与Mackenzie's Mission基因列表一致率95.2%，可实现标准化panel设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗传病严重程度分类具有主观性和高人力成本，成为基因组筛查的瓶颈；商业化panel规模与重叠差异大，缺乏标准化依据。

Method: 构建自主AI agent，将ReAct（推理与行动）与RAG（检索增强生成）相结合；以ACMG认可的严重性指南和ACOG生活质量标准为准则，检索PubMed文献，生成可解释推理链，并独立验证声明；先对10,211个HPO术语进行表型水平分类，再在8,738个基因对上聚合基因水平严重程度。

Result: 表型水平分类准确率93.55%，MCC 0.9237，82.6%–91.4%的声明有直接证据或有效推断支持；基因水平识别出3,283个呈严重或极重表型的常染色体隐性配对；外部验证与Mackenzie's Mission基因列表一致率为95.2%。

Conclusion: 该agent可提供有直接证据支持的可靠、自动化严重程度分类，从而实现标准化的基因panel设计，缓解基因组筛查中的分类瓶颈。

Abstract: Disease severity classification for genetic conditions is subjective and labor-intensive, creating bottlenecks in genomic screening, where commercial panels vary widely in size and overlap. We developed an autonomous AI agent integrating Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to classify 10,211 Human Phenotype Ontology terms. It uses American College of Medical Genetics (ACMG)-endorsed severity guidelines and American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) quality-of-life criteria to retrieve PubMed literature, generate interpretable reasoning chains, and independently verify claims. At the phenotype level, using expert-curated cohorts, the agent achieved 93.55% accuracy (MCC 0.9237) with 82.6% to 91.4% of claims supported by direct evidence or valid inferences. Gene-level severity was aggregated across 8,738 pairs, identifying 3,283 autosomal recessive pairs with severe or profound presentations. External validation showed 95.2% concordance with Mackenzie's Mission gene list. This system enables standardized panel design by providing reliable, automated classification supported by direct evidence.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [528] [Detecting Soft Errors in Parallel Software with LLM-tuned Instruction Duplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19531)
*Yafan Huang,Guanpeng Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出PaRID，一种仅需编译期开销的软件指导软错误检测框架，面向多线程并行程序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行程序软错误检测面临两大挑战：支持串行与并行混合区域，以及在无需昂贵动态剖析的前提下降低性能开销。

Method: 结合并行感知代码变换与LLM调优的性能建模，并由离线表征研究中得到的八条可泛化发现进行指导，实现编译期指令复制式的快速软错误检测。

Result: 在NPB基准上，保护开销平均从162.79%降至59.84%，最高获得5倍加速，同时保持完整的错误检测有效性。

Conclusion: PaRID证明仅凭编译期手段即可在并行程序中实现低开销且有效的软错误检测。

Abstract: We propose PaRID (PaRallel Instruction Duplication), a software-directed soft error detection framework that requires only compile-time effort for multithreading parallel programs. PaRID addresses two key challenges: supporting parallel programs with mixed serial and parallel regions and minimizing performance overhead without relying on costly dynamic profiling. It combines parallel-aware code transformation with LLM-tuned performance modeling, guided by eight generalizable findings from an offline characterization study, to enable fast soft error detection in parallel applications. Evaluation on NPB benchmarks shows that PaRID reduces protection overhead from 162.79% to 59.84% on average and achieves up to 5x speedup while maintaining full error detection effectiveness.

</details>


### [529] [Syndrome Decoding for Silent Data Corruption in Quantized Integer GPU Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19743)
*Pranav Napolean,Vikas Srivastava,Napolean Periathambi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SProbe是一种面向量化神经网络GPU张量核GEMM的输出尾随验证与纠错内核，用Freivalds随机化门检测静默数据损坏（SDC），再用Reed-Solomon译码定位并恢复行内最多4个冲突错误，可原地修复或重算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化推理在GPU张量核上执行整数矩阵乘法，INT32累加器既无奇偶校验也无ECC，瞬态故障会返回合法但错误的整数且不触发中断。现有校验和类ABFT（如TR-ABFT）判决是二值的，无法定位损坏元素及其幅度，且无加权行/列校验和按构造对在两轴上抵消的错误盲区。

Method: SProbe读取未修改厂商GEMM的输出；采用61位素域上三个独立求值点的随机Freivalds门（漏检概率≤2^-141）；门触发后，在三素数上计算逐行幂和伴随式，经Berlekamp-Massey、Chien搜索、Forney的Reed-Solomon链译码，恢复每行最多4个冲突错误的列位置与精确幅度，随后原地修复累加器或重算GEMM。

Result: 在NVIDIA H100上，SProbe对7类故障与4种矩阵尺寸的全部注入故障均检出，包括TR-ABFT永不检出及加权网格码能检出但无法纠正的模式。门开销在N=16384时为cuBLASLt GEMM时间的49%，N=65536时为11%。在INT8医学LLM中，保护消除了所有观测到的静默损坏，吞吐代价30%。测量还显示重算在所有测试配置下都快于原地恢复，诊断而非修复主导恢复开销，并报告了验证验证器时发现的缺陷。

Conclusion: SProbe证明基于随机化验证门与RS译码的尾随校验可在不加ECC的商用张量核上实现高概率检测、精确定位与纠错，兼顾可靠性与可接受开销，并揭示重算优于原地恢复的工程结论。

Abstract: Quantized neural network inference runs integer matrix multiplications on GPU tensor cores, and the INT32 accumulators inside those cores have neither parity nor ECC. A transient fault in this datapath returns a valid but wrong integer and raises no interrupt. Checksum based Algorithm Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT) can detect such silent data corruptions (SDCs), but its verdict is binary. It cannot identify the corrupted element or its magnitude, and unweighted row and column checksums are blind by construction to errors that cancel on both axes. We present SProbe, a trailing verification kernel that reads the output of an unmodified vendor GEMM. A randomized Freivalds gate with three independent evaluation points in a 61 bit prime field misses a nonzero error with probability at most $2^{-141}$. When the gate fires, per row power sum syndromes over three primes are decoded with the Reed Solomon chain of Berlekamp Massey, Chien search, and Forney, recovering the column and exact magnitude of up to four colliding errors per row. SProbe then repairs the accumulator in place or recomputes the GEMM. On an NVIDIA H100, SProbe detects every injected fault across seven fault classes and four matrix sizes, including constructed patterns that TR-ABFT never detects and patterns that a weighted grid code detects but cannot correct. The gate costs 49% of the cuBLASLt GEMM time at N=16384 and 11% at N=65536. In an INT8 medical LLM, protection eliminates all observed silent corruptions at a 30% throughput cost. Our measurements also show that recomputation is faster than in place recovery in every configuration we tested, that diagnosis rather than repair dominates recovery cost, and we report the defects we found while validating the verifier itself.

</details>


### [530] [Sketching the Error, Not the Product: Post Hoc Fault Recovery for Half Precision GPU Matrix Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19758)
*Pranav Napolean,Vikas Srivastava,Napolean Periathambi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FP-Sketch 是一种张量核 GEMM 后验校验器，利用和草图检测每次调用的数据损坏，并通过哈希一阶矩草图与独立重计算定位多个损坏条目，实现无假阳性定位与故障幅度诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加速器缺陷引发的静默数据损坏（SDC）会中断大规模训练，但现有缓解措施多以整节点为粒度，缺乏细粒度局部化能力。单个 GEMM 的 ABFT 需融合进内核或编码操作数，且每条校验和至多定位一个错误。

Method: FP-Sketch 在未修改的张量核 GEMM（半精度操作数、FP32 累加与输出）之后运行：和草图检测每次调用的损坏；哈希一阶矩草图配合独立重计算定位多个损坏条目，按构造无假阳性，每个故障给出坐标与幅度。针对浮点场景，测量草图噪声（其常数依赖 BLAS 与操作数格式），确定方形乘积所需桶数为 n^2.57；按实测噪声而非拟合的 n 幂次调整桶数，并在运行时测量噪声以适配内核与模型。

Result: 按实测噪声确定桶数使八种 transformer 形状的恢复率从 0.402 提升到 1.000。NVBit 指令级注入显示活跃累加器中的翻转常仅为典型条目的 2–9%，输出侧注入无法产生该分布：输出侧注入可恢复全部故障，而按典型幅度设计的引擎在 NVBit 下仅恢复 0.550，按实测幅度设计则恢复到 1.000。在 Llama-2-7B 上，保护 MLP 下投影可消除 2048 次比特翻转造成的困惑度损伤的 99.4%（BF16）与 99.9%（FP16），干净路径探针开销 0.78–3.06 ms，对应 GEMM 为 0.35–12.47 ms。

Conclusion: 以实测噪声而非经验幂律确定草图桶数，并在运行时自适应测量噪声，是提升浮点 GEMM 故障定位恢复率的关键；针对指令级注入产生的真实故障幅度进行校准，可实现 100% 恢复，并在大模型上显著降低比特翻转的困惑度损伤。

Abstract: Silent data corruption (SDC) from defective accelerators now interrupts large scale training, yet deployed mitigations act on whole nodes. Algorithm based fault tolerance (ABFT) for a single GEMM has to be fused into the kernel or encode the operands, and it localizes at most one error per checksum. We present FP-Sketch, a verifier that runs after an unmodified tensor core GEMM whose half precision operands are accumulated and delivered at FP32. A sum sketch detects corruption on every call. Hashed first moment sketches, confirmed by independent recomputation, then localize several corrupted entries with no false positives by construction, and each fault yields a coordinate and a magnitude for fleet diagnosis. In floating point, sketch noise rather than bucket collisions limits localization. We measure that noise and find that its constant depends on the BLAS and the operand format and that the bucket count must grow as $n^{2.57}$ for a square product. Sizing the bucket count by measured noise rather than by a fitted power of $n$ raises recovery on eight transformer shapes from 0.402 to 1.000, and measuring the noise at run time adapts the bucket count to the kernel and the model. Instruction level injection with NVBit shows that upsets in a live accumulator are often only 2 to 9% of a typical entry, a population that output side injection cannot produce. Output side injection recovers every fault, while under NVBit the same engine sized for faults of typical magnitude recovers 0.550, and sizing for the measured magnitudes restores 1.000. On Llama-2-7B, guarding the MLP down projections removes 99.4% (BF16) and 99.9% (FP16) of the perplexity damage caused by 2048 bit flips, and the clean path probe costs 0.78 to 3.06 ms against GEMMs of 0.35 to 12.47 ms.

</details>


### [531] [Safe Exploration of Arbitrary Dynamic Dangerous Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19845)
*Caterina Feletti,Paola Flocchini,Giuseppe Prencipe,Nicola Santoro*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文将图网络探索问题扩展到含黑洞的危险动态网络，证明在时序连通性假设下，给定必要数量代理，无知代理可在半同步调度下无需先验知识、无ID地永久安全探索；随后给出具唯一ID与持久内存、已知安全节点数的可终止安全探索算法；并证明两类情形下均无法仅正确标记通向黑洞的端口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gotoh等(2021)首次研究任意动态网络的探索问题，其必要最小假设是任意两节点会无限频繁地通过时序路径连通（时序连通性）。本文在其基础上引入危险动态网络，即网络可能包含一个或多个黑洞，代理一旦进入即被永久困住，从而需要研究安全探索问题。

Method: 在时序连通性假设下研究危险动态网络的安全探索。首先针对无知代理（无网络与队伍先验知识、无代理或节点ID），在半同步调度器下，证明给定必要（且充分）的代理数量即可永久探索所有安全节点。随后设计一个可终止的安全探索算法，该算法要求代理具有唯一ID与持久内存，并知道安全节点数量。最后，证明上述两种情形下均不可能使代理团队仅正确标记通向黑洞的端口。

Result: 证明在给定必要（且充分）代理数量时，无知代理可在半同步调度下、无任何先验知识、无ID地永久安全探索所有安全节点；给出具备唯一ID、持久内存且已知安全节点数时可安全探索并终止的算法；同时证明在两种情形下均不可能仅正确标记通向黑洞的端口。

Conclusion: 本文在时序连通的危险动态网络中建立了安全探索的可行性与不可能性边界：无知代理可行永久安全探索，具ID与记忆的代理可终止安全探索，但仅正确标记黑洞端口在两类设定下均不可实现。

Abstract: Given a team of agents on the nodes of a graph-based network, the exploration problem requires each node to be visited by at least one agent. In the classical distributed setting of static networks, agents do not know the topology of the network; in the more recently investigated setting of dynamic networks, they may have prior knowledge about the graph class (e.g., trees, tori, rings) or other parameters (e.g., number of nodes). Gotoh et al. (2021) are the first to study the exploration problem of arbitrary dynamic networks, under the necessary minimal assumption that any two nodes will be connected by a temporal path infinitely often (temporal connectivity assumption). In this paper, we extend their study of exploration under temporal connectivity by considering dangerous dynamic networks, i.e., containing possibly one or more black holes. Whenever an agent enters a black hole, it will be trapped forever. The safe exploration problem requires a team to explore all the safe nodes, ensuring that at least one agent will never be trapped in a black hole. We first prove that, given the necessary (and sufficient) number of agents, a team of oblivious agents can perpetually explore the safe nodes without any prior knowledge of the network or the team, without agent or node IDs, under semi-synchronous schedulers. Then, we provide an algorithm that enables agents to safely explore the network and terminate. In this case, agents are equipped with unique IDs and persistent memory, and they know the number of safe nodes. Yet, in both cases, we prove that it is impossible for a team of agents on dynamic networks to correctly mark only the ports leading to black holes.

</details>


### [532] [Xronos: Heterogeneity-Aware Tensor Parallelism for Collaborative LLM Fine-Tuning on Edge CPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19909)
*Wonmi Choi,Sunjae Park,Dohyeok Kwon,Zhixiong Niu,Yeonho Yoo,Chuck Yoo,Gyeongsik Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Xronos，一个面向异构 CPU 边缘设备的协同微调框架，以张量并行（TP）为执行骨干，结合轻量级性能分析与异构感知张量划分，缓解流水线并行（PP）在 CPU 边缘设备上的 CPU 争用与异构设备下的拖尾瓶颈，相比 SOTA 降低微调时间 18%–56%，设备空闲时间降低约 5.9 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SOTA 协同微调技术主要面向基于 GPU 的边缘设备并依赖流水线并行（PP）。但许多边缘平台（IoT 网关、智能家居中枢、车载计算机）以 CPU 为主。论文指出 PP 在 CPU 边缘设备上效率低下：同一 CPU 同时承担模型计算与通信，导致严重的 CPU 争用，平均计算停滞率比 GPU 设备高 5.75 倍。

Method: 先以张量并行（TP）作为替代方案，因其可分离计算与通信从而缓解争用；但现有 TP 假设设备同构，在异构 CPU 边缘设备上会导致较快的 worker 在同步点等待慢设备而空闲高达 34%。为此提出 Xronos：以 TP 为执行骨干，采用轻量级性能分析（lightweight profiling）与异构感知张量划分（heterogeneity-aware tensor partitioning），以缓解拖尾（straggler）瓶颈。

Result: 在多种设备、模型和基准任务上，Xronos 相比 SOTA 技术将微调时间降低 18%（相对于 TP）至 56%（相对于 PP），设备空闲时间比例降低约 5.9 倍，同时保持精度不变。

Conclusion: PP 不适用于 CPU 边缘设备的协同微调，TP 可缓解 CPU 争用但需解决异构性带来的拖尾问题；Xronos 通过异构感知的 TP 设计与轻量性能分析，在保持精度的同时显著提升异构 CPU 边缘设备上的协同微调效率。

Abstract: Collaborative fine-tuning on edge devices adapts large language models to domain-specific data while keeping each device's data local. State-of-the-art (SOTA) collaborative fine-tuning techniques are largely designed for GPU-based edge devices and rely on pipeline parallelism (PP). However, many edge platforms, including IoT gateways, smart-home hubs, and in-vehicle computers, are primarily CPU-based. This paper reports that PP is ineffective on CPU-based edge devices because the same CPU handles both model computation and communication, which causes severe CPU contention. Our analysis shows that this leads to 5.75$\times$ higher computation stall ratios than on GPU devices on average. Tensor parallelism (TP) can alleviate this contention by separating computation and communication, but existing TP techniques assume homogeneous devices. On heterogeneous CPU edge devices, we find that this assumption causes faster workers to remain idle for up to 34% while waiting for slower devices at synchronization points. To address the limitations, we propose Xronos, a collaborative fine-tuning framework for heterogeneous CPU edge devices. Xronos uses TP as its execution backbone and combines lightweight profiling with heterogeneity-aware tensor partitioning to reduce the straggler bottleneck. Across diverse devices, models, and benchmark tasks, Xronos reduces fine-tuning time by 18% (TP) to 56% (PP) and the ratio of device idle time by $\sim$5.9$\times$ over SOTA techniques, while maintaining the accuracy.

</details>


### [533] [The Life of a Token: from Words to Bits on the Wire](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19924)
*Davide Avesani,Pengwenlong Gu,Sotiris Skaperas,Stefano Secci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文以教程形式,借助《神曲》文本实例,从分词、嵌入、模型架构到并行化策略,分析大语言模型训练中语言如何转化为HPC网络通信流量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM参数规模达数十亿至数万亿,训练需跨数千个互联加速器展开;底层通信网络成为关键却常被忽视、不透明的组件,且语言如何转化为通信流量这一问题缺乏直观阐释。

Method: 结合模型架构分析、解析式流量模型与数值算例,追踪"词到网络流量"的路径,说明分词、嵌入与并行化策略如何影响网络交换数据的规模、结构与时序。

Result: 以但丁《神曲》为具体案例,刻画了LLM训练的通信需求特征,揭示架构与并行策略对通信流量形态的决定性作用。

Conclusion: 该教程揭开了"词如何穿越网络"的过程,并为支撑文本到已训练模型这一旅程所需的网络能力提供了实用见解。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) transform vast collections of unstructured text into semantic patterns used for language generation and reasoning tasks. Behind their ease of use lies a complex process: words become tokens, tokens become vectors, and vectors ultimately give rise to streams of bits that flow through High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems. As modern LLMs grow to billions or trillions of parameters, this path increasingly unfolds across thousands of interconnected accelerators, making the underlying communication fabric a critical and often opaque component of model training. This tutorial aims to walk the reader through the journey from words to network traffic, shedding light on how language is translated into communication flows within HPC training systems. Using concrete examples from Dante's Divine Comedy, we illustrate how model architecture, tokenization, embeddings, and parallelization strategies shape the volume, structure, and timing of data exchanged across the network. We combine architectural analysis with analytical traffic models and numerical examples to characterize the communication requirements of LLM training. We try to demystify how words travel across the network and provide practical insights into the network requirements needed to support the journey from text to trained model.

</details>


### [534] [VERA: Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Memory Scaling of HPC Workloads in Kubernetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19936)
*Ade Pramono,Jie Ren,Ivy Peng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出基于强化学习的垂直内存扩缩推荐器VERA，将HPC作业的内存弹性建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并在真实Kubernetes集群上验证其优于默认VPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC工作负载运行于Kubernetes时，内存过度供给导致资源利用率低下；默认Vertical Pod Autoscaler无法预判首次运行HPC作业的阶段性内存峰值，导致要么资源浪费、要么OOM风险。

Method: 将垂直内存扩缩形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，利用3353条真实Prometheus时序轨迹训练RL智能体（VERA），以观测驱动方式给出内存推荐；在在线Google Kubernetes Engine集群上以LAMMPS、图分析、内存分析、MLPerf 3D-UNet等负载进行评测，并与默认VPA对比。

Result: RL智能体回收31.6%的可用内存余量，最多发生1次OOM；同轮次中VPA回收率为-7.9%，反而提高了内存供给，且有30次运行其推荐不足以规避OOM。

Conclusion: 观测驱动的RL推荐器在动态内存扩缩场景下可优于回顾式启发式方法，为HPC负载在Kubernetes上的内存管理提供可行路径。

Abstract: Memory over-provisioning results in resource underutilization when HPC workloads run on Kubernetes. The default Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) cannot anticipate phase-driven memory spikes for first-run HPC jobs. In this work, we present a reinforcement learning (RL) recommender VERA that formulates vertical memory scaling as a Markov Decision Process and trains an agent on 3353 real Prometheus traces. Evaluated on a live Google Kubernetes Engine cluster using LAMMPS, graph analytics, in-memory analytics, and MLPerf 3D-UNet, the RL agent reclaims 31.6% of the available memory headroom and incurs at most one OOM event while VPA reclaims -7.9% over the same runs, raising memory provisioning, and its recommendation would have been insufficient to avoid OOM in 30 runs. The results demonstrate that an observation-driven RL recommender could outperform retrospective heuristics for dynamic memory scaling.

</details>


### [535] [P-GADMM: Parallel Group-Based ADMM for Asynchronous Optimization in Heterogeneous Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20006)
*Gaiguo Wei,Qingying Zhang,Heqiang Wang,Yu Zhang,Xiaoxiong Zhong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出面向异构边缘网络的并行分组ADMM（P-GADMM），通过计算感知分组与有界异步云协调降低墙钟训练时间并保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同步ADMM在异构边缘网络中因快客户端需等待慢客户端而效率受损；现有分组ADMM的分组规则多基于数据相似性或网络拓扑，未显式考虑计算异构性。

Method: P-GADMM依据客户端计算能力与本地数据规模构建计算感知边缘分组，降低组内训练速度差异；结合边缘级聚合与云端有界异步协调，通过延迟阈值控制组级陈旧信息，使活跃组无需等待慢组即可参与全局更新。针对强凸组目标，在组级有界陈旧性下建立理想化形式的收敛保证。

Result: 理论分析给出时间平均收敛行为，收敛至由陈旧性导致的渐近误差邻域；实验表明相较代表性基线，P-GADMM缩短墙钟训练时间且最终精度相当。

Conclusion: 通过计算感知分组与有界异步协调，P-GADMM在异构边缘分布式优化中实现效率与精度的良好权衡。

Abstract: The Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is widely used for distributed optimization, but its synchronous implementation can suffer from efficiency loss in heterogeneous edge networks, where fast clients or groups need to wait for slower ones before global updates can be completed. Existing group-based ADMM methods reduce communication overhead through grouping, but their grouping rules usually focus on data similarity or network topology and do not explicitly account for computation heterogeneity. To address this issue, this paper proposes Parallel Group-Based ADMM (P-GADMM) for distributed optimization in heterogeneous edge networks. P-GADMM forms computation-aware edge groups according to client computational capabilities and local data sizes, which reduces training-speed variation within each group. It further combines edge-level aggregation with bounded asynchronous coordination at the cloud, allowing active groups to participate in global updates without waiting for slower groups while controlling stale group information through a delay threshold. For strongly convex group objectives, we establish convergence guarantees for an idealized form of P-GADMM under bounded group-level staleness, showing a time-averaged convergence behavior up to a staleness-induced asymptotic error neighborhood. Experiments show that P-GADMM reduces wall-clock training time compared with representative baselines while maintaining comparable final accuracy.

</details>


### [536] [Distributed Edge Inference: an Experimental Study on Multiview Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20009)
*Gianluca Mittone,Giulio Malenza,Marco Aldinucci,Robert Birke*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过FastFL框架在计算连续体上部署多视角检测模型MvDet，验证去中心化基础设施在可扩展性上的优势，推理时延相比集中式方案最高提升1.92倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云计算集中式客户端-服务器架构随应用规模增长日益限制可扩展性，云/边/雾融合形成的计算连续体虽提供泛在资源，但如何设计应用以利用该复杂环境仍是挑战。

Method: 以真实多视角检测模型（MvDet）为负载，基于FastFL高性能C/C++边缘推理框架在计算连续体上实现，并设置不同边缘算力与网络带宽的多种实验场景。

Result: 在相同设备条件下，对比集中式方案，推理时间最高获得1.92倍加速。

Conclusion: 计算连续体具备提升超大规模应用性能的潜力，但性能收益依赖于边缘算力与网络带宽等条件。

Abstract: Computing is evolving rapidly to cater to the increasing demand for sophisticated services, and Cloud computing lays a solid foundation for flexible on-demand provisioning. However, as the size of applications grows, the centralised client-server approach used by Cloud computing increasingly limits the applications' scalability. To achieve ultra-scalability, cloud/edge/fog computing converges into the compute continuum, completely decentralising the infrastructure to encompass universal, pervasive resources. The compute continuum makes devising applications benefitting from this complex environment a challenging research problem. We put the opportunities the compute continuum offers to the test through a real-world multi-view detection model (MvDet) implemented with the FastFL C/C++ high-performance edge inference framework. Computational performance is discussed considering many experimental scenarios, encompassing different edge computational capabilities and network bandwidths. We obtain up to 1.92x speedup in inference time over a centralised solution using the same devices.

</details>


### [537] [The Price of Decentralization, Paid Twice: A Latency Floor and a Minimal Subsidy from a Geographic Decentralization Invariant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20322)
*Ruiyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文论证延迟感知验证者选择会侵蚀地理容错独立性，证明任意协议下β-法定人数提交延迟存在几何下界ρ（平面上最小为ρ√(β/γ)），并将该几何下界与激励耦合：在位置选择博弈中中心化表现为超临界O(2)对称破缺分岔，维持去中心化需量级为Θ(c*ρ/√γ)的反集中补贴，去中心化在延迟与激励上以常数比例被"双重支付"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延迟感知的验证者选择（通过投票权重、领导权或快速法定成员资格奖励低延迟）会促使验证者共址，从而侵蚀拜占庭容错所假设的地理故障独立性。作者希望为这一张力给出尖锐且与协议无关的形式化刻画，并揭示几何约束与激励之间的耦合关系，指出其基础下界虽属初等，但真正贡献在于延迟—补贴的耦合关系。

Method: 定义(ρ,γ)-去中心化质押配置（半径ρ区域内持有的质押不超过γ比例）。证明对法定阈值β>γ，任意提案者的β-法定提交延迟至少为ρ（协议无关），平面上最小值为ρ√(β/γ)。构造带真实法定延迟奖励的位置选择博弈，分析其中心化行为与对称破缺分岔，并推导维持去中心化目标所需的反集中补贴量级。数值验证并在实测地理数据上进行检验：基于RIPE-Atlas延迟矩阵对719个Solana验证者做普查。

Result: 证明了对β>γ，任意提案者的β-法定提交延迟下界为ρ，平面上确切最小值为ρ√(β/γ)；在位置选择博弈中，中心化以超临界O(2)对称破缺分岔形式出现；维持去中心化目标所需反集中补贴量级为Θ(c*ρ/√γ)，即去中心化在延迟与激励上以常数比例被支付两次。实测方面，719个验证者的Solana普查在RIPE-Atlas延迟矩阵上得出验证者Nakamoto系数为19，而地理Nakamoto系数仅为1–2。

Conclusion: 延迟感知的验证者选择导致地理集中化，去中心化被迫在延迟与激励两方面付出代价，且两者存在常数比例关系。作者明确界定范围：几何下界本身是初等的，真正的贡献在于延迟—补贴耦合的刻画。该框架为协议设计者评估去中心化成本提供了判据。

Abstract: Latency-aware validator selection---rewarding validators for low network latency through voting weight, leadership, or fast-quorum membership---is known to push validators to co-locate, eroding the geographic fault-independence that Byzantine fault tolerance assumes. We give this tension a sharp, protocol-agnostic form. Calling a stake configuration (rho,gamma)-decentralized if no radius-rho region holds more than a gamma fraction of stake, we prove that for quorum threshold beta>gamma every proposer's beta-quorum commit latency is at least rho---independent of the protocol---and in the plane the minimum is exactly rho*sqrt(beta/gamma). Our main result couples this geometric floor to an incentive one: in a location-choice game with the true quorum-latency reward, centralization arises as a supercritical O(2)-symmetry-breaking bifurcation, and sustaining a decentralization target costs an anti-concentration subsidy of magnitude Theta(c*rho/sqrt(gamma))---decentralization is paid twice, in latency and in incentives, in a constant ratio. We verify every claim numerically and on measured geography: a 719-validator Solana census on a RIPE-Atlas latency matrix has validator Nakamoto coefficient 19 but geographic Nakamoto 1--2. We are explicit about scope: the floor is elementary; the contribution is the latency--subsidy coupling.

</details>


### [538] [Accelerating Sharded Data Parallelism at Scale with Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20359)
*Gianluca Mittone,Marco Aldinucci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出FL+FSDP与FL+HSDP两种混合算法，将分片数据并行（DP）与FedAvg式聚合交织，把大规模DP部署解耦为松散耦合的联邦组，以降低通信开销并约束全局批大小。在512块A100上预训练Llama3.1 8B，数据处理速度最高提升8.04倍，评估困惑度降低4.48。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型（FM）训练需在数千块GPU上耗时数月，分片数据并行（sharded DP）是主流加速策略，但在大规模部署时通信开销过高，尤其在多层级、性能异构的互连网络上。受联邦学习高效通信原则启发，作者希望在大规模DP场景中实现可扩展且灵活的通信优化。

Method: 提出两种混合算法FL+FSDP与FL+HSDP，将分片DP与FedAvg式聚合交替进行；将大规模DP部署解耦为多个较小且松散耦合的联邦组，仅需极少的组间流量，同时使全局批大小受限于组规模。对通信成本进行形式化分析，并通过实验验证。

Result: 在512块A100 GPU上预训练Llama3.1 8B时，在相同超参数下，FL+FSDP与FL+HSDP相比对应基线，数据处理速度最高提升8.04倍，评估困惑度降低4.48，展现出更优的计算效率与模型质量。

Conclusion: 上述性能收益源于通信开销的降低，以及全局批大小相对联邦组规模的有界增长；形式化分析与实验共同证明该方案具备良好的可扩展性与灵活性。

Abstract: The symbiotic scaling of artificial intelligence models and high-performance computing systems continually creates algorithmic challenges in their convergence. Foundation models (FMs) are a crucial example, requiring months-long training on thousands of cutting-edge GPUs. Sharded data parallelism (DP) is the dominant strategy to accelerate such computations by splitting data and models across multiple GPUs. However, it incurs prohibitive communication overhead when deployed at scale, particularly on multi-tier interconnects with heterogeneous performance. Inspired by the efficient communication principles of federated learning (FL), this work introduces two hybrid algorithms - FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP - interleaving sharded DP with FedAvg-style aggregations. Such approaches decouple large DP deployments into smaller, loosely-coupled federation groups, requiring minimal inter-group traffic while keeping the global batch size bounded by the groups' size. Formal analysis of communication costs and experimental validation prove their scalability and flexibility. A Llama3.1 8B pre-training on 512 A100 GPUs shows that, under identical hyperparameters, FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP achieve up to 8.04 faster data processing and 4.48 lower evaluation perplexity than their counterparts, demonstrating superior computational efficiency and improved model quality. These properties stem from reduced communication overhead and the bounded growth of the global batch size relative to the federation group size.

</details>


### [539] [A Kubernetes-Native Request Router for Quality-Aware Inference Serving in the Computing Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20497)
*Ignjat Karanovic,Pantelis A. Frangoudis,Ivan Čilić,Ivana Podnar Žarko,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出ASRB，一种面向Kubernetes计算连续体部署的、基于动态评分的请求路由机制，联合考虑基础设施信息、响应时间与应用级质量指标，支持延迟-精度权衡，并在不修改Kubernetes的前提下降低监控开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算连续体上部署的机器学习工作负载对延迟与精度存在多样化需求，现有路由机制难以灵活权衡二者，且大规模部署下的监控开销问题突出。

Method: ASRB为动态评分路由均衡器：将基础设施层信息、响应时间测量与应用级质量指标统一建模；依据服务提供者定义的策略（QoS准则的加权组合）进行路由；跨多系统层监控运行时指标，并对监控强度进行选择性、自适应控制以降低开销；实现上无需修改Kubernetes。

Result: 当调优为降低延迟时，平均响应时间比面向延迟的先进路由机制至少低10 ms；在特定配置下精度更高，可实现灵活且由运营者控制的权衡；同时失败率更低、对运行环境变化的响应性更高，监控成本较相关先进方案最多降低约70%，部分配置下仅有适度延迟代价。

Conclusion: ASRB能够在不改动Kubernetes的情况下提供可配置的延迟-精度权衡，兼顾性能、鲁棒性与监控效率，适合在现有集群环境中直接部署与运维。

Abstract: We introduce Adaptive Score-based Routing Balancer (ASRB), a dynamic, score-based request routing mechanism for Kubernetes-based service deployments over the computing continuum. ASRB jointly considers infrastructure-level information, response time measurements, and application-level quality indicators, with a particular focus on serving Machine Learning (ML) workloads. For these workloads, ASRB balances requests over service instances deployed in the continuum, following service provider-defined policies encoded as weighted combinations of QoS criteria to flexibly address latency-accuracy trade-offs. To drive routing decisions and swiftly adapt to changes in the operating environment, ASRB monitors a range of runtime metrics across multiple system layers. To deal with the associated monitoring overhead, particularly important for large-scale deployments, it selectively and adaptively controls monitoring intensity without sacrificing on routing quality. ASRB is implemented without requiring any modifications to Kubernetes, making it straightforward to deploy and operate in existing cluster environments. Our testbed experiments demonstrate the versatility of ASRB: When tuned for latency reduction, it achieves at least 10 ms lower mean response time compared with latency-oriented state-of-the-art routing mechanisms, while it achieves higher accuracy when this is prioritized through specific configurations, thus enabling flexible and operator-controllable trade-offs. At the same time, it attains reduced failure rates, higher responsiveness to changes in the operating environment, and up to ~70% less monitoring cost than relevant state-of-the-art solutions, at the potential expense of only a modest latency penalty in some configurations.

</details>


### [540] [PixelFlow: Token-Level Workload Management for Efficient Distributed DiT Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20723)
*Zhexiang Zhang,Minchen Yu,Yifan Sun,Xu Bai,Xingliang Yuan,Adel N. Toosi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PixelFlow 是一个分布式 DiT 在线服务系统，通过 token 级工作负载管理，将请求划分为可变大小的分区并在多 GPU 上批量执行，从而在满足延迟 SLO 的前提下提升 GPU 利用率与吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线 DiT 图像生成需要在满足延迟 SLO 的同时高效利用 GPU。现有系统采用请求级批处理提升利用率，但批大小控制受限：小批次无法饱和 GPU 算力，大批次则可能违反延迟 SLO；此外全局协调调度要求各自推进的 GPU 在接纳新工作前同步，进一步引入延迟。

Method: 核心思想是用图像 token（DiT 生成图像的处理单元）将请求工作负载在更细粒度上划分与批处理，使每块 GPU 在延迟约束下承担部分额外工作，并通过跨 GPU 分摊提升并发请求数。系统提供运行时将请求切分为可变大小分区并在各 GPU 上高效批处理；通过优化 token 放置减少跨 GPU 数据交换并平衡负载；利用去噪步骤间的相似性将剩余传输与计算重叠；并采用 SLO 感知调度器将具有兼容延迟需求的请求分组共享算力，各组独立推进，仅在需要合并资源接纳新请求时同步。

Result: 在 H100 GPU 上使用 Stable Diffusion 3 与 FLUX.1-dev 评估，PixelFlow 将 SLO 达成率提升最高 43%，goodput 达到最先进 DiT 服务系统的最高 2.8 倍。

Conclusion: 通过 token 级细粒度批处理与分区、通信优化及 SLO 感知分组调度，PixelFlow 有效突破了请求级批处理的批大小限制和全局协调同步开销，在满足延迟约束下显著提升 GPU 利用率与系统吞吐。

Abstract: Online image generation with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) must meet latency service-level objectives (SLOs) while using GPU resources efficiently. Existing systems improve GPU utilization by batching multiple requests for joint execution. However, request-level batching offers limited control over batch size: batches may be too small to saturate GPU compute, while larger ones may violate latency SLOs. Globally coordinated scheduling introduces further delays by requiring independently progressing GPUs to synchronize before admitting new work.
  We present PixelFlow, a distributed DiT serving system that addresses these limitations through token-level workload management. Its key idea is to use image tokens (the units a DiT processes to generate an image) to divide and batch request workloads at a finer granularity. This allows each GPU to take on a portion of additional work under latency constraints. By distributing these portions across GPUs, PixelFlow accommodates more concurrent requests, improving GPU utilization while reducing queueing delays. To realize this flexibility, PixelFlow provides a runtime that splits requests into variable-sized partitions and batches them efficiently on each GPU. To reduce the resulting communication overhead, it optimizes token placement to limit cross-GPU data exchange while balancing GPU workloads. It further exploits similarity across denoising steps to overlap the remaining transfers with computation. An SLO-aware scheduler groups GPUs to share compute resources among requests with compatible latency requirements. Each group progresses independently, synchronizing with others only when their combined resources are needed to admit a new request. Evaluation with Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX.1-dev on H100 GPUs shows that PixelFlow improves SLO attainment by up to 43% and achieves up to 2.8 times the goodput of state-of-the-art DiT serving systems.

</details>
